We observe a pattern of aggressive inventory push to top-tier distributors, which correlates with the subsequent product returns. While management attributes this to seasonal fluctuations, we have not yet verified the underlying sell-through data. We reserve our final conclusion on channel health pending reconciliation with the distributor’s inventory reports. This potential overstatement of net revenue warrants close scrutiny during the final audit stage.

notes.why: 使用观察型动词 observe 描述事实，而非直接给出定性判断（如指责压货）。

notes.q: we have not yet verified the
notes.why: 诚实陈述审计证据的缺失，既保护自己又客观指出风险点。

notes.q: We reserve our final conclusion on
notes.why: 标准的推迟断言句式，通过 reserve 将结论延后至证据充分时。

take: We observe a pattern of [behavior] which correlates with [financial outcome].
We have not yet verified the [data point] provided by management.
We reserve our final conclusion on [topic] pending reconciliation with [evidence].

items.t: 并购估值分歧归因分析
items.en: The Target’s management claims that the 15% premium over peer averages is justified by their proprietary AI pipeline projected for FY26F. However, our preliminary analysis indicates that these projections heavily rely on aggressive customer acquisition assumptions that have not materialized in 9M26. While the seller maintains that these synergies are imminent, our independent review of the internal sales backlog suggests a more conservative conversion rate. We recommend bridge negotiations focus on earn-out structures to mitigate the valuation gap arising from these disparate outlooks. This approach balances the seller’s optimistic growth narrative with our data-driven risk assessment.

notes.why: 通过claim一词弱化对方观点的确定性，与后文的转折形成对比。
使用preliminary一词为审计结论留有余地，符合尽调初期的谨慎态度。
用While引导让步从句，在承认对方立场的同时，为我方反驳做铺垫。

take: The Target’s management claims that […], but our analysis suggests […].
While the seller maintains that […], our independent review indicates […].
We recommend [action] to mitigate the valuation gap arising from [source].

items.t: 汇率波动对跨境结算的影响
items.en: The depreciation of the local currency against the USD by 8.5% in 9M26 significantly eroded cross-border settlement margins. While we have assessed the transaction-level impact, we are currently unable to isolate the specific causal link between currency hedging efficacy and individual supplier pricing models due to data granularity constraints. Our analysis focuses on historical variance rather than predictive forecasting of future exchange rate volatility. We recommend that the management implement a more robust forward-contracting framework to mitigate these exposures in FY27. This scope limitation should be considered when interpreting the overall financial impact disclosed in the draft audit report.

notes.q: we are currently unable to isolate
notes.why: 使用无法隔离（isolate）来定义工作边界，暗示问题复杂而非自己能力不足。
将做不到的原因归咎于底层数据颗粒度，这是非常专业的防御性表达。

notes.q: focuses on historical variance rather than predictive forecasting
notes.why: 通过对比而非消极陈述，明确界定服务范围（即只做回溯不做预测）。

take: We are currently unable to [isolate/verify] X due to [data granularity/access] constraints.
Our analysis is strictly confined to [historical data] and does not extend to [predictive forecasting].
This limitation should be taken into account when assessing [the specific impact of X].

items.t: 营运资金机制的谈判局限
items.en: The FY25 working capital adjustment mechanism successfully stabilized cash flow, yet further optimization of supplier payment terms remains outside the current audit mandate. We have reviewed the underlying contracts for the top 20 vendors, representing 78% of total procurement, to validate the current settlement cycle. It is beyond the scope of this engagement to renegotiate individual commercial terms or perform a comparative analysis against industry-wide benchmarks for non-core suppliers. Consequently, we provide no assurance regarding the potential for further working capital release beyond the identified cash conversion cycle improvements. Stakeholders should note that this review serves to assess compliance rather than facilitate direct operational negotiations.

notes.q: remains outside the current audit mandate
notes.why: 直接引用授权（mandate）作为拒绝进一步工作的理由，显得公事公办且专业。

notes.q: It is beyond the scope of this engagement to
notes.why: 标准的审计/咨询术语，用客观的范围界定来拒绝客户的额外要求。
通过否定语气（no assurance）明确排除潜在责任，保护自身免受预期外压力。

take: Further optimization of [X] remains outside the current audit mandate.
It is beyond the scope of this engagement to [perform X/renegotiate Y].
We provide no assurance regarding [future outcomes/potential savings] resulting from [current findings].

items.en: enabling America's families to access mortgage loan funding
items.why: enabling sth to do sth 结构比简单的 help/allow 更具专业感，强调了作为基础设施的赋能作用。中国人常写成 help families get/obtain，显得口语化且缺乏金融机构的宏观视角。
items.when: 描述公司业务如何为客户创造核心价值或提供便利时使用。
items.slot: enabling […] to access […]
swap: facilitating access to [...] (更正式，强调流程顺畅)
providing [...] with access to [...] (更直接，强调服务提供)

items.en: accounted for 16% of our FMS total revenue
items.why: 这是财务报告描述占比的标准表达。中国人常写成 was 16% of...，account for 强调了该项目在整体中的权重和贡献，更具专业分析感。
items.when: 在财务报告或审计底稿中描述某项业务、支出或资产在总额中的占比时使用。
items.slot: [...] accounted for [percentage] of [total amount]
swap: represented 16% of (中性，较平淡)
comprised 16% of (强调构成，稍微正式一点)

items.en: Our business is subject to complex and evolving laws
items.why: 用 'be subject to' 连接业务与法规约束，既专业又精准，免去了中国写作者常犯的 'our business faces or is controlled by' 等口语化表达。
items.when: 在财报或尽调报告中描述企业面临的法律、监管或合同约束时。
items.slot: [Our business / The company] is subject to complex and evolving [laws / regulations / standards] regarding [...]
swap: Our business faces complex laws (中文直译感强，缺乏正式财报的客观严肃性)
We must comply with complex laws (主语变成we，不如被动语态客观强调业务本身的属性)

items.en: as well as relevant discussion in our 'Liquidity and Capital Resources' section
items.why: 用 as well as 连接并列名词短语，使句式错落有致，避免了 and 的单调。中国人写作容易通篇使用 and。
items.when: 在罗列多个相关章节、因素或证据时套用。
items.slot: as well as relevant discussion in our [...] section
swap: and relevant discussion... (并列连词过于单一)
along with relevant discussion... (侧重伴随，语气稍显非正式)

items.en: see further discussion in Note 3 and Note 7, respectively, of our consolidated financial statements
items.why: respectively 精准对应了 Note 3 对应前面某处、Note 7 对应另一处（或按顺序对应），位置夹在介词短语中极具专业感。中国人在类似交叉引用时经常漏掉这个词，导致对应关系模糊。
items.when: 在报告中同时引用多处对应位置时套用。
items.slot: see further discussion in Note [...] and Note [...], respectively, of our [...]
swap: see further discussion in Note 3 and Note 7 of our... (缺少 respectively，对应关系不够严密)
respectively, see further discussion... (放在句首略显突兀)

items.en: Maintaining superior human capital is a key driver to the success and longevity
items.why: 中国人容易用 'is very important for success'。这里用 key driver to 替代 important，名词化后更有战略高度，longevity 更是点睛之笔，比写 'how long it has lived' 高明得多。
items.when: 分析公司核心竞争力或业务护城河时。
items.slot: Maintaining [...] is a key driver to the success and longevity of [...]
swap: is very important for the company's long-term success (口语化且缺乏力度)
plays an important role in making the company successful (冗长不够精炼)

items.en: Our 2025 financial results also reflect the impact of a complex macro environment
items.why: 用 reflect 代替 show 或 result from，将抽象的财务表现与宏观环境的映射关系写得极具画面感。中国人在写财报时常因词汇量有限而用 show 或 impact on，显得呆板。
items.when: 在财报或尽调报告中，当需要解释财务数据受外部环境或事件影响时使用。
items.slot: Our […] financial results also reflect the impact of […]
swap: Our [...] financial results are driven by [...] (过于直接，缺乏财报高级感)
Our [...] financial results show the effects of [...] (动词不够精准)

items.en: pressuring our International Package segment margins during the year
items.why: 将名词 pressure 转化为动词ing形式作伴随状语，精准传达了对利润率造成的持续下行压力。中国职场英语常写成 'which put pressure on margins'，不够精简。
items.when: 描述某项不利因素对财务指标产生挤压或负面作用时。
items.slot: pressuring our […] segment margins during the year
swap: putting pressure on our [...] segment margins (结构冗长，缺乏动感)
reducing our [...] segment margins (力度不够，未能体现出压迫和博弈感)

items.en: contributing to consolidated total revenue of $7.5 billion and consolidated operating income of $216.1 million
items.why: 用现在分词短语作结果状语，比用and连接的并列句更紧凑，避免了句子过于琐碎。中国人在写财报时常写成 'which contributed to'，显得拖沓
items.when: 在财报中描述某项业务运营对整体财务业绩的贡献时
items.slot: contributing to consolidated total revenue of […] and consolidated operating income of […]
swap: which contributed to revenue of [...] (加入了which显得冗余且中断了连贯性)
resulting in revenue of [...] (强调直接导致，语气比contributing to更强)

items.en: that, when combined, lead the industry in margin and growth
items.why: 非母语者常写成 'which lead the industry... when they are combined'。使用插入语 'when combined' 紧凑地表达了协同价值，'lead the industry in' 是非常地道的评价性表达，避免了平庸的 'is the best'。
items.when: 在撰写管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）或总结公司竞争优势时使用。
items.slot: that, when combined, lead the industry in […] and […]
swap: that collectively position us as an industry leader in […] (更强调市场地位)
that together drive industry-leading performance in […] (更强调驱动力)

items.en: leverage efficiencies and best practices across our brands
items.why: leverage 在财务报告中是动词首选，意为“利用/发挥杠杆作用”。中国人常写 use 或 utilize，显得比较口语化，缺乏管理咨询的专业力度。
items.when: 在讨论整合资源、协同效应或并购后的管理策略时使用。
items.slot: leverage […] and […] across our […]
swap: capitalize on […]: 侧重于利用机会，不如 leverage 强调对内部效率的挖掘
utilize resources for [...]: 过于平淡，缺乏对协同效应的描述

items.en: evaluate growth opportunities based on customer demand and supply chain trends
items.why: 用 based on 引导一系列复杂的决策维度，逻辑清晰。中国人常写 'We look at A, B, and C to decide...'，显得结构松散，缺乏书面报告的严谨性。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中说明决策逻辑、投资评估标准时使用。
items.slot: evaluate […] based on […], […], and […]
swap: assess […] in light of [...]: 语气较正式，但不如 based on 直接明了
determine […] by considering [...]: 动词搭配较弱，不如 evaluate 具有评估的专业性

items.en: as a percent of total cost of operations
items.why: 中国人常写成 'accounted for X% of the total cost'，原句用介词短语作定语修饰名词，更简洁且符合财务报告的专业语感。
items.when: 在财务分析中说明某项成本占总支出的比例时。
items.slot: […] as a percent of [… total amount]
swap: as a proportion of (更正式，常用于学术或严谨报告)
expressed as a percentage of (更啰嗦，不够地道)

items.en: To date, the Company has not experienced a cybersecurity incident
items.why: To date 是非常地道的时态限定词，明确指代‘截至目前’。中国人常写成 Until now 或 So far，前者过于正式生硬，后者过于口语，不如 To date 在专业报告中稳重。
items.when: 在陈述当前状态或历史记录（如未发生违约、未受处罚）时使用。
items.slot: To date, the Company has not [… verb in past participle]
swap: As of the date of this report, the Company has not (更冗长，但更具法律效力)
Up to the present, the Company has not (略显生硬)

items.en: while it is not dependent on any one customer
items.why: 中国人写让步或转折时习惯用 although 或 even though，而专业财报里更喜欢用 while 放在句中做弱转折，语气客观精炼，避免了头重脚轻。
items.when: 在陈述公司某项核心优势（如不依赖单一客户、供应商），同时又需客观指出潜在风险时套用。
items.slot: while it is not dependent on any […]
swap: although it is not dependent on any […] (尽管语气准确，但不如 while 显得地道流畅)
even though it is not dependent on any […] (even though 语气偏重，通常用于口语或强反差对比)

items.en: loss of certain top customers could adversely affect the Company
items.why: 用 could 代替 will，体现了财务英语严谨的对冲思维（Hedge）；同时副词 adversely 放在动词 affect 前面，比用 bad impact 更加书面化。
items.when: 在尽调报告的风险提示章节中，分析某种不利事件可能对公司造成的负面影响时套用。
items.slot: loss of certain […] could adversely affect the […]
swap: would negatively impact the […] (would 语气过于绝对，不符合审计谨慎原则)
might harm the […] (harm 感情色彩过强，不如 adversely affect 专业)

items.en: align executives' personal incentives with those of the Shareholders
items.why: 用 align... with... 完美表达了“利益绑定”，比中国写作者常用的 connect... with... 更精确；代词 those of 的使用避免了重复名词 Shareholders。
items.when: 在解释高管薪酬结构设计初衷或公司治理政策时套用
items.slot: align [...]'s personal incentives with those of the [...]
swap: connect [...]'s interests with [...] - 词汇过于基础，未体现高管激励机制的专业性
match [...] goals with [...] - 搭配不够地道，通常不用 match 表达利益对齐

items.en: directly participate in any increase in per share value created by their efforts
items.why: 精准运用 participate in 表达分享红利，配合 per share value 显得极其专业，后置分词 created by 简洁有力，避免了从句的拖沓。
items.when: 在描述股权激励带来的财务收益或价值创造机制时使用
items.slot: directly participate in any increase in per share value created by [...]
swap: directly share the growth of [...] - 动词选择不够正式，缺乏财务文本的严谨感
enjoy the higher stock price from [...] - 带有明显的主观色彩，不符合客观财报风格

items.en: we entered into an employment agreement with Darcy Daubaras
items.why: 动词 enter into 比签约常用的 sign 更具正式法律文书感，搭配 agreement 显得专业。中国人在写财务报告时常写成 sign an agreement，显得口语化。
items.when: 描述公司与高管、供应商或客户正式签署合同、协议时套用。
items.slot: we entered into an employment agreement with [...]
swap: signed an employment agreement (sign 偏口语，缺乏 SEC 报告的正式法律严肃感)
concluded an employment agreement (conclude 虽正式但多用于国际条约，在劳务合同中不如 enter into 地道)

items.en: pursuant to which Mr. Daubaras serves as Chief Financial Officer of the Company
items.why: 用 pursuant to which 引导定语从句来替代 and under this agreement，极具法律契约文风，使行文紧凑且专业。中国人在写审计报告或尽调时喜欢拆成两个简单的句子。
items.when: 在前述合同或协议条款的基础上，引出某人根据该协议担任某职务或履行某义务时套用。
items.slot: [...] pursuant to which [...] serves as [...] of the Company
swap: under which Mr. Daubaras serves as (under which 也可以，但 pursuant to which 的契约强制力语气更强)
and according to this agreement he serves as (句式零散，完全没有专业英文财报的精炼感)

items.en: the Daubaras Employment Agreement provides for severance benefits upon termination of employment
items.why: 用 provide for 表示协议“规定、涵盖、提供”某项条款或福利，比用 include 或 has 更准确地表达了合同条款的法律效力。中国人容易直译为 include severance benefits。
items.when: 说明某项合同、协议、法律或制度中“规定了”某种补偿、津贴或权利时套用。
items.slot: the [...] Agreement provides for [...] upon [...]
swap: includes severance benefits (include 仅表示包含，无法体现法律文件强制“规定”的语义)
offers severance benefits (offer 偏向商业促销或主动给予，不如 provide for 的契约规定感强)

items.en: up by $24.7 million, or 19%, from 2024
items.why: 精确定量表达采用‘up by [金额], or [百分比], from [基准期]’的双重递进结构，兼顾绝对值与相对涨幅，中国人常只写一项或用 and 连接导致冗长。
items.when: 财报中描述营收、利润、资产等核心财务指标的按年或按季变动时
items.slot: up by […] , or […] , from […]
swap: increased by $24.7 million (19%) compared to 2024 (结构较平淡，缺少层次感)
rose $24.7 million, representing a 19% increase from 2024 (表达偏冗长，不如原文紧凑)

items.en: We have omitted discussion of the earliest of the three years covered by our consolidated financial statements
items.why: 用 omit discussion of 代替省略不谈，显得正式且职业；中国人在写审计报告或财报时容易直译为 we did not write about，缺乏SEC文件特有的规范感。
items.when: 在财报中依法合规地省略某年比较数据说明时套用
items.slot: We have omitted discussion of the earliest of the three years covered by our […]
swap: We decided not to discuss the earliest year... (口语化，不够正式严肃)
We skipped the discussion of the oldest year... (skipped 过于随意，不符合审计底稿文风)

items.en: as that disclosure is included in our Annual Report on Form 10-K
items.why: 用 as that disclosure is included 巧妙串联前后文指引，比用 and it is included 更加紧凑且符合法律文书的逻辑连贯性。
items.when: 需要指引读者去查阅其他已公开的法定报告时套用
items.slot: as that disclosure is included in our Annual Report on Form […]
swap: and this disclosure can be found in our... (and 连接显得松散，缺乏专业公文感)
because it is written in our... (because 语气偏口语，不够正式)

items.en: You can reference the discussion and analysis of our results of operations
items.why: 准确使用了 reference the discussion and analysis 这一标准财报交叉引用的动宾搭配，避免了中国人爱用的 look at 或 read 这种非正式用语。
items.when: 在财报或尽调报告中引导读者交叉检索特定章节时套用
items.slot: You can reference the discussion and analysis of our […]
swap: You can read our analysis about... (read 显得太浅白，缺乏专业审计报告的权威感)
Please check the discussion of... (Please check 语气像是在命令客户，不够客观)

items.en: confident in our ability to generate free cash flow
items.why: 使用了“Confident in our ability to...”这一句式，在表达对未来业绩的预期时，既展现了管理层的信心，又通过 ability 强调了这种信心是基于公司核心竞争力的，而非空谈。
items.when: 在展望（Outlook）或管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）中，向投资者传递对未来财务表现的信心时使用。
items.slot: confident in our ability to […] to continue supporting our commitment to […]
swap: believe we can generate enough cash (过于主观，缺乏财务专业度)
expect to generate sufficient free cash flow (语气偏中性，缺乏信心表达)

items.en: As a result of changes to many of the programs
items.why: 中国人常直接用 Because of 或 Due to，显得简单。As a result of 能够自然地引出复杂的因果逻辑，且在审计报告中能体现出对外部环境变动（changes）的严谨因果归因。
items.when: 在陈述外部政策变动导致公司财务或业务受影响时使用。
items.slot: As a result of […]
swap: Due to changes in (用词较平淡，缺乏逻辑递进感)
Owing to the modifications of (语气过于书面化，不够简洁)

items.en: insurance proceeds may not be timely paid to us
items.why: 中国人常写成 'insurance proceeds might not be paid on time'，用 timely 作副词比 on time 更正式且具有专业感，体现了财务报告对时效性的精确定义。
items.when: 在风险披露或合同条款中，描述付款或赔偿延迟的可能性时使用。
items.slot: […] may not be timely paid to us
swap: may experience payment delays (过于口语化，不够正式)
might not be settled in a timely manner (更为冗长，不如原句简洁)

items.en: Each of our brands has accessible pricing relative to its competitive set
items.why: 用 relative to 代替 compared to，显得学术且克制，没有动词拖泥带水。中国人写财报常写 compared with 或 in comparison with，略显陈旧和口语化。
items.when: 在财报、招股书或竞品分析中对比价格、市占率或定位时套用
items.slot: Each of our [...] has accessible pricing relative to its competitive set
swap: compared with its competitors (显得口语化且用词平庸)
vis-à-vis its competitive set (过于书面化，不适合美股财报风格)

items.en: as compared to other leading mass cosmetics brands which have average product price points of $10
items.why: 用 as compared to 引导具体量化对比，语气极为客观精确。中国财务人员常直接用 compared to 丢掉 as，或者生硬地用 whereas。
items.when: 在财报中罗列具体财务或运营指标的基准对照时套用
items.slot: as compared to other leading [...] brands which have average product price points of [...]
swap: compared to other leading brands (少了一个 as，结构不够严谨平衡)
whereas other leading brands have (连词过长，破坏了平行句式)

items.en: we deliver quality that's often better than prestige
items.why: 用 often better than 而非绝对化的 best，既自信又合规，避免虚假宣传风险。中国人写产品优势时容易用力过猛用 always 或 the best。
items.when: 在财报描述产品性能、客户反馈或竞争优势时需要展现自信但留有余地时套用
items.slot: we deliver [...] that's often better than [...]
swap: that is always superior to (语气太满，合规上有风险)
which generally outperforms (略显生硬呆板，不如原句生动)

items.en: The United States accounted for 79% of our net sales
items.why: 用 accounted for 替代了生硬的 took up 或 made up，显得极具专业财务报告的正式感。中国人常误用 occupy 或 compose，不够地道。
items.when: 在财报中描述某项业务、地区或产品线占总营收或总资产的比例时。
items.slot: [...] accounted for [...]% of our [...]
swap: represented 79% of our net sales (强调代表性，略显正式)
comprised 79% of our net sales (侧重于构成成分，但不如 accounted for 常见)

items.en: The remaining 21% was attributable to international markets.
items.why: 用 attributable to 替代了简单的 came from，精确表达“归因于/来源于”，逻辑链条严密。中国人容易写成 come from 或 belong to。
items.when: 分析财务指标变动原因或解释特定部分的归属时。
items.slot: The remaining [...] was attributable to [...]
swap: derived from international markets (动词形式，表达更直接但少了一层归因的严谨)
originated from international markets (侧重来源地，缺乏财务归属的专业感)

items.en: in the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026.
items.why: 过去分词 ended 作后置定语极其精炼，省去了定语从句。中国人往往会写成 which ended on，显得拖沓不专业。
items.when: 在财报和审计报告中指代特定的财务年度或期间。
items.slot: in the fiscal year ended [...] [...]
swap: for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026 (适用于尚未结束或强调正在进行的财年)
that ended on March 31, 2026 (使用了定语从句，不如分词短语简洁)

items.en: Delivering premium quality products at extraordinary prices is at the heart of our value proposition
items.why: 用 'is at the heart of' 替代了平庸的 'is very important for'，将核心价值具象化为心脏，画面感极强。中国人写财报常滥用 'core' 或 'is important'。
items.when: 在陈述某项商业战略、产品特性或品牌理念对于整个商业模式至关重要时套用。
items.slot: Delivering […] is at the heart of our […]
swap: is central to our value proposition (词义相近但偏学术，不如 heart 生动)
lies at the core of our value proposition (略显陈旧的商业套话)

items.en: Understanding our water footprint is another important aspect of our sustainability efforts.
items.why: 用动名词短语作主语，比用被动语态或写人称代词（如 We want to understand...）显得客观且学术。中国职场英语常写成 To understand... 或 We should understand...，不如动名词更符合 ESG 报告的正式体例。
items.when: 在财务报告或 ESG 报告中介绍某项战略举措、重要性和背景时使用
items.slot: Understanding our […] is another important aspect of our […] efforts.
swap: To understand our water footprint is another important aspect... (动词不定式略显啰嗦，不如动名词自然)
We need to understand our water footprint as part of... (主动态过于口语化，缺乏正式报告的客观感)

items.en: From being an essential ingredient in our products to its use in our suppliers' manufacturing processes
items.why: 用 'From A to B' 结构串联不同维度的业务场景，条理极清。中国人写这类句子容易用并列连词 and 堆砌，显得散乱，而此结构天然带有全景扫描的递进感。
items.when: 在说明某项政策、资源或风险覆盖的业务范围、链条长度时使用
items.slot: From being an essential […] in our operations to its use in our […] processes
swap: Both as an essential ingredient in our products and in our suppliers' manufacturing... (用 both...and... 显平庸，没有范围延伸的动态感)
It is used as an essential ingredient and also in our suppliers' manufacturing... (拆成两个句子，破坏了流畅度)

items.en: we are working to identify and implement solutions to reduce water usage and increase efficiency
items.why: 连续使用 'working to identify and implement' 和 'to reduce... and increase...'，动词不定式嵌套精准，动作感极强。中国人常写成 try to find and use ways of reducing...，显得繁琐且不够专业。
items.when: 在审计底稿或尽调报告中描述管理层正在采取的整改或优化措施时使用
items.slot: we are working to identify and implement solutions to […] and […]
swap: we are trying to find and use solutions for reducing... (try to 显得不够正式，for reducing 不及不定式简洁)
we endeavor to find and apply solutions that can reduce... (endeavor 略显陈旧，定语从句拖沓)

items.en: within the meaning of the corporate governance rules of the Nasdaq Stock Market
items.why: 精准引用法规、协议或准则的术语界定，用 within the meaning of 比 according to 更具法律严谨性，中国人常误用 under 或 according to。
items.when: 在财务报告中引用特定规则、法条或合同条款定义时套用。
items.slot: [...] within the meaning of the [...]
swap: as defined in the [...]（侧重于定义，少了一层解释性含义）
pursuant to the [...]（偏向行政执行，不如 within the meaning of 贴合概念归属）

items.en: Kura Japan can exert significant voting influence over fundamental and significant corporate matters
items.why: 用 exert significant influence over 替代简单的 control，体现控制力的施加过程而非绝对状态，中国人常写成 have big power。
items.when: 描述大股东、母公司或关键利益方对企业决策施加重大影响时套用。
items.slot: [...] can exert significant voting influence over [...]
swap: can heavily control [...]（用词生硬，缺乏专业财报的客观克制感）
has major impact on [...]（结构单薄，动词和名词搭配不够地道）

items.en: We have pursued a disciplined new unit growth strategy
items.why: 用 disciplined 修饰 strategy，精准传达了有纪律的、克制的扩张态度，比干巴巴的 cautious 或 controlled 更有战略定力。中国审计师常写成 carried out a strict growth plan，显得机械。
items.when: 在财报或尽调报告中描述公司有原则、有计划的业务推进时套用。
items.slot: We have pursued a disciplined […] strategy, having expanded our […] across […]
swap: We have implemented a controlled growth plan (听起来更偏向行政执行，缺乏战略主动感)
We have executed a rigorous expansion strategy (语气偏重压力测试，不如 disciplined 显得游刃有余)

items.en: We plan to leverage our expertise opening new restaurants to fill in existing markets
items.why: 动词 leverage 用得极精妙，把过去的经验直接转化为当下的竞争筹码；fill in 展现出填补空白市场的精准动作。中国人常写成 use our experience to enter，显得平庸生硬。
items.when: 在阐述公司如何利用既有核心能力开拓新业务或新市场时套用。
items.slot: We plan to leverage our expertise […] to fill in existing markets and expand into new geographies
swap: We intend to use our experience to enter existing markets (用 use 代替 leverage 显得口语化且缺乏商业感)
We aim to apply our knowledge to penetrate existing markets (apply... to 略显陈旧，没有 leverage 借力打力的动态感)

items.en: Our ability to achieve new restaurant growth is impacted by a number of risks and uncertainties beyond our control
items.why: 巧妙组合了 is impacted by、a number of 以及 beyond our control，既说明了外部制约，又没有绝对化。中国人常写成 will be affected by many uncontrollable risks，显得过于绝对和口语化。
items.when: 在尽调报告的风险提示或局限性说明部分套用。
items.slot: Our ability to achieve […] is impacted by a number of risks and uncertainties beyond our control, including those described in […]
swap: Our growth is affected by many uncontrollable risks (many 不如 a number of 正式，uncontrollable 不如 beyond our control 地道)
Our performance faces various risks outside our management (outside our management 不及 beyond our control 在财报语境中标准)

items.en: We intend to continue to pursue targeted local marketing efforts
items.why: 连续使用了 intend to 和 continue to 两个动词不定式，层层递进地表达了公司长期的战略规划，语气坚定且正式。中国人在写这类句子时，往往只用一个简单的 plan to do 或者 will do，显得单薄且缺乏商业文件的专业度。
items.when: 在撰写战略规划、管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）或未来展望时，需要表达持续推进某项业务时套用。
items.slot: We intend to continue to pursue […]
swap: We plan to further advance [...] (语气略有不同，强调进一步推进而非持续追求)
We are committed to pursuing [...] (语气更强，强调承诺与决心)

items.en: We intend to continue to promote limited time offerings
items.why: 使用 limited time offerings 这一标准的行业术语来指代限时促销产品，用词极其地道。中国人容易直译为 time-limited sales 或 short-term products，不够专业。
items.when: 在提及具体营销手段、产品策略或商业活动时套用。
items.slot: We intend to continue to promote limited time [...]
swap: We plan to continue to feature seasonal [...] (强调季节性而非单纯限时)
We aim to continue to offer promotional [...] (强调促销性质)

items.en: We use a variety of marketing and advertising channels
items.why: 用 a variety of 代替普通的 various 或 different，显得词汇更丰富；中国人写财报常习惯用 various，显得呆板。
items.when: 在介绍企业采用多种方式、多种渠道开展某项业务时套用
items.slot: We use a variety of [...] to [...]
swap: We utilize diverse [...] (显得更学术或技术化)
We employ multiple [...] (强调数量多)

items.en: are an additional form of marketing that differentiates the Kura brand
items.why: 用 form of marketing 配合定语从句，把具体的促销活动抽象化定性，中国人容易直接写成 promote the brand，缺乏层次感。
items.when: 介绍某个具体产品或项目属于某种战略补充时套用
items.slot: [...] is an additional form of [...] that [...]
swap: [...] serves as another type of [...] which [...] (略显冗长)
[...] acts as a supplementary [...] to [...] (表达更直接但少了一层定语修饰)

items.en: which include the licensing of other popular brands from time-to-time
items.why: 插入 from time-to-time 作为状语，准确界定了动作发生的非连续性和频率，避免了绝对化的表述，符合审计严谨性要求。
items.when: 描述某种非常态的、间歇性发生的业务操作时套用
items.slot: [...] which include [...] from time-to-time
swap: [...] which occasionally include [...] (用副词代替，更简洁但不如原句生动)
[...] which periodically involve [...] (偏正式，缺乏原句的商业灵活性)

items.en: generally ranging from $20.95 to $20.99 for lunch and $29.99 to $33.95 for dinners
items.why: 用 ranging from... to... 完美处理了不同门店、不同时段的价格区间，衔接自然。中国人写财报常喜欢用 split sentences 拆成两句，不够紧凑。
items.when: 披露价格区间、费用变动范围或运营指标波动时
items.slot: generally ranging from […] to […] for […] and […] to […] for […]
swap: spanning between […] and […]（spanning 偏向时间跨度，不如 ranging 贴切）
falling in the bracket of […] to […]（过于书面和生硬，财报中不常用）

items.en: with significant concentrations in major markets like Los Angeles, San Francisco, and New York City
items.why: 用介词短语 with 作后置定语或伴随状语，紧凑地补充说明地理分布，比写成独立的句子更为精炼。中国人写财报常习惯用定语从句（which have significant concentrations...），显得啰嗦
items.when: 在描述资产、门店、业务或风险的地域分布时
items.slot: with significant concentrations in [...]
swap: concentrated heavily in [...]
动词过去分词作后置定语，语气更直接但缺乏层次感
where a significant concentration exists in [...]
定语从句，结构臃肿，不符合专业财报的精炼风格

items.en: a more than 100% increase over the past five year
items.why: 用名词短语精确量化增长幅度和时间跨度，more than 前置修饰百分比很地道。中国人容易写成动词短语（increased by more than 100% over the past five years），而在总结性陈述中名词化表达更有说服力
items.when: 在招股书或业绩回顾中报告业务量、门店数或财务指标的成倍增长时
items.slot: a more than [...] increase over the past [...]
swap: an increase of over 100% during the last [...] years
介词搭配略显平淡，不如原句紧凑
growing by more than 100% in [...] years
分词短语作状语，不如名词短语作为核心统计数据醒目

items.en: forward-looking statements made by us in this Form 10-K speak only as of the date on which they are made
items.why: 中国人常写成'are only valid on the date'。'speak as of'是法律英语中界定陈述时效性的地道表达，强调陈述仅在特定时间点有效，避免承担后续责任。
items.when: 在披露前瞻性声明或财务预测时，用于界定信息的时间效力范围。
items.slot: the […] speak only as of the date on which they are made
swap: are limited to the date of (表达较平铺直叙，缺乏法律文书的凝练感)
reflect the situation as of (侧重于描述现状，而非强调陈述的时效性)

items.en: we undertake no obligation to update these forward-looking statements
items.why: 中国人常写成'we don't have to update'或'we are not required to update'。'undertake no obligation'使用了更正式的动词搭配，体现了发行人主动规避后续更新义务的法律姿态。
items.when: 在免责声明中，明确告知投资者公司无义务根据后续变化更新过往预测。
items.slot: we undertake no obligation to […]
swap: are not obligated to (用词较为普通，缺乏法律文书的仪式感)
disclaim any duty to (语气更强硬，通常用于完全拒绝承担责任的语境)

items.en: under the guidance of the Board of Directors
items.why: 用 under the guidance of 表达从属和被监督关系，比简单的 directed by 或 managed by 更具专业感和合规性。中国人常写成 guided by the Board，缺乏名词短语带来的稳重感。
items.when: 描述公司内部治理架构或特定政策的制定过程时使用。
items.slot: under the guidance of […]
swap: subject to the oversight of [...]: 语气更强硬，强调监管和制衡。
in accordance with the directives of [...]: 强调遵从指令，更具行政色彩。

items.en: partially offset by an increase in accounts payable of $38.1 million
items.why: 用 past participle 短语作后置状语极为精炼，精准表达了某项负面影响被另一项正面或相反变动部分抵消的动态关系，避免了写成冗长的复合句。
items.when: 当分析两个方向相反的财务变动如何互相牵制、影响最终净额时。
items.slot: partially offset by […] of […]
swap: which was partly counterbalanced by […]（从句形式偏啰嗦，不如分词干脆）
with a partial offset from […]（介词短语结构，稍显被动）

items.en: We prepare our consolidated financial statements in accordance with GAAP.
items.why: 用介词短语 in accordance with 代替汉语直译的 follow 或 by，显得极其规范和官方。中国人常写成 according to GAAP 或 follow GAAP，在正式财务报告中不够严谨。
items.when: 在财报、审计报告或法律合同中引用准则、法规或合同时
items.slot: We prepare our consolidated financial statements in accordance with [...]
swap: pursuant to GAAP（更加法律化和强制）
in compliance with GAAP（强调合规性而非单纯遵循）

items.en: Substantially all of our revenue is generated from
items.why: 中国人常写成 'Most of our revenue comes from'，显得口语化。'Substantially all' 是审计和财报中的标准用语，精确界定了绝大部分的比例，显得严谨且专业。
items.when: 在尽职调查报告或审计底稿中描述某项业务占比极高时使用。
items.slot: Substantially all of our […] is generated from […].
swap: The vast majority of our revenue is derived from (语气较重，但不如 substantially 严谨)
A significant portion of our revenue is generated from (语气较弱，不够精准)

items.en: Our platform enables our customers to increase patient loyalty and retention
items.why: 用 enable sb to 比让中国人头疼的 make sb do 或 allow sb to 显得更专业且极具商业说服力，强调了平台赋能的属性，避免了平庸的主谓结构。
items.when: 在财报或商业计划书中介绍核心产品或技术的功能优势时。
items.slot: Our […] enables our […] to […]
swap: Our platform lets our customers increase patient loyalty -> lets 过于口语化，不够正式
Our platform helps our customers to increase patient loyalty -> helps 语气较弱，不如 enables 确定

items.en: by helping them keep their patients engaged through multi-channel communications
items.why: 介词 by 加上动名词短语，极其流畅地解释了前文目标的实现路径（how），避免了另起一句造成的逻辑断层。中国人往往会机械地用 and they can 导致句式松散。
items.when: 解释某项业务策略或财务指标增长的根本驱动因素时。
items.slot: by helping them […] through [...]
swap: so that they can keep their patients engaged -> 变成结果状语从句，头重脚轻
through keeping their patients engaged -> 略显生硬，不如 by helping them 自然

items.en: reducing friction with online appointments, digital forms, and convenient and flexible payment options
items.why: 用 reducing friction 这种高度浓缩的商业术语来概括优化流程、提升效率，比罗列一堆动词短语高级得多。中国人写此类内容常堆砌 improve efficiency 或 make it easy。
items.when: 描述产品如何改善用户体验、降低交易成本或简化业务流程时。
items.slot: reducing friction with […]
swap: making it easier with online appointments -> 过于口语化，缺乏商业质感
decreasing operational barriers with online appointments -> 词汇稍显生硬，不如 reducing friction 地道

items.en: pass through credit card processing fees to patients with surcharging
items.why: 准确使用了 pass through 这一财务/商业术语来表达成本转嫁，避免了用 transfer 这种不够专业的词。
items.when: 涉及费用转嫁、成本分摊或税费处理机制时。
items.slot: pass through […] to […] with […]
swap: transfer fees to patients (用词不够精准，缺乏行业专业感)
charge fees to patients directly (忽略了通过 surcharge 机制转嫁的商业实质)

items.en: We provide end-to-end artificial intelligence-powered ("AI") advertising solutions
items.why: 用复合形容词 end-to-end 修饰 solutions，极具商业科技感。中国人写财报常写成完整的定语从句 'solutions that cover the whole process'，显得啰嗦而不地道。
items.when: 描述技术、平台或服务覆盖全流程、一站式时套用。
items.slot: We provide end-to-end […] solutions for businesses to […]
swap: full-cycle solutions - 侧重生命周期全覆盖，但商业上不如 end-to-end 常用
comprehensive solutions - 含义过于宽泛，缺乏科技公司的精确感

items.en: Our comprehensive, end-to-end advertising solutions deliver value by helping companies scale their businesses
items.why: 用 deliver value 引出具体方式 (by doing)，比中国学生常用的“can help companies to do”显得更有商业说服力，动词搭配更地道。
items.when: 在财报或商业计划书中介绍核心产品或服务如何创造商业价值时套用。
items.slot: Our comprehensive, end-to-end […] solutions deliver value by helping companies […]
swap: provide value through doing (略显冗余)
create value via doing (偏向学术)

items.en: in order to increase the number of users who download and/or engage with their content
items.why: 使用了“in order to + 动词”来精确锁定战略意图，且用“download and/or engage with”处理了复杂的法律/商业合规表述，避免了漏项。
items.when: 在描述某项技术功能或商业举措的目的时使用。
items.slot: […] in order to increase the number of users who […]
swap: so that they can increase (口语化，不够正式)
to increase (有时不够强调目的性)

items.en: This summary should be read in conjunction with the
items.why: 中国人常写 please read this together with，显得很像说明书。这里用被动语态加介词短语 in conjunction with，既正式又具引导性，完美指引了财务报表各章节的勾稽关系。
items.when: 在财报附注或段落开头提示读者交叉比对相关章节时使用。
items.slot: This summary should be read in conjunction with the [...]
swap: Please read this along with [...] - 祈使句口吻太强，不符合专业财务报告的客观克制语气
This must be viewed together with [...] - 语气过于严厉，缺乏法律文件惯用的客观提示感

items.en: not be relied upon as an exhaustive summary
items.why: 中国人容易直译为 cannot be trusted as，显得主观且不够法律规范。这里用 rely upon 作为被动搭配，并用 exhaustive 准确界定“穷尽性”，在免责声明（Safe Harbor）中是标准且无可挑剔的表达。
items.when: 在出具声明、报告或估值时进行责任豁免和边界限定时使用。
items.slot: should not be relied upon as an exhaustive [...]
swap: cannot be used as a complete [...] - 词汇偏日常，缺乏法律文书的庄重感
should not be treated as a full [...] - treated 比 relied upon 显得随意，不够专业

items.en: we expanded the use of AI-powered customer service and support features
items.why: 中国人常写 we used more AI tools，而用 expanded the use of 显得正式且有层次，强调存量的扩大与业务延展，符合财报客观沉稳的基调。
items.when: 在财报中描述公司扩大某项技术、工具或策略的应用范围时套用。
items.slot: we expanded the use of […] to help more quickly and effectively resolve issues
swap: we scaled up our utilization of [...] - 语气更重，强调规模化扩张
we increased our reliance on [...] - 带有“增加依赖”的意味，略微改变了原意色彩

items.en: supplementing our existing review, watchlist, and background check procedures
items.why: 中国人通常会另起一句用 and they supplement...，而这里用现在分词作状语，极具英语母语者的精炼感，把“主动作”和“辅助效果”完美结合在一句话中。
items.when: 在介绍某项新措施或新资产时，说明其对现有流程或体系的补充作用。
items.slot: [...], supplementing our existing [...] procedures
swap: which supplements our existing [...] procedures - 用定语从句，稍显冗长拖沓
and it also supplements [...] - 用并列句，削弱了主次层次感

items.en: While performance marketing remains a component of our multi-faceted approach
items.why: 用 remains 替代简单的 is，既承认了某项成本或策略的存在（客观、不掩饰），又暗指它不再占据主导地位。中国人写财报常写 is an important part，显得生硬且没有这种微妙的动态退让感。
items.when: 在财报中需要承认某个传统业务或高成本项依然存在，但要强调其重要性正在下降时。
items.slot: While […] remains a component of our multi-faceted approach
swap: While […] continues to be a part of our strategy (语气更直白，少了一点留白)
Although […] is still utilized within our framework (显得过于防御和生硬)

items.en: has allowed us to maintain lower reliance on paid marketing channels
items.why: 用 allow sb. to do 巧妙地把‘内部能力的提升’和‘外部指标的优化（如低依赖度）’挂钩，避开了直接吹嘘。中国人写财务分析时常写 so we have lower reliance，句子松散且缺乏因果推导的专业感。
items.when: 解释某一核心优势（如品牌效应、技术壁垒）如何自然带来财务或运营指标（如低成本、低风险）的改善时。
items.slot: has allowed us to maintain lower reliance on […]
swap: has enabled us to reduce our dependence on […] (动词直接变成 reduce，少了 maintain 这种维持既有优势的稳健感)
leading to a decrease in our reliance on […] (分词作结果状语，不如主谓结构有力)

items.en: we are also subject to a wide spectrum of laws, rules, regulations, policies, legal interpretations, and regulatory guidance
items.why: 中国人写合规常干巴巴用 'face many laws'，这里用 'be subject to a wide spectrum of'，既准确传达了法律的强制管辖，又用 'wide spectrum of' 极具画面感地展现了监管范围的广阔和杂乱，极大地提升了风险揭示的专业度。
items.when: 在财务尽职调查或审计报告中罗列某家企业面临的外部监管、诉讼或合规风险时套用。
items.slot: [company name] is also subject to a wide spectrum of [laws / regulations / risks / challenges] governing […]
swap: face various laws (太口语化，缺乏法律严肃性)
must comply with numerous regulations (略显单调，没有体现出种类的繁多)

items.en: As we continue to expand the reach of our brand
items.why: 'expand the reach of our brand' 比单纯的 'expand our brand' 更有画面感，强调了品牌影响力的辐射范围和边界。
items.when: 描述业务扩张、市场渗透或品牌全球化战略时套用。
items.slot: As we continue to expand the reach of our [...]
swap: As we keep growing our brand (keep doing 略显口语化)
As our brand gets bigger (用词极其幼稚，缺乏商业正式感)

items.en: These forward-looking statements are subject to a number of known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions
items.why: 用 'are subject to' 完美衔接主语和风险因素，比中国学习者惯用的 'will face' 或 'include' 显得专业且被动克制，符合审计报告对不确定性的客观表述。
items.when: 在财报或尽调报告中提示某项资产、业绩或预测面临潜在风险和不确定性时。
items.slot: [...] are subject to a number of known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions
swap: face a number of risks (直白且缺乏专业财报的客观防御感)
will encounter risks (过于确定，违背前瞻性声明的免责本质)

items.en: cause actual results to differ from those contained in, or implied by, any forward-looking statements
items.why: 用 'cause A to differ from B' 严谨地界定预测与实际结果的差异，'contained in, or implied by' 更是把显式和隐式的预测都涵盖了，滴水不漏。
items.when: 在法律声明或风险提示中解释为什么未来实际结果可能与预期不符时。
items.slot: cause actual results to differ from those [contained in / stated in] [...]
swap: make actual results different from forecasts (用词平庸，缺乏法律和审计文书的严密性)
lead to different results from what we said (极其口语化，完全无法用于 SEC 报告)

items.en: These savings are driven by reduced infrastructure spend, development and operational resources
items.why: 用被动语态和 driven by 精准串联因果，比直接用 because of 更有说服力。中国人写财报常习惯写主动态 We save money because we reduce...
items.when: 在财报中解释某项财务指标或商业结果的驱动因素时套用
items.slot: These [gains / savings / efficiencies] are driven by reduced […], […] and [...]
swap: These savings stem from lower [...] and [...] (动词 stem from 略显单薄，力度不及 driven by)
These cost reductions are caused by [...] (caused by 过于口语化，缺乏财报专业度)

items.en: avoid the complexity of building data streaming systems from scratch
items.why: 名词化表达 avoid the complexity of 比用动词 avoid building 更加客观、正式，突出了痛点的系统性。中国人常习惯写 prevent complicated things。
items.when: 在强调产品如何帮助客户规避繁琐流程或技术壁垒时套用
items.slot: avoid the complexity of [...] from scratch
swap: prevent the complicated process of building [...] (prevent 用法不如 avoid 地道)
skip the complicated task of creating [...] (skip 略显口语化，不够严谨)

items.en: there is no assurance that the proposed Merger will occur
items.why: 用 'there is no assurance that' 比普通的 'we are not sure whether' 或 'it is not guaranteed' 正式得多，是美国资本市场信息披露的标准避险话术。
items.when: 在财报、合同或尽调报告中声明某项重大交易或未来事件不具百分之百的确定性时。
items.slot: there is no assurance that [...] will occur
swap: it is not guaranteed that [...] will happen (动词 'happen' 不及 'occur' 正式)
we cannot ensure whether [...] will take place (主观色彩太浓，不如原句客观中立)

items.en: without bypassing controls for risk management or regulatory compliance
items.why: 用 bypass controls（绕过控制）从反面切入，比正面强调 comply with regulations 更具审计合规的专业严谨度。中国人写合规常只会用 meet requirements。
items.when: 在强调速度、创新或效率的同时，保证不违反合规和风控底线时
items.slot: safely accelerate […] initiatives without bypassing controls for […]
swap: without breaking compliance rules：口语化较重，缺乏SEC文件应有的法律严谨性。
while still meeting compliance standards：属于正面表述，不如原句用 bypass 从反面限定来得深刻有力。

items.en: meaning that our success is tied to our customers’ actual usage of and success with our product.
items.why: 用 'is tied to' 替代常规的 'depends on'，生动形象地表达业务成果与客户产品使用深层绑定，避免了词汇单一。中国写作者常习惯用 rely on 或 depend on。
items.when: 在财报中描述商业模式的底层驱动逻辑、业务相关性时套用。
items.slot: meaning that our success is tied to our customers’ […]
swap: is directly dependent on (语气更偏向传统依赖，缺乏 tied to 的契约与绑定感)
correlates with (侧重统计学相关，没有业务共生的动态感)

items.en: The model is designed to drive business growth by mapping the customer journey from initial interest, to pilot, to first production project, to an integrated platform across the enterprise.
items.why: 用 'mapping the customer journey from A to B to C' 串联整个转化漏斗，极具画面感和专业度。中国写作者常写成 tracking the process from A to B，缺乏战略高度。
items.when: 描述商业规划、用户生命周期或业务演进路径时套用。
items.slot: The model is designed to drive business growth by mapping the customer journey from [initial interest], to [pilot], to [first production project], to [...]
swap: tracing the development from (动词不够精准，缺乏 journey 的动态推进感)
outlining the progression from (语气偏静态大纲，不如 mapping 贴合业务落地)

items.en: We have designed and implemented this strategy to garner customer signups, convert them to paid customers, expand long-term consumption through additional use cases and rapidly deliver customer value.
items.why: 动词 'garner' 和 'convert'、'expand'、'deliver' 构成了密集的动宾复合动作，精准体现获客到变现的全链路。中国人常写成 get new users 或 win customers，显得不够正式。
items.when: 罗列战略动作、业务目标的实现手段时套用。
items.slot: We have designed and implemented this strategy to garner [customer signups], convert them to [paid customers], expand [long-term consumption] through [...] and rapidly deliver [customer value].
swap: secure new users (secure 偏向防守和拿到，garner 更具囊括战果的商业感)
obtain signups (obtain 过于生硬刻板，不如 garner 地道)

items.en: As we continue to expand into new markets and further develop our digital channels
items.why: 用 as 引导伴随性的背景从句，动词用 continue to 和 further develop 组合，显得业务进展是连续且有深度的。中国人写财报常死板用 while we are expanding，缺少动态演进感。
items.when: 写公司业务发展背景、战略推进或管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）章节时
items.slot: As we continue to expand into […] and further develop our […],
swap: While we are expanding into [...] and developing [...] (时态较单一，缺乏持续深入的语感)
With our ongoing expansion into [...] and further development of [...] (名词化结构过重，动感不如原句)

items.en: retain customer data for Sweetgreen orders and may use that information to promote other restaurants
items.why: 用 retain 准确描述平台对数据的留存，并用 may use 谨慎限定潜正在风险。中国人易用 keep 替代 retain，显得口语化不够专业。
items.when: 在审计或尽调中描述第三方平台、供应商或合作伙伴对敏感资产、数据的使用权限及合规风险时
items.slot: retain customer data for […] orders and may use that information to […],
swap: keep customer data and might use it for [...] (动词 keep 和 might 显得过于随意不够正式)
collect user data and are able to leverage it to [...] (collect 强调收集而非留存，准确度打折扣)

items.en: has further intensified overall competition in recent years
items.why: 用 intensified overall competition 描述竞争加剧，搭配副词 further 和时间状语 in recent years 很有宏观报告的质感。中国人常写 has made competition more intense。
items.when: 评估行业竞争格局变化、市场压力或外部经营环境恶化时
items.slot: has further intensified overall competition in […],
swap: has made the market competition much more intense recently (口语色彩较浓，主谓宾结构略显臃肿)
has driven up the level of competition over the past few years (driven up 偏向价格或成本上升，不如 intensified 贴切)

items.en: Our business has been and may continue to be materially and adversely affected by
items.why: 副词 materially 和 adversely 连续修饰被动语态，精准界定了财务冲击的程度（实质性）与性质（负面），比泛泛而谈的 'badly hurt' 显得更为客观专业。中国人在写审计报告或风险提示时，常习惯用 'badly damaged' 或 'greatly influenced'，显得口语化且力度不够。
items.when: 在财务报告、审计意见或尽调报告中描述某项宏观因素、诉讼或灾害对公司财务状况造成重大不利影响时套用。
items.slot: [Our business / The financial condition] has been and may continue to be materially and adversely affected by [...]
swap: significantly and negatively impacted by (略显普通，缺乏法律与审计文本的正式感)
substantially harmed by (substantially 比 materially 略重，且少了一个对立方向的 adversely)

items.en: trades businesses may be apprehensive to invest in technology solutions
items.why: 用 apprehensive 代替普通的 afraid 或 worried，瞬间提升了商业报告的专业感和克制度。中国人写报告容易用 hesitate to 或 afraid of，显得生硬或不够职业。
items.when: 描述客户、市场或管理层对某项新投入或变革心存顾虑时。
items.slot: [...] may be apprehensive to invest in [...]
swap: are hesitant to commit capital to (语气更侧重行动迟缓)
show reluctance in funding (名词形式，不如原句形容词顺畅)

items.en: Since trades businesses tend to devote their resources to serving their customers
items.why: devote... to... 搭配动名词 serving，比单纯用 spend money on 更具画面感，精准表达了企业将核心精力与资金倾斜于主业。中国人常写成 spend time and money on do。
items.when: 解释某主体为何无暇顾及次要事务、资金或精力被主业占满时。
items.slot: Since [...] tend to devote their resources to [...]
swap: As [...] typically channel their capital into [...] (更加偏重资金流向)
Because [...] focus predominantly on [...] (动词变弱，不如原句结构有力)

items.en: they often lack the large IT organizations required to stitch together narrow solutions
items.why: lack 后面直接跟名词短语，并用过去分词短语作后置定语，极为精炼地道。中国人常常会写成 because they do not have large IT organizations which can...
items.when: 分析目标公司或行业缺乏特定内部职能来支撑某项工作时。
items.slot: [...] often lack the [...] required to [...]
swap: they frequently fall short of the [...] needed for [...] (略显口语化)
they do not possess the robust [...] to [...] (句式变长，不如原句干练)

items.en: Our entry point to a typical customer’s business is through our Core product offering
items.why: 用名词 'entry point to' 替代动词 'we enter'，把动作实体化，使得句子的主语稳稳停留在核心资产上。中国学习者常写成 We enter a typical customer's business through...
items.when: 在商业模式或产品矩阵介绍中，描述如何切入客户业务或市场时
items.slot: Our entry point to […] is through […]
swap: We start our service by […] (动词化，失去了商业架构的厚重感)
Our initial access into […] comes via […] (介词搭配稍显繁琐，不如 entry point 精准)

items.en: makes knowing which lead sources are producing inbound calls critical to maximizing our customers’ sales and marketing ROI
items.why: 巧妙利用动名词短语作宾语从句的简化，避免了 'makes it that...' 的冗长，使因果关系紧凑有力。中国人常写成 'makes us know which...' 显得口语化且生硬。
items.when: 在财报或商业报告中分析某个复杂现象如何直接决定某项关键业务指标时套用。
items.slot: makes knowing which […] are producing […] critical to maximizing our […] ROI
swap: ensures that we know which lead sources drive revenue, though it loses the direct adjective complement structure
makes it essential to identify which lead sources generate calls, which sounds slightly more formal but heavier

items.en: assigns a unique phone number to each marketing campaign
items.why: 动宾搭配极具画面感，用词精准克制。中国人容易写成 'gives every campaign a different number'，显得词汇贫乏、缺乏商业报告的专业度。
items.when: 描述企业软件或业务流程具体如何对不同对象进行追踪、标记或分类时套用。
items.slot: assigns a unique […] to each […]
swap: allocates a distinct telephone identifier for every promotional effort, which sounds overly academic
attaches a specific phone contact per campaign, which is less idiomatic for software features

items.en: provides a customer visibility into the effectiveness of each marketing dollar
items.why: 用名词 'visibility into' 代替动词 'sees' 或 'understands'，极具财务和管理报告的风格。中国人常写成 'lets customers see how effective each dollar is'，缺乏专业书面语的厚重感。
items.when: 在财报中阐述产品如何提升客户对业务或成本透明度时套用。
items.slot: provides a customer visibility into the effectiveness of each […]
swap: offers transparency regarding the performance of each marketing dollar, which is slightly more formal
gives customers clear insight into how well each marketing dollar performs, which is a bit more verbose

items.en: any one of which could materially adversely affect our business
items.why: 中国人写正式报告时可能会用“will adversely affect”或“will have a不良影响”，此处用情态动词could表非绝对可能性，副词materially明确影响程度，既体现风险严重性又避免绝对化，符合正式报告的谨慎性要求
items.when: 在正式风险披露、财务报告中描述潜在风险对业务的影响时套用
items.slot: any one of which could materially adversely affect our […]
swap: might significantly negatively impact（语气更委婉，significantly程度略弱于materially）
could have a material adverse effect on（更正式的名词短语结构，适合书面报告）
may adversely affect（语气更弱，体现可能性更低）

items.en: you should read this risk factor summary together with the more detailed discussion
items.why: 中国人写正式报告时可能会用“and”或“along with”连接阅读要求，此处用together with连接，更符合SEC报告的正式书面语风格，明确两个内容的关联，语气更严谨
items.when: 在正式报告中要求读者同时参考两个相关参考内容时套用
items.slot: you should read this […] together with the more detailed discussion of […]
swap: you should read this risk factor summary alongside the more detailed discussion（alongside更侧重并列伴随，语气稍不同）
you should read this risk factor summary in conjunction with the more detailed discussion（in conjunction with更正式，侧重协同关联）
you should read this risk factor summary as well as the more detailed discussion（as well as稍口语化，正式度略低）

items.en: is designed to be secure, fast, reliable, and define the future of the corporate network
items.why: 用几个并列形容词加一个动词原形（define）直接挂在 be 后面，极具产品文案的张力。中国人的直觉常写成 is designed to be secure and to define...，略显拖沓。
items.when: 在财报或招股书描述某项核心技术、产品或架构的目标时套用。
items.slot: is designed to be [secure, fast, reliable], and [define the future of ...]
swap: aims to be secure... (aims 显得语气稍弱，不如 designed 更有主观自信)
functions as a secure... (偏向实际功能，缺乏 strategic vision)

items.en: at-risk journalists, human rights defenders, and civil society organizations
items.why: 中国人写这类群体常误用 in danger 或 dangerous，而 at-risk 是精炼的专业定语，自带机构合规审慎感，且用连字符连接极具商业文本的紧凑感。
items.when: 描述面临威胁、处于弱势或需要合规重点关注的客户、群体或资产时
items.slot: at-risk [...]
swap: vulnerable [...]（语感偏向生理或自然脆弱，不如 at-risk 强调外界威胁环境）
threatened [...]（分词作定语略显累赘，不如 at-risk 规范简练）

items.en: We sell our products under our Enterprise plans directly to customers through our global, technically-oriented inside and field sales teams
items.why: 中国人常写成 sell through 或 use plans，这里用 under our Enterprise plans 极其地道，准确表达了在某种商业方案或价格条款框架下销售，介词 under 比 through 更符合商业合同和财报语境。
items.when: 在财报或商业计划书中描述基于特定服务层级或套餐的销售模式时。
items.slot: We sell our products under our […] directly to customers through our global, […] teams
swap: We provide our offerings via […] — 中文思维直译，显得生硬且缺乏商业正式感。
We market our goods through […] — goods 远不如 products 在科技财报中精准。

items.en: our relationships often start with a portion of the customer’s overall network, security and application needs and expand over time
items.why: 主语用抽象名词 relationships 而不是具体的人，动词 start with 搭配 expand over time，完美勾勒出客户生命周期和交叉销售（cross-selling）的演进过程，中国财务人员常写成 we begin to serve customers with part of their needs。
items.when: 在分析客户粘性、LTV（生命周期价值）或业务拓展路径时。
items.slot: our relationships often start with a portion of the customer’s overall […] needs and expand over time as they […]
swap: our business begins with part of […] — business 范围太模糊，不如 relationships 准确描绘客户绑定度。
our engagement usually commences with […] — commences 过于学术和生硬，不如 start with 自然。

items.en: increase their adoption of our products and services
items.why: 用 adoption（采纳/使用率）来量化客户对产品的深度使用，比单纯用 use 或 buy 更具商业分析质感。中国人常写成 buy more products。
items.when: 在讨论老客户增购、产品渗透率或使用深度时。
items.slot: increase their adoption of our […] and services
swap: increase their use of our […] — use 偏口语化，缺乏财报应有的专业审计厚度。
raise their consumption of our […] — consumption 通常用于能源或原材料，不适合SaaS软件或云服务。

items.en: At the heart of our brand is a passionate and engaged community called the Traegerhood
items.why: 用介词短语前置作表语倒装，既突出核心驱动力，又避免了主谓过长造成的头重脚轻。中国习惯往往写成 Our brand's core is...
items.when: 在商业报告中介绍企业核心资产、核心战略或竞争壁垒时
items.slot: At the heart of our […] is a […] called the […]
swap: Our core is a passionate community... (平铺直叙，失去了倒装带来的强调和高级感)
The central pillar of our brand is... (词汇稍显生硬，不如 at the heart of 生动)

items.en: which includes everyone from casual grillers to competition pitmasters and professional chefs
items.why: 用非限制性定语从句向后无限延展，且内部用 from A to B and C 结构把极端的两端连起来，展现用户画像的广泛性。中国写作者容易写成多个短句。
items.when: 在财报或商业计划书中描述用户群体、产品覆盖范围或生态广度时
items.slot: which includes everyone from […] to […] and […]
swap: It includes various people, such as casual grillers and chefs. (过于碎片化，缺乏气势)
Covering both casual users and professionals... (分词结构不够流畅，无法完美穷尽)

items.en: represented 53.3% and 53.8% of our revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
items.why: 中国人写财报常因语序纠结，而 respectively 放在句尾能极精炼地一一对应两组数据，避免冗长的重复表述。
items.when: 财报或审计报告中对比两年或两类财务指标的占比时
items.slot: represented [...]% and [...]% of our revenue for the year ended December 31, [...] and [...], respectively.
swap: respectively placed at the end to match chronological order
in that order (slightly more conversational, less formal than respectively)

items.en: These grills vary in size, price, construction, materials, and digital technologies.
items.why: 用 vary in 搭配多个名词短语罗列维度，比分别用形容词描述更具专业感和归纳力，避免了中国写作者容易犯的句式单一问题。
items.when: 审计报告或尽调中描述产品线、资产或业务在多维度的差异时
swap: differ across multiple dimensions including [...]
show distinct variations in [...]

items.en: Our accessories represented 24.0% and 26.5% of our revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
items.why: 用 represented 串起百分比和年份，句式极其紧凑。中国人写财报常习惯用占比从句或分开多句写，显得零散，而这里通过 respectively 完美实现了一句对应两年数据的对仗。
items.when: 在财报中表述某类产品、地区或业务对总收入（或成本等）的贡献占比及年度对比时。
items.slot: [...] represented [...]% and [...]% of our [revenue / costs / expenses] for the year ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
swap: accounted for [...]% and [...]% of [...] respectively (动词稍显平淡)
made up [...]% and [...]% of [...] respectively (口语化色彩稍重，不及 represented 正式)

items.en: We offer a variety of grill accessories (including the MEATER smart thermometers, P.A.L. Pop-And-Lock accessory rail, covers, drip trays, bucket liners, storage bins, and shelves)
items.why: 将具体产品名称直接放在括号内的 including 短语中，既能罗列大量细节又不打断主句的流畅度。中国人写长清单往往喜欢用非限制性定语从句，导致句子臃肿头重脚轻。
items.when: 在主句中提及一个大类资产或产品线，需要紧接着列举其具体组成部分时。
items.slot: We offer a variety of [...] (including [...])
swap: such as [...] (放在括号外容易造成主句过长难以阅读)
which include [...] (使用定语从句会让句子显得琐碎)

items.en: is frequently deployed across a customer’s entire infrastructure
items.why: 用 deployed across 替代了散乱的 spread over 或 used in，瞬间把技术软件的渗透率写得极具立体感。中国人在写尽调报告时容易用遍布 across 之外的泛泛词，显得不够科技企业的专业硬核。
items.when: 描述技术、系统、产品在客户业务或基础设施中全面铺开时套用
items.slot: is frequently deployed across a […]'s entire [...]
swap: is widely used throughout a [...]'s [...]
用 throughout 略显平淡，不如 deployed across 有部署落地的厚重感
is fully integrated into a [...]'s [...]
integrated 侧重融合而非铺开，不如 deployed 贴切

items.en: Compared to legacy systems that are often used only by a few users in an organization’s IT operations team
items.why: Compared to 引导的长状语把传统竞品直接比下去，且用 legacy systems 代替 old software 显得极其老道。中国人常写 In contrast, traditional software is..., 略显生硬且缺乏对比的紧凑感。
items.when: 在财报或审计中对比新旧业务模式、传统与现代系统时套用
items.slot: Compared to legacy [...] that are often used only by [...] in an organization’s [...] team
swap: Unlike traditional [...] which are usually used by [...]
Unlike 稍显口语化，Compared to 更符合审计报告的客观语调
In contrast to older [...] used merely by [...]
merely 语气偏酸，often used only by 更客观中立

items.en: is a daily part of the lives of developers, operations engineers and business leaders
items.why: 用 a daily part of the lives 这种具象化表达来描述高频粘性，比抽象的 high user stickiness 更具感染力。中国人习惯用名词化的词组（如 heavy daily usage），写不出这种直击人心的使用场景感。
items.when: 描述某产品或服务已深入目标用户日常生活或工作流时套用
items.slot: is a daily part of the lives of [...], [...] and [...]
swap: serves as a routine tool for [...]
routine tool 偏向冷冰冰的工具属性，lives 更有客户粘性
is heavily utilized daily by [...]
utilize 日常感较弱，不如 daily part of the lives 生动

items.en: a combination of facts and factors currently known by us
items.why: 用 'a combination of facts and factors' 组合拳来为预测背书，严谨且滴水不漏，比单独说 'based on facts' 更有层次。中国人常简写为 'based on known facts'，缺乏防御性。
items.when: 在解释某项估计、预测或判断所依据的复杂基础时套用。
items.slot: a combination of […] and factors currently known by us
swap: based on facts we know（过于口语化，缺乏法律层面的严谨性）
derived from available information（表意过窄，没有涵盖 facts 和 factors）

items.en: may cause our actual results to differ materially from those expressed or implied by our forward-looking statements
items.why: 中国人容易写成 'be very different from'，这里用 'differ materially' 精准表达了审计和财经语境下的『产生重大差异』，副词 'materially' 极具专业感。
items.when: 在财报中提示预测数据与实际结果可能存在重大偏差时套用
items.slot: may cause our actual results to differ materially from those […]
swap: may cause our actual results to vary significantly from [...]（'vary significantly' 口语化更强，财报感略弱）
may cause our actual results to diverge substantially from [...]（'diverge substantially' 偏学术，不如 'differ materially' 常见）

items.en: New risks and uncertainties emerge from time to time
items.why: 中国人常写 'new risks appear sometimes'，而 'emerge from time to time' 完美还原了风险动态涌现的客观规律，显得老练自然。
items.when: 描述行业或经营环境中不断涌现新风险时套用
items.slot: New […] emerge from time to time
swap: New [...] arise periodically（'arise periodically' 稍显生硬，不如 'emerge' 形象）
New [...] crop up from time to time（'crop up' 过于口语化，不适合正式财报）

items.en: it is not possible for us to predict all risks and uncertainties
items.why: 中国人写这类句子常把 we 做主语 'we cannot predict all...'，而用 'it is not possible for us to...' 转移了主语焦点，客观陈述了能力局限，语气更严谨得体。
items.when: 在财报中声明管理层无法完全预知未来风险时套用
items.slot: it is not possible for us to predict all […]
swap: we are unable to foresee all [...]（'unable to foresee' 略显直接，防御性不如原句）
it remains unfeasible for us to anticipate all [...]（'unfeasible' 用词过重且少见）

items.en: who have been billed as of the end of period
items.why: 在定义业务指标（Paying Circle）时，精确使用现在完成时被动语态（have been billed），并用 as of 精准锚定时间截面，确保了财务口径的法律严谨性，防止产生“过去曾付费但期末已失效”的歧义。
items.when: 在定义财务或运营指标（如付费用户、活跃账户）的统计口径和时间范围时使用。
items.slot: who have been billed as of [...]
swap: who paid by the end of the period (主动语态不够准确，无法体现计费系统的账单状态)
that paid up to the period end (用词偏口语化，缺乏审计级定义的严密性)

items.en: designed to foster trust, transparency, and ethical decision-making
items.why: 动词 foster 比用 promote 或 build 更具高级感，精准表达出‘如温床般培育并促成’无形资产的意味。中国人写财报常套用 enhance 或 improve，显得很机械。
items.when: 写公司使命、治理结构、ESG 报告等需要强调无形企业文化建设的段落时
items.slot: designed to foster [...], [...], and [...]
swap: aimed at building [...] (略显普通，缺乏培育生长的动态感)
targeted to promote [...] (偏向官僚化表述，不如 foster 自然)

items.en: This summary should be read in conjunction with the “Risk Factors” section
items.why: 用 'in conjunction with' 替代简单的 'with' 或 'and'，强调前后文件的整体阅读关系，极具法律和审计文件的规范感。
items.when: 提示读者需要结合其他章节或附注共同阅读时套用。
items.slot: This [summary] should be read in conjunction with the [...] section
swap: This should be read together with the section (略显生硬直接)
Please read this with the section (口吻像说明书而非专业报告)

items.en: offering flexible plans that scale with our customers
items.why: 用现在分词短语作状语紧跟前文，省去了冗余的and从句；同时用 scale with our customers 替代了长篇大论的随客户规模增长而调整，极具科技公司财报的精炼感。
items.when: 描述产品特性或定价策略具备动态扩展能力时套用
items.slot: offering [...] that scale with [...]
swap: which offer flexible plans that can grow with our customers (使用了完整的定语从句，略显拖沓)
and we provide flexible plans to meet customers' scale (主谓结构切断了与前文商业模式的紧密连带感)

items.en: ensuring that businesses of all sizes can adopt and expand their use of Amplitude
items.why: 分词作结果状语顺理成章，businesses of all sizes（各规模企业）比写成 small, medium and large enterprises 更加紧凑，adopt and expand（采用与拓展）是SaaS财报高频黄金搭配。
items.when: 总结某项策略带来的最终商业效果或愿景时套用
items.slot: ensuring that [...] can adopt and expand their use of [...]
swap: to make sure that all size companies can use and expand [...] (口语化严重，缺乏SEC文件的正式感)
thereby guaranteeing every business can adopt and scale [...] (guaranteeing语气过重，存在法律合规风险暗示)

items.en: By uncovering bottlenecks in user journeys and identifying features that resonate
items.why: 用名词短语 uncovering bottlenecks 和 identifying features 充当 By 的宾语，动作感强且极具商业说服力。中国财务/审计人员常写成通过发现问题（by finding problems），词汇偏口语化，不够专业严谨。
items.when: 在 SEC 报告的 MD&A 或商业模式章节中，论述公司产品或服务如何为客户创造价值时。
items.slot: By uncovering [...] in [...] and identifying [...] that resonate
swap: Through discovering issues in [...] and spotting features that appeal (用词略显平淡，缺乏专业财报的干练感)
Via revealing blockages in [...] and recognizing elements that fit (介词和动词搭配不够地道)

items.en: will gain competitive advantages, which will help them to adapt to market shifts
items.why: 动宾搭配 gain competitive advantages 比单纯的 win competition 更地道，后接非限制性定语从句层层推进。中国职场人容易写成 will win competition 或 get advantages，显得生硬中式。
items.when: 在论述战略布局、技术投入或市场前景时表达竞争壁垒。
items.slot: will gain [...], which will help them to adapt to [...]
swap: will secure competitive edges, which will assist them in adapting to [...] (edge 偏口语，不如 advantage 正式)
will achieve market benefits, which will enable them to adjust [...] (benefit 词义过宽，不如 advantage 准确)

items.en: can be highly competitive, expensive, and time consuming
items.why: 连续使用三个形容词修饰，且用 highly 增强程度，比中国人只会用 very 或 difficult 显得更加客观且专业。结尾的 time consuming 不用连字符直接并列，地道自然。
items.when: 在描述某项业务、流程或市场环境具有多重挑战时套用。
items.slot: [...] can be highly competitive, expensive, and time consuming
swap: is very difficult and costs much time and money
用了口语化的 very，且结构散乱，缺乏商业文书的精炼感。
tends to be intensely challenging and resource-intensive
用词过于文学化，不如原文直接且符合 SEC 风格。

items.en: without any assurance that such efforts will generate sales or revenue
items.why: 用 without any assurance 完美规避了绝对化表述，精准揭示商业不确定性。中国人在写尽调报告时常写 'maybe cannot make money'，显得极不专业。
items.when: 在揭示某项投入可能无法带来回报的风险时套用。
items.slot: [...] without any assurance that such efforts will generate [...]
swap: with no guarantee of getting money back
用词口语化，get money back 不符合财报正式文体。
hoping that it will make a profit
用 hoping 作为分词状语在法律与审计语境下主观色彩太浓。

items.en: typically expire after some period of time and must be “re-competed.”
items.why: 用 typically 和 expire 精准界定合同生命周期，并创造性地使用 re-competed（重新竞标）这个动词，极其符合审计和尽调中对合同续签风险的专业描述。
items.when: 在描述协议、资质或合同到期需要重新招标时套用。
items.slot: [...] typically expire after some period of time and must be “re-competed.”
swap: will finish soon and need to bid again
finish soon 太口语，bid again 不够正式且漏掉了重新竞标的核心含义。
reach the end of term and require a new tender process
表达虽对，但不如原文用动词 re-competed 简洁有力。

items.en: The inability of any supplier, co-packer, third-party distributor or transportation provider to deliver or perform for us in a timely or cost-effective manner could cause our operating costs to increase and our profit margins to decrease.
items.why: 中国人常写成长句或条件句（If they cannot deliver...），而SEC报告常用名词化结构（The inability of... to...），将主语变成抽象名词，显得客观、紧凑且极具法律文书的严谨感。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中分析供应链中断、供应商违约或关键主体无法履约的风险时使用。
items.slot: The inability of any [...] to [...] in a timely or cost-effective manner could cause our [...] to increase and our [...] to decrease.
swap: If any [...] fails to perform in time, our costs will rise. (口语化，不够正式)
Failure by any [...] to timely execute could lead to increased costs. (略显单薄)

items.en: We must continuously monitor our inventory and product mix against forecasted demand
items.why: 动词搭配精准到位，用 monitor... against... 表达“将实际库存与预测需求进行动态比对与监控”，比单纯的 check 更有专业审计和内控的质感。
items.when: 描述企业对运营指标、预算执行或库存水平进行动态管理和风险控制时使用。
items.slot: We must continuously monitor our [...] against forecasted demand
swap: We need to check our inventory with predicted demand. (with 不如 against 精准表达对抗或比对感)
We should track our stock according to demand forecasts. (track... according to 稍显平淡)

items.en: may reach its expiration date and become unsaleable
items.why: 地道的商业表达，不用口语的 expire 或 go bad，而是用 reach its expiration date 配合 become unsaleable，准确描述资产因过期而丧失商业价值的状态。
items.when: 在尽调中评估存货减值风险、滞销风险或保质期管理时使用。
items.slot: may reach its expiration date and become [...]
swap: may expire and cannot be sold. (expire 略显简单，不够正式)
might become outdated and useless. (outdated 和 useless 不符合快消品或食品行业的专业术语)

items.en: has been adversely impacted in the past by the publicity surrounding
items.why: 用 adversely impacted 代替普通的 affected 或 hurt，显得极有专业规范感；中间插入 in the past 保持时态严谨，比直接用副词开头更地道。
items.when: 描述过去某事受到外部负面事件冲击时。
items.slot: [...] has been adversely impacted in the past by the publicity surrounding [...]
swap: has been badly hurt by - 口语化，缺乏正式财务报告的严肃感。
was negatively affected by - 略显平淡，不如 adversely impacted 精准。

items.en: As a result of extensive global publicity and trade restrictions imposed to provide safeguards against mad cow disease,
items.why: 用名词短语做状语从句的精简替代，避免了用 because clauses 导致句子结构拖沓，极大地增强了因果关系的紧凑度。
items.when: 在解释某一财务或经营结果的直接成因时。
items.slot: As a result of [cause noun phrase], [...]
swap: Because there was extensive global publicity - 显得冗长且不够书面化。
Due to the fact that extensive publicity happened - 典型的中国式冗余句式。

items.en: has from time to time increased significantly and may increase again in the future
items.why: 巧妙结合了表示历史频率的 from time to time 和表示未来的情态动词 may，既陈述了历史波动事实，又规避了绝对预测的法律风险。
items.when: 在披露具有周期性或不确定性成本时进行风险提示。
items.slot: [...] has from time to time increased significantly and may increase again in the future if [...]
swap: often increased and will increase - 语气太绝对，不符合审计中谨慎性原则。
sometimes went up and might go up - 用词偏口语化，不够严谨。

items.en: Our use of transportation services for shipments is subject to risks
items.why: 用 'is subject to' 代替常见的 'faces' 或 'has'，既精准又极其符合法律与财务文书的正式感。中国人在写风控时常直译成 face risks，显得单薄。
items.when: 在财报或审计报告中罗列某项业务、资产或流程面临的潜在风险时。
items.slot: Our use of [...] is subject to risks, including [...]
swap: Our use of [...] faces risks (普通，缺乏正式的契约感)
Our use of [...] is exposed to risks (侧重被动暴露于风险，不如 subject to 精准)

items.en: may impact the ability of providers to provide delivery services
items.why: 巧妙运用名词化结构 'impact the ability of... to do'，比直接用动词 'impair providers from delivering' 显得更加客观且有层次感。中国人写这类句子通常喜欢用 affect providers to deliver，语法不对且不地道。
items.when: 分析外部因素如何限制供应商或管理层执行某项特定任务的能力时。
items.slot: [...] may impact the ability of [...] to [...]
swap: [...] may impair [...] from delivering (直接用动词，但不够正式)
allows [...] to have difficulty in delivering (中式英语，累赘)

items.en: adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations
items.why: 标准的 SEC 财报大结局套话。副词 'adversely' 加动词 'affect' 搭配三大财务要素是标准范式。中国人往往会自创坏词如 influence badly 或 damage finance，极不专业。
items.when: 在风险因素（Risk Factors）结尾总结某不利事件对公司财务和运营的整体冲击时。
items.slot: [...] and thereby adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations
swap: and thereby negatively impact our financial performance (稍显口语化，不够严谨)
and thus hurt our company's business and money (极其口语化，绝对不能出现在报告中)

items.en: could differ materially and adversely from those anticipated or implied in the forward-looking statements
items.why: 中国审计师和分析师写财务负面影响时，最爱用 adversely affect 或者 bad result 这种单一形容词。而原文用 differ materially and adversely（在重大方面产生实质性不利差异），既客观（differ）又精确点出性质（materially and adversely），是标准的法律和审计措辞，显得极具专业素养。
items.when: 在审计报告、尽调报告或风险提示中，描述实际结果与预期或历史数据可能出现重大负面偏差时。
items.slot: actual results could differ materially and adversely from […]
swap: may negatively impact the results - 用 negatively impact 显得比较口语且单薄，缺乏 SEC 文件的严谨性
could be much worse than expected - 用 much worse 则过于主观和非正式，不符合专业公文风格

items.en: are subject to a number of risks, uncertainties and assumptions
items.why: 中国人写“受到……影响”常说 will be affected by 或者是 face many risks。而原文用 are subject to a number of...（受到……的约束/存在……风险），完美避用了弱动词，同时用 a number of 代替 many，既精确表达了风险的多元性，又保持了克制客观的语气。
items.when: 在声明某项预测、资产、计划或估值受到潜在外部不确定性影响时。
items.slot: [… ] are subject to a number of […], including those described in [… ]
swap: will face many risks - 过于口语化，且 will 显得过于绝对，不符合风险提示的防御性要求
are influenced by various factors - 表达太宽泛，不如 subject to 准确传达法定约束和风险敞口

items.en: We market and sell our products through our direct sales force and in partnership with our channel partners
items.why: 中国人常写 sell and promote，这里用 market and sell 涵盖了从市场推广到最终销售的全流程商业动作，动词搭配更精准且符合 SEC 披露规范。
items.when: 描述公司业务模式、产品商业化与分销渠道时。
items.slot: We market and sell our products through [...] and in partnership with [...]
swap: We promote and commercialize our products... (语气更偏向产品生命周期管理，少了一层分销含义)
We distribute and sell our products... (强调物流分销，略去了前端市场开拓)

items.en: designed to engage partners who provide value-added services and extend our reach into the marketplace
items.why: 用 extend our reach 代替简单的 expand our market，形象地表达了触达范围的延伸，比用 expand 显得更有画面感且更地道。
items.when: 解释战略项目、合作伙伴计划或市场扩张的设立目的时。
items.slot: designed to engage partners who provide [...] and extend our reach into [...]
swap: designed to engage partners who provide [...] and expand our market share... (显得过于直接且俗套)
designed to engage partners who provide [...] and increase our market penetration... (偏向学术和定量，不如 reach 生动)

items.en: Our partners typically receive an order from an end customer before placing an order with us
items.why: 精准区分了终端客户下单与渠道商向公司下单的时序，用 typically 做谨慎限定，既符合业务事实又规避了绝对化表述。
items.when: 描述供应链上下游交易流程、订单确认机制或渠道库存政策时。
items.slot: Our partners typically receive an order from [...] before placing an order with [...]
swap: Our partners always get orders from [...] before ordering from [...] (always 太绝对，且 get 比 receive 口语化)
Our partners generally obtain orders from [...] prior to placing orders with [...] (表达偏正式，但不够流畅)

items.en: we are primarily reliant upon our predominant merchant silicon vendor, Broadcom, for our switching chips
items.why: 精妙运用 'reliant upon' 衔接形容词补足语，比直接用动词 rely 更具商务书面语的客观与正式感。中国人写财报常写成 rely on，显得口语化且缺乏力量感。
items.when: 在财务尽职调查中披露供应链或业务对某特定供应商或技术的严重依赖时套用
items.slot: we are primarily reliant upon our predominant […] vendor, […], for our […]
swap: we heavily depend on our primary vendor for chips (缺少财报的正式感，动词显得单薄)
our business is chiefly contingent on this supplier (语气变得过于法律诉约化，不如 reliant upon 自然)

items.en: impose purchase obligations for specific quantities beyond the amounts established in our submitted purchase orders or forecasts
items.why: 用介词短语 'beyond the amounts established in...' 精准修饰限定数量范围，避免了从句的繁琐。中国人常写成 exceed the amount that we submitted，显得啰嗦不够地道。
items.when: 在合同审计或尽调中描述采购承诺、责任边界或金额上限时套用
items.slot: impose purchase obligations for specific quantities beyond the amounts established in our submitted [...]
swap: exceeding the quantities that we stated in purchase orders (分词短语结构松散，不如 established 精准)
more than what is in our forecasts (口语化严重，完全不符合专业财经英文规范)

items.en: representing an $8 billion increase over the topline in the President’s DoW budget request
items.why: 使用现在分词短语作结果状语，精准衔接具体的金额变动和对比基准。中国人写财务分析时常另起新句 The amount represents...，割裂了逻辑上的因果承接关系。
items.when: 在财报或审计报告中描述预算、收入或成本的同比、环比变动及超出预算的金额时
items.slot: representing an [...] increase over [...]
swap: which represents an [...] increase compared to [...] (使用定语从句，略显拖沓)
showing an [...] increase against [...] (showing 动词色彩不够专业)

items.en: providing funding for the government through the end of the government’s FY26, including authority for defense accounts
items.why: 用现在分词短语挂载法案的具体效力和涵盖范围，结构紧凑且信息密度高。中国人常写成 and it provides funding...，缺乏专业财经英文的高效和简洁度。
items.when: 描述某项拨款法案、合同或协议的资金覆盖期限及具体授权范围时
items.slot: providing funding for [...] through [...], including [...]
swap: which provides funding for [...] until [...] and includes [...] (用并列句削弱了法律条文的严密性)
to fund [...] through [...] along with [...] (结构松散，不适合正式披露)

items.en: While the majority of our revenue is derived from the U.S. government
items.why: 用 the majority of 替代大而无当的 most，显得定量更精确。中国人常写成 most of our revenue come from，主谓一致和词汇丰富度都不及此句地道。
items.when: 在财务报告或审计底稿中描述某类收入、资产或成本占比最高时套用
items.slot: While the majority of our […] is derived from the […], we have […]
swap: over half of our revenue is derived from (强调刚过半，不如 majority 气势宏大)
substantially all of our revenue is derived from (强调几乎全部，比 majority 程度更深)

items.en: we have a diverse business mix within the U.S. government funding
items.why: 把业务多样化抽象为名词词组 a diverse business mix，使句子从动词主导转向名词主导，符合专业英文报告的严谨、书面化风格。中国人容易写成 our business is diverse。
items.when: 分析公司业务组合、收入来源或风险分散情况时套用
items.slot: we have a diverse business mix within the […]
swap: our business operations are highly diversified (用形容词，略显口语化和直白)
we maintain a broad portfolio of businesses (强调资产或业务组合的广度，语义略有不同)

items.en: Currently, no single contract represented more than 10% of our revenues
items.why: 用 no single contract 加上否定句式来强调集中度风险极低，比正面去说 every contract is small 要自然得多。中国人常写成 any single contract does not exceed，否定前置容易产生歧义。
items.when: 披露客户集中度、供应商依赖度或单项资产占比限制时套用
items.slot: Currently, no single […] represented more than […]% of our […]
swap: every single contract accounted for less than 10% of our revenues (正面表述，不如否定句式具有强调效果)
no individual contract exceeded 10% of our revenues (动词换成 exceeded，简洁但换掉了原词)

items.en: Our actual results may differ significantly from any results expressed or implied by any forward-looking statements.
items.why: 用 differ significantly 替代简单的 differ，副词加得恰到好处，既表达了差异之大，又保留了前瞻性陈述的不确定性，中国人常写成 vary greatly 或 change a lot。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调报告中提示预测数据与实际结果可能存在重大偏差时。
items.slot: Our actual results may differ significantly from any results expressed or implied by any [...]
swap: vary substantially (略显生硬)
diverge markedly (文学色彩太浓，不适合SEC文本)

items.en: The following is only a summary of the principal risks that may materially adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
items.why: 用 materially adversely 连用作副词修饰动词短语，精准限定了负面影响的法律级别（即必须达到‘重大且不利’的标准），中国人常写成 badly affect 或 negatively influence。
items.when: 在法律文件、尽调报告或财务风险提示中描述某事项对公司的严重负面影响时。
items.slot: The following is only a summary of the principal risks that may materially adversely affect our [...].
swap: significantly harm (少了一个维度，不够严谨)
seriously impact (impact 作动词在SEC风格中不如 affect 正式)

items.en: for a given fiscal year is calculated using
items.why: 精妙地用给定的特定期间（a given...）限定计算范围，比中国人在写财报时爱用的 for this year 显得客观、严谨且具普遍适用性。
items.when: 在定义某一年份或周期的财务指标、计算公式时。
items.slot: for a given […] is calculated using […]
swap: for the fiscal year (语气确定，缺乏灵活性)
in this year (口语化，不够正式)

items.en: the quotient obtained by dividing (a) the revenue generated by the base cohort in the second year of measurement by (b) the revenue generated by the base cohort in the first year of measurement
items.why: 将数学计算过程完全名词化（the quotient obtained by dividing A by B），避免了中国人在写作时习惯用动词句“we divide A by B”的流水账式表达，极具 SEC 文件的专业规范感。
items.when: 在财务报告、审计报告或估值模型中定义复杂的比例、增长率或比率计算逻辑时。
items.slot: the quotient obtained by dividing (a) […] by (b) […]
swap: calculated by dividing A by B (结构较平淡，缺少名词词组的厚重感)
the result of A divided by B (略显口语化，不够严谨)

items.en: the population of clients that were using our services
items.why: 用 population 来指代统计学意义上的客户群体，比泛泛而谈的 clients 显得精准、严密，具备审计和精算视角的专业度。
items.when: 在界定统计样本、客户留存群组（cohort）或特定用户范围时。
items.slot: the population of […] that were [...]
swap: the group of clients (过于日常，缺乏学术或审计严谨性)
all clients (范围太宽泛，无法体现 cohort 的筛选含义)

items.en: The TaskUs platform is purpose-built and organized around three service offerings
items.why: 精妙的复合形容词 purpose-built 瞬间拉高了技术与商业架构的专业感，比用 designed for 或 made for 显得更有针对性和高级感。中国人写作容易堆砌普通形容词，而母语者倾向用这种带连字符的复合词来体现系统化设计
items.when: 在介绍自家产品、业务架构、技术平台或资产配置专为某种目的而设计时套用
items.slot: The [...] platform is purpose-built and organized around [...]
swap: The [...] platform is specifically designed for [...] and organized around [...] (稍显冗长，缺乏原版的利落感)
The [...] platform is custom-made for [...] and organized around [...] (custom-made 偏向硬件或大众消费品，不如 purpose-built 适合企业级平台)

items.en: Digital Customer Experience, Trust & Safety and Artificial Intelligence Services represented 56%, 26% and 18%, respectively, of our total service revenue
items.why: 用 represented... respectively of 清晰、紧凑地把三个并列主体的占比交代清楚，动词和 respectively 的位置极其标准。中国人写这种多项占比时容易写成冗长的从句或者句式散乱，而英文财报习惯用单一动词加 respectively 一气呵成
items.when: 在财务报告中罗列多个业务板块、产品线或客户群体的收入、成本占比时套用
items.slot: [...], [...] and [...] represented [...], [...] and [...], respectively, of our total [...]
swap: [..., ..., and ...] accounted for [..., ..., and ...] of our total ..., respectively (用 accounted for 也是对的，但原版的 represented 更具正式财务报表的客观陈述感)
The revenue share of [...], [...] and [...] was [...], [...] and [...], respectively (句式被动且不够干练，不如原版主动态势强)

items.en: compared to 61%, 25% and 14%, respectively, of our total service revenue of $995.0 million
items.why: 极其地道的对比写法，用 compared to 引导上一年度的百分比和绝对金额，省略了重复的动词，通过 respectively 与前期数据一一对应。中国人写同比常写成完整的主谓宾从句，导致句子臃肿，而这里用介词短语顺畅过渡
items.when: 在财务对比、同比分析（YoY）中，需要同时对比结构占比和绝对金额大小时套用
items.slot: compared to [...], [...] and [...], respectively, of our total [...] of [...]
swap: which compares to [...], [...] and [...], respectively, of our total [...] of [...] (加上了 which 显得拖泥带水，不如直接用分词或介词短语简洁)
while [...] for the previous year were [...], [...] and [...], respectively (切断了与前文主句的紧密连贯性，对比感减弱)

items.en: leveraging Blend as a unified platform to streamline processes
items.why: 中国人常写成 using Blend to make processes fast。原文用 leveraging... as... 展现了“杠杆化利用”资源的高级感，后面接动词不定式做目的状语极为干练
items.when: 描述客户如何使用产品、资源配置或降本增效时套用
items.slot: leveraging […] as a unified platform to streamline processes
swap: utilizing […] to simplify workflows (utilizing 偏硬，simplify 不如 streamline 专业)
using […] for process optimization (名词化后显得生硬，不如动宾短语有行动力)

items.en: In order to provide focus and increase our ability to win
items.why: 用 provide focus 和 increase ability to win 替代了口语化的 'to make it clear and win more'，极具SEC财报的高管说服力。
items.when: 在解释某项组织架构调整或资源分配的战略意图时使用。
items.slot: In order to provide focus and increase our ability to [win], we [orient our sales workforce]...
swap: To concentrate our efforts and improve win rates (偏口语化，不够正式)
For the purpose of focusing and winning more business (表达略显累赘)

items.en: we expect competition to increase as our competitors invest more
items.why: 使用 'expect... to...' 配合连词 'as'，既表达了对未来的预测（前瞻性），又给出了合理的逻辑支撑（伴随竞争对手加大投入）。中国人在写风险提示时往往直接说 'competition will increase'，显得绝对且缺乏依据。
items.when: 在风险因素或管理层讨论（MD&A）中预测行业趋势并给出原因时套用。
items.slot: we expect [...] to increase as [...]
swap: anticipate heightened competition driven by [...] (更加正式和精炼)
foresee a surge in market rivalry as [...] (文学色彩过强，不适合 SEC 风格)

items.en: to the extent we believe it would be beneficial and cost-effective
items.why: 中国人常写 if necessary，显得太绝对且口语化。用 to the extent 能够极其精准地限定条件和范围，既有法律严谨性又显得专业。
items.when: 在财报或合同中限定某项行动的实施条件或边界时使用。
items.slot: to the extent we believe it would be [...]
swap: if we think it is good and cheap (中文: 用词极其幼稚，缺乏商务正式感)
whenever it is helpful (中文: 过于笼统，无法表达成本效益的权衡)

items.en: we may be subject to claims that our technology or services infringe or misappropriate the intellectual property rights of others
items.why: 中国人描述面临诉讼时常说 we may face lawsuits，而原句用 subject to claims 更加地道且符合法律文书的客观、被动语调，语气更具防御性。
items.when: 在审计底稿或风险披露中提示潜在法律纠纷或侵权指控时使用。
items.slot: we may be subject to claims that [...]
swap: others might sue us for infringement (中文: 主动语态太强，且用 sue 显得不够专业和书面)
we could face legal issues regarding IP (中文: legal issues 范围模糊，不如 claims 精准)

items.en: While approximately 97% of our revenue is derived from transporting LTL shipments
items.why: 用 while 引导让步状语从句精准界定主营业务占比，既肯定了核心优势，又为下文补充其他业务留出空间，approximately 展现了严谨的审计措辞习惯
items.when: 在描述某项业务、资产或收入占总体的绝大部分比例，同时需要提及长尾或多元化业务时
items.slot: While approximately […] of our [revenue/costs] is derived from […],
swap: Although about […]（about 不如 approximately 严谨，且通常用于估算）
Even though roughly […]（roughly 显得不够专业）

items.en: invested in excess of $2.5 billion in capital expenditures
items.why: 用 'in excess of' 代替常见的 'more than'，显得更加正式和具有财务专业度。中国学习者常机械使用 'more than' 或 'over'，显得口语化。
items.when: 在财报或审计报告中描述大额资金投入、资产规模或时间跨度超过某个基数时。
items.slot: invested in excess of […] in capital expenditures
swap: exceeding $2.5 billion (更简练但缺少了介词短语的缓冲节奏)
more than $2.5 billion (过于口语化，缺乏正式财报的严谨感)

items.en: expanding our footprint in both new and existing markets in order to be closer to our customers and position us to gain market share
items.why: 采用 'in order to + 动词原形并列' 的结构，层层递进地解释战略行为背后的商业目的（贴近客户 + 获取份额），逻辑严密。中国学习者常写成破碎的短句或滥用简单连词 'because'。
items.when: 在阐述企业战略举措及其背后的商业动机和长远布局时。
items.slot: expanding our footprint in […] in order to be closer to […] and position us to […]
swap: so that we can be closer to (从句结构略显啰嗦，不如动词不定式紧凑)
to be closer to (直接省去 in order，虽然精炼但目的性稍弱)

items.en: resulting in improved fuel efficiency, enhanced safety features and reduced carbon emissions
items.why: 用现在分词短语 'resulting in' 作结果状语，优雅地将前文的投入转化为具体成效，避免了写成两个独立分句的生硬。中国学习者往往会用 'which leads to' 导致句式拖沓。
items.when: 在财报中总结某项投资或运营举措所带来的多重正面结果时。
items.slot: resulting in improved […], enhanced […] and reduced […]
swap: which has resulted in (加上了时态和主谓，但不如分词短语干练)
leading to better (用词不够正式，'leading' 略显泛滥)

items.en: generated revenue of $3.2 billion and operating income of $352.2 million
items.why: 用动词 generate 搭配具体财务指标（revenue / operating income），显得动作感强且客观；中国人写财报常习惯用“achieved”或系动词“was”，不如它干练、地道。
items.when: 在年报、业绩发布会或尽调报告中总结特定年度的营收和利润表现时。
items.slot: generated revenue of [...] and operating income of [...]
swap: realized revenue of [...] (略显夸张，通常用于投资收益)
achieved revenue of [...] (略带主观努力色彩，不如 generate 客观)

items.en: compared to revenue of $3.2 billion and operating income of $482.2 million in 2024
items.why: 采用简洁的介词短语 compared to 引导对比，省去了从句，使长句对比更加紧凑；中国人容易写成冗长的“which was compared with...”。
items.when: 在财务正文中将当年业绩与上年同期进行横向对比时。
items.slot: compared to revenue of [...] and operating income of [...] in [...]
swap: as compared with [...] (略显冗长、书卷气过重)
versus [...] (过于口语化，不适合正式财报)

items.en: traveled an average distance of approximately 897 miles
items.why: 用 traveled 搭配具体距离，并用副词 approximately 进行严谨的模糊修饰，兼顾了业务描述的生动与专业；中国人常死板地用“the average distance was...”。
items.when: 在运营数据、物流指标或资产使用情况的描述中。
items.slot: traveled an average distance of approximately [...] miles
swap: covered an average distance of [...] (搭配合理，但少了个约数修饰词不够严谨)
the average distance was [...] miles (变成主系表结构，句式生硬呆板)

items.en: This element of our business strategy focuses on optimizing
items.why: 用 'focuses on optimizing' 动宾结构比中国人常写的 'is to optimize' 更有动感和专业度，主语直接锁定具体战略要素，行文紧凑。
items.when: 在年报中阐述某项业务举措或战略重点时套用
items.slot: This element of our business strategy focuses on optimizing [...]
swap: is dedicated to optimizing（略显冗长且感情色彩过重）
aims at the optimization of（名词化后显得生硬死板）

items.en: In addition to organic expansion through new terminal openings
items.why: 中国人写递进喜欢用 besides 或 what's more，而 in addition to 后面接动名词短语作为介词宾语，重心稳妥且能瞬间把焦点引向主句的主体战略。
items.when: 在既定主营动作之外，补充说明另一条并行路径时
items.slot: In addition to [...] through [...], we may [...]
swap: Besides organic growth (besides 略带口语色彩，不够严谨)
Apart from internal expansion (apart from 常用于口语或排除法，不如 in addition to 正式)

items.en: the timing of the revenue, earnings and cash flows
items.why: 用名词短语 'the timing of...' 代替动词从句，既紧凑又符合审计报告的专业排比节奏。中国人常习惯写成 'when the revenue, earnings and cash flows happen'，显得冗长且口语化。
items.when: 在财务报告或审计底稿中描述某类指标的发生时间或节奏时
items.slot: the timing of the […]
swap: when the [...] occur (动词化结构，不如名词短语紧凑严谨)
the schedule for [...] (更偏向进度表，不如 timing 贴切)

items.en: can be delayed by a number of factors
items.why: 用被动语态加 'a number of factors' 引出原因，客观且留有余地。中国人容易写成 'may be delayed because of many factors'，显得词汇贫乏、缺乏商业正式感。
items.when: 在分析财务数据波动或项目延误原因时
items.slot: can be delayed by a number of factors, including […]
