swap: may be postponed due to several reasons (postponed 多指主观推迟，不如 delayed 准确)
might be impacted by various causes (various 略显空洞，不如 a number of factors 具体)

items.en: As part of our business, we are a party to joint ventures
items.why: 用介词短语 As part of our business 开篇顺畅自然地引入业务背景，比中国学习者常写的 We do business by doing... 显得更地道、更具官方财报的正式感。
items.when: 在财务报告中需要交代某项常规业务、衍生安排或附带活动时用。
items.slot: As part of our business, we are a party to [...]
swap: In the course of our operations, we participate in [...] (语气更偏向日常运营)
As an element of our commercial activities, we engage in [...] (用词过分冗长沉重)

items.en: pursuant to which we typically jointly bid on and execute particular projects
items.why: 用介词加关系代词 pursuant to which 连接复杂从句，精准替代了口语化的 according to which 或冗余的 and under this，极大地提升了合同与审计报告的法律严密性。
items.when: 在描述依据某项协议、合同或安排来开展具体行动时用。
items.slot: [...] pursuant to which we typically [...]
swap: under which we typically [...] (较为简练，但少了一点法律依据的正式感)
according to which we usually [...] (according to 显得不够专业和正式)

items.en: Success on these joint projects depends upon managing the risks
items.why: 主语直接接 depends upon managing 动名词结构，言简意赅地指出成败系于风险管控。中国学习者往往容易写成 depend on how well we manage，显得拖沓繁琐。
items.when: 在分析业务成败、业绩好坏或项目结果的决定因素时用。
items.slot: Success on these [...] depends upon managing [...]
swap: Success on these [...] relies on the management of [...] (名词化后稍显僵硬)
Whether these [...] succeed depends on if we manage [...] (if 从句显得口语化且结构松散)

items.en: represent a substantial portion of our consolidated revenue and gross margin
items.why: 用 represent... 代替占比例的表达显得极具专业度，避免了中国人在写财报时爱用的 account for 或 make up 的口语化倾向。
items.when: 描述某家大客户或某项业务在总收入、利润中占比很高时套用。
items.slot: represent a substantial portion of our […]
swap: account for a large share of [...] (更偏口语，不够正式严肃)
make up the majority of [...] (语气过于绝对，不如 substantial 准确)

items.en: a default or delay in payment on a significant scale by a customer
items.why: 将行为名词化（default or delay in payment）并用 on a significant scale 修饰，比写动词短语（when customers fail to pay or delay payments heavily）显得严谨且有法律质感。
items.when: 审计或尽调中描述客户大面积违约或拖欠款项的情形时套用。
items.slot: a default or delay in payment on a significant scale by […]
swap: massive payment delays by [...] (表达不够正式，像是新闻报道风格)
customers failing to pay on time [...] (主谓结构太口语，不如名词短语紧凑)

items.en: We maintain insurance coverage as part of our overall risk management strategy
items.why: 用 maintain 代替一般的 buy 或 have，既专业又体现出持续合规的动作。中国人在写投保时常说 buy insurance，显得口语化。
items.when: 在财报或尽调报告中描述公司持续性政策、合规动作或风险管理措施时。
items.slot: We maintain […] as part of our overall risk management strategy
swap: We hold insurance policies (稍显平淡，缺乏 maintain 的持续运营感)
We procure insurance coverage (侧重于采购动作，不及 maintain 稳健)

items.en: could have an adverse impact on our ability to procure new work
items.why: 标准且极具说服力的风险揭示句型，用 adverse impact 代替坏影响，比口语的 affect 更有SEC文风。中国写作者常直译为 badly influence。
items.when: 在审计和财报中评估负面因素对业务、流动性或合同获取能力的影响时。
items.slot: could have an adverse impact on our ability to […]
swap: could negatively affect our ability to (略显普通，不如 adverse impact 正式)
would severely impair our capacity to (语气过重，不够客观中立)

items.en: which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows
items.why: 资本市场标准的财务法律风险兜底句式，并列四项精准专业。中国人写财报往往只写 affect our business，漏掉 financial condition 等固定四件套。
items.when: 在尽调报告、法律文件中总结某项风险对整个公司的实质性综合损害时。
items.slot: which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and […]
swap: which might heavily damage our financial status (用词非标准财报术语)
which could seriously harm our overall performance (过于主观且不规范)

items.en: have a material adverse effect on our results of operations or financial condition
items.why: 国人常写成 bad influence，显得非常业余和口语化。而 material adverse effect 是美股财报和法律合同中最标准、最精准的词块，用 material 替代 big，用 adverse 替代 bad，瞬间建立起专业严肃的合规文风。
items.when: 在审计报告、尽调报告或合同中描述某事对财务、声誉或运营造成重大负面影响时。
items.slot: have a material adverse effect on [...]
swap: cause significant negative impacts to (略显冗长且不够地道)
lead to severe financial damage (用词过于情绪化，缺乏法律文件的严谨性)

items.en: Investments in immature businesses with unproven track records
items.why: 用 immature businesses 替代 early-stage companies 或 new small companies，生动传达出标的不成熟、抗风险能力差的状态；搭配 unproven track records（未经验证的业绩记录）比用 no history 更有审计专业的画面感。
items.when: 在评估初创公司、新业务线或缺乏历史数据标的之风险时。
items.slot: Investments in [...] with unproven track records
swap: Investing in new companies without history (平淡且缺乏商业质感)
Funding early-stage startups (侧重点在于初创，未能准确传达不成熟与无业绩记录的风险)

items.en: diminish our capital resources and liquidity or limit our ability
items.why: 国人容易用 reduce money 或 hurt cash，而 diminish 带有‘逐渐削减、耗尽’的精准财务语感，capital resources and liquidity 则是规范的资产负债表表述，显得表达极具说服力。
items.when: 分析某项资本开支、并购或大额支出对企业现金流和资金链挤压影响时。
items.slot: diminish our [...] and liquidity or limit our ability
swap: reduce our cash and financial flexibility (表达偏口语，金融正式感不足)
drain our available funds (drain 语气过重，通常用于危机爆发时)

items.en: to be unable to successfully execute all or part of our strategy
items.why: all or part of 穷尽了全部与部分，successfully execute 增强了动词张力。中国学习者常写成 fail to carry out our strategy，显得单薄。
items.when: 评估战略落地、计划实施或整合重组存在失败可能时
items.slot: to be unable to successfully execute all or part of our […]
swap: to fail in the full or partial execution of our […] 偏书面化且略显沉重
to fall short in executing portions of our […] 强调效果未达预期

items.en: The core of our growth strategy centers around increasing physical and digital availability of our products
items.why: 用 centers around 替代了沉闷的 focuses on，显得生动且地道；中国人在写商业战略时常过度使用 centered on 或 focus on，缺乏这种动词短语的活力。
items.when: 在财报、商业计划书或尽调报告中描述核心战略或业务重心时。
items.slot: The core of our […] strategy centers around increasing […] of our […], including through […]
swap: focuses primarily on expanding (略显平庸，缺乏 centers around 的动态感)
is anchored in driving (语气更为正式厚重，强调战略支柱)

items.en: building a purpose-driven brand with deep connection to the community
items.why: 通过 purpose-driven 和 deep connection 两个复合/修饰结构，把抽象的品牌建设写得极具画面感和说服力；中国人通常会写成 building a brand with a purpose which connects deeply，显得冗长呆板。
items.when: 在描述品牌定位、ESG 理念或客户忠诚度战略时。
items.slot: Building a purpose-driven […] with deep connection to the […] we serve
swap: establishing a mission-focused brand closely tied to consumers (mission-focused 略显生硬，不如 purpose-driven 流行)
developing a values-led brand with strong community ties (values-led 语气稍有不同，侧重价值观)

items.en: which builds upon our original Transformation Pillars of Brand Maximization, Margin Enhancement and Operating Discipline
items.why: 用 builds upon 代替了普通的 based on 或 develops，生动传达出在现有战略基石上‘迭代、叠加并向上构建’的动态感，比中国职场英语爱用的 based on 显得更有层次。
items.when: 在财报或战略规划中，描述新计划、新项目是在原有成果或战略支柱上延伸时套用。
items.slot: which builds upon our original [...] of [...], [...] and [...]
swap: which is based on our original...（过于平淡，缺乏进阶感）
which extends our previous...（表达直接，但不如 builds upon 贴切）

items.en: Powering Honest Growth is aimed at improving simplicity, focus and profitability
items.why: 将项目名称 Powering Honest Growth 直接作主语，比用 We aim to... 显得更加客观和宏观，符合标准财务英文中‘计划/战略自身在推动变革’的去主体化叙事风格。
items.when: 在介绍某项内部重大转型计划或项目的宏观目标时套用。
items.slot: [...] is aimed at improving [...], [...] and [...]
swap: We aim to improve simplicity...（主语是人，偏口语化，不够正式）
The goal of this initiative is to improve...（稍显冗长，不如直接用项目名作主语干练）

items.en: have the potential to change entire industries and how products are made
items.why: 用 have the potential to 比直接用 can 更具商业文件的谨慎与专业感，避免了绝对化表述，中国人在写报告时常直译为 can 显得单一且生硬。
items.when: 在财务报告中描述某项技术、战略或趋势具有发展潜力和颠覆性影响时。
items.slot: have the potential to [...]
swap: are capable of changing (更侧重客观能力，但略显生硬)
may change (语气过于直接，缺乏商业文件的严谨度)

items.en: Our commitment to environmental mindfulness shows up through our product development, packaging processes and in many parts of our business on a daily basis
items.why: 用 shows up through 替代常见的 is reflected in 或 appears in，使抽象的承诺（commitment）显得生动且落地，中国学习者常套用 is shown in 显得口语化不足。
items.when: 在阐述公司的某种战略、承诺或价值观如何在具体业务日常中得以践行时。
items.slot: Our commitment to [...] shows up through [...]
swap: is reflected in (较为书面化且常规，缺乏动感)
manifests itself in (过于学术和沉重，不适合日常消费品财报)

items.en: we are regularly looking to increase the amount of post-consumer resin in our components
items.why: 用 are regularly looking to 表达持续改进的动态过程，比单纯用 plan to 或 want to 显得更有行动力和前瞻性，中国人在写计划时习惯用词较为主观或呆板。
items.when: 管理层在讨论对环保、技术迭代或供应链优化的持续性追求时。
items.slot: we are regularly looking to [...]
swap: continually plan to (动词 plan 显得较为静态)
intend to (意图表达偏弱，缺乏积极进取的动态感)

items.en: reported net income available to common shareholders of
items.why: 中国人常写成 'announced that the net income was...' 显得拖沓。用过去分词 reported 直接引导核心财务指标，后面接介词短语作定语，紧凑且符合 SEC 披露惯例。
items.when: 财报业绩发布、审计报告或尽调摘要中首次披露核心利润指标时。
items.slot: reported net income available to common shareholders of […]
swap: announced net income available to common shareholders of (语气更偏向公关通告，不及 reported 严谨)
posted a net income available to common shareholders of (偏向新闻报道体，正式财报少用)

items.en: reflecting criticized and classified loan resolutions throughout the year as well as a favorable portfolio mix shift
items.why: 用现在分词短语作状语直接引出变动原因，不仅省去了 'which reflects...' 的主谓结构，还用 'as well as' 并列两个驱动因素，极为紧凑。中国财务人员常写成独立句子 'This reflects...'，导致行文琐碎。
items.when: 解释某项财务指标（如比率、余额）下降或上升的底层原因时套用
items.slot: reflecting […] throughout the year as well as […]
swap: driven by […] and […] - 偏向被动，不如 reflecting 主动说明披露主体的归因视角
which reflects [...] - 变成了定语从句，拖沓冗长

items.en: We aim to differentiate ourselves from other PEOs in three substantive areas.
items.why: 用 aim to 替代普通的 try to，显得公司战略有方向感、有蓄谋而非盲目尝试。中国人常写成 we try to make our company different，显得口语化且缺乏商业气势。
items.when: 在 10-K 的业务概述、战略规划或管理层讨论（MD&A）中陈述公司核心定位时。
items.slot: We aim to differentiate ourselves from other [...] in [number] substantive areas.
swap: We strive to distinguish our offerings from [...] in several key dimensions. (词汇更丰富，强调努力程度)
Our strategy is focused on setting ourselves apart from competitors in [...] (用名词主语替代动词，偏向宏观陈述)

items.en: The transition from our prior HRIS offering to our ASO offering in 2025 resulted in increased attrition from our prior HRIS population
items.why: 中国人写因果时喜欢用动词 lead to 或直接用 cause，而美股财报高频使用 result in + 名词化结构（increased attrition），显得客观且书面化，避免了情绪化动词
items.when: 财报分析业务调整或产品迭代带来的负面影响时
items.slot: The transition from our prior […] to our new […] resulted in increased attrition from our prior […]
swap: led to higher churn rates（用 churn 显得口语化且不够正式）
caused customer loss（用 customer loss 不够准确，没体现出原有客户群流失的专有名词 attrition）

items.en: These losses were partially offset by an increase in clients for our ASO services
items.why: 财报中解释财务或业务数据变动时，对冲（offset）是高频逻辑。中国人常说 but also increased，而 offset 准确表达了双向对冲的净影响
items.when: 解释某项业务指标下滑，但被另一项增长部分抵消时
items.slot: These [losses / decreases] were partially offset by an increase in [clients / revenue] for our […] services
swap: were balanced by growth（balanced 语气偏中性，没体现出主动抵消的财报质感）
were made up by more customers（made up 属于明显的口语短语，不适合正式财报）

items.en: help our clients navigate many of the administrative, regulatory and practical requirements associated with being employers
items.why: 用 navigate 代替一般的 handle 或 deal with，生动地表达出“引导客户穿梭/应对错综复杂的合规与行政要求”，极具专业服务业的画面感。中国人写财报常滥用 handle。
items.when: 写商业模式中如何协助客户解决复杂合规、税务或监管挑战时
items.slot: help our clients navigate many of the […] requirements associated with being [...]
swap: help our clients deal with... (动词过于口语化，缺乏专业顾问的高级感)
assist our clients in addressing... (稍显生硬，不如 navigate 形象)

items.en: We do this by incorporating our knowledge and experience into our services and our technology platforms
items.why: 用 By doing sth. 清晰且结构化地解释“如何”实现前文所述的商业目标，主谓宾后紧跟具体实现路径。中国人往往喜欢用分词短语倒装，导致主句过长。
items.when: 在阐述公司商业模式、产品功能或服务交付机制时
items.slot: We do this by incorporating our […] into our […] and our [...]
swap: Through the incorporation of... (名词化后使句子变得晦涩呆板)
This is achieved via... (被动语态削弱了服务提供商的主动担当)

items.en: ranging from call center support to pooled HR resources
items.why: 用分词短语 ranging from... to... 精准限定服务层级的广度与跨度，干净利落。中国人写范围时常写成 from A and to B 或者用长句解释，不如分词短语修饰自然。
items.when: 描述产品功能、服务套餐、收费标准或业务范围存在多层次差异时
items.slot: ranging from [...] to [...]
swap: which range from... (加上了定语从句，显得冗余)
varying between... and... (表达范围时不如 ranging from 常见和地道)

items.en: the Company believes it is well-positioned to continue to adapt to increased competition
items.why: 用 'well-positioned to do' 形容公司处于有利地位去应对变化，比生硬地写 'has the ability to' 或 'is ready to' 显得专业且富有商业感。
items.when: 在财报中描述公司有能力应对外部挑战、新法规或市场竞争时。
items.slot: [...] believes it is well-positioned to continue to [...]
swap: is capable of continuing to adapt - 过于口语且缺乏气势
has a good position to adapt - 语法略显生硬，不如 well-positioned 地道

items.en: principally due to its experience in the market, well-known brand, low-cost operations, expansive marketing system and product expertise
items.why: 用 'principally due to' 替代常见的 'mainly because'，后面紧跟一连串并列的名词短语，高度精炼地罗列了核心竞争优势，符合审计和尽调报告客观严谨的文风。
items.when: 在分析某项业务成功、业绩增长或市场领先原因时。
items.slot: [...] principally due to its [...], [...], and [...]
swap: mostly because of - 显得比较随意，不符合正式财报风格
largely driven by - 强调由外部因素驱动，不如 principally due to 适合归因自身优势

items.en: the continued development and maintenance of operating efficiencies
items.why: 连续使用抽象名词 'development and maintenance' 替代动词，将动作名词化，使句子更加紧凑、书面化和客观，是中国人写报告时容易忽略的高级名词化结构。
items.when: 在讨论公司长期战略、成本控制或内部管理持续推进时。
items.slot: the continued development and maintenance of [...]
swap: continuously developing and maintaining - 动名词形式略显啰嗦，不及名词词组庄重
keeping on developing and maintaining - 口语化严重，绝对不能用于正式报告

items.en: Aflac Japan's SMR is sensitive to interest rate, credit spread and foreign exchange rate changes.
items.why: 用 'is sensitive to' 替代了中国财务人员常写的 'is easily affected by'，精准且极具专业质感，将复杂的市场风险暴露精炼为一个学术与商业通用的形容词短语。
items.when: 在财报中描述资产、负债或资本充足率对宏观经济变量（如利率、汇率）的风险敞口时套用。
items.slot: [...] is sensitive to interest rate, credit spread and foreign exchange rate changes.
swap: is easily affected by interest rate changes (用词过于口语化，缺乏财报的严谨性)
has significant exposure to interest rate fluctuations (语气偏重，不够客观中性)

items.en: measures the Company has taken to mitigate the sensitivity of Aflac Japan's SMR
items.why: 巧妙使用省略关系代词的定语从句（the Company has taken），将动词短语浓缩为名词修饰语，比写成 'measures that the Company has taken' 更简练精干。
items.when: 在论述管理层应对某种风险、挑战或监管要求所采取的行动时套用。
items.slot: measures the Company has taken to mitigate the sensitivity of [...]
swap: actions which the Company took in order to reduce... (which 显冗余，in order to 拖沓)
steps implemented by the Company for mitigating... (结构略显生硬)

items.en: given the profitability erosion some major medical carriers are facing
items.why: 用 given 开头引出背景，并将 profitability erosion（盈利侵蚀）作主干名词，极其干练地把复杂的市场状况压缩成一个介词短语。中国写作者常习惯用长句 As some major medical carriers are facing erosion in profitability，显得拖沓不够高级。
items.when: 在财报或尽调报告中分析外部不利环境、行业痛点或宏观背景时套用。
items.slot: given the […] erosion […] are facing
swap: As some major medical carriers are facing profitability erosion (用状语从句，不如原句紧凑)
Considering that profitability is declining for some carriers (口语化严重，缺乏专业财经严肃性)

items.en: State insurance departments conduct periodic examinations of the books and records, financial reporting, policy filings and market conduct of insurance companies
items.why: 用 'conduct periodic examinations of...' 替代动词化表达（如 'examine periodically'），使审计和监管行为显得高度制度化和正式。中国人的直觉常写成 'check books regularly'，显得口语化且缺乏法律严肃感。
items.when: 在尽调或审计报告中描述监管机构、内部审计或外部专家开展定期检查时。
items.slot: [...] conduct periodic examinations of the books and records, financial reporting, and [...] of [...]
swap: perform routine reviews (语气稍弱，不如 examination 正式)
undertake regular audits (侧重财务审计，范围比 examinations 窄)

items.en: Examinations are generally carried out in cooperation with the insurance departments of other states under guidelines promulgated by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners
items.why: 用 'carried out in cooperation with... under guidelines promulgated by...' 完美展现了多方协同的合规流程。中国人容易写成 'work together with... following rules'，介词搭配和动词选择都很生硬。
items.when: 描述多部门协同、跨机构监管或依据特定行业指引执行程序时。
items.slot: Reviews are generally carried out in cooperation with [...] under guidelines promulgated by [...]
swap: are conducted jointly with... following rules established by... (用词更直接，但缺乏官方文件的正式感)
are executed in coordination with... pursuant to guidelines issued by... (法律色彩更浓，适用于更重大的诉讼或合规背景)

items.en: gave the U.S. federal government direct regulatory authority over the business of health insurance
items.why: 动宾搭配极具法律和监管文件的专业感，用 gave... authority over 精准界定了权力的归属和监管对象，中国人常写成 exercise control on，不如原汁原味
items.when: 在财报中描述某项新法案或机构被赋予对特定行业的监管权力时
items.slot: gave the […] direct regulatory authority over the business of [...]
swap: granted the U.S. federal government direct regulatory oversight over [...] (更具官方色彩)
established direct regulatory control by the U.S. federal government over [...] (偏向主动态势，略显生硬)

items.en: have been and may continue to be subject to challenge through litigation
items.why: 巧妙运用并列时态 have been and may continue to be，无缝衔接了过去状态与未来预期，中国人写此类长定语或表语时容易漏掉持续性时态
items.when: 描述某项政策、合同条款或资产正面临并不确定是否会结束的诉讼或争议时
items.slot: have been and may continue to be subject to challenge through [...]
swap: remain vulnerable to potential litigation (语气稍弱，无法体现过去已经发生的过程)
are continuously being challenged via lawsuits (过于口语化，缺乏SEC文书的正式感)

items.en: indirect consequences of, or changes to, the legislation and regulations
items.why: 精准处理了修饰语的平行结构，通过逗号巧妙应对多个名词共用介词短语的情况，避免了中文直译可能导致的句式杂糅
items.when: 在合规或风险披露中，需要同时提及某项复杂规则的衍生影响及修改时
items.slot: indirect consequences of, or changes to, the […] and [...]
swap: indirect impacts or regulatory amendments of [...] (名词搭配不够地道)
subsequent changes and indirect effects resulting from [...] (结构拆分后显得冗长)

items.en: assessing whether control by foreign entities is increasing US food prices or creating national or economic security risks
items.why: 精妙地用分词短语递进指出监管核心，比用 and 连两个谓语动词显得更专业、更有层次。中国人常写成 and assess 或者 and to assess，缺乏英语母语在法律或监管文件中惯用的紧凑感。
items.when: 在财报或尽调报告中指出某项政策或条款的核心审查方向时
items.slot: assessing whether control by [...] is [...] or [...]
swap: evaluating if [...] contributes to [...] or poses [...] (稍显平淡，缺乏原句的法律严谨感)
determining whether [...] drives [...] or creates [...] (动词略显直接，不如 assessing 正式)

items.en: While the ultimate impact of the executive order will depend on the actions ultimately resulting from the U.S. regulatory authorities
items.why: 巧妙运用 while 引导让步状语从句，并在主句前对不确定性进行对冲（hedge），既承认了现状又为潜在风险留出余地。中国人常写成 Although the final impact depends on...，显得生硬死板，缺乏 SEC 报告特有的圆润和审慎。
items.when: 在评估某项新政策、诉讼或宏观事件的最终影响尚不确定时
items.slot: While the ultimate impact of [...] will depend on the actions ultimately resulting from [...],
swap: Although the final effect relies on [...] (用詞較口語，且 rely on 不如 depend on 正式)
Though the eventual outcome depends on [...] (句式略短，缺乏财报严谨的长句节奏)

items.en: restrict the company from pursuing certain growth opportunities, including mergers and acquisitions
items.why: 标准且地道的合规与风险披露句式，用 restrict... from doing 精准表达法律层面的限制。中国人常写成 limit the company to pursue 或 stop the company to do，常常在介词搭配和动名词上出错。
items.when: 在罗列监管或法律行动对企业商业行为（如并购、扩张）造成的负面限制时
items.slot: restrict the company from pursuing certain [...], including [...]
swap: prevent the company from pursuing [...] (prevent 语义偏向物理阻止，restrict 更符合监管限制)
limit the company's ability to pursue [...] (意思相近，但结构变为名词短语，不如原句动词短语有力)

items.en: leverage the integrated model to increase the proportion
items.why: 动名词短语作状语高度浓缩了管理动作，leverage（撬动/利用）配合 proportion（比例）极具投行和上市公司财报风格。中国人常写成 use the model to make the percentage higher。
items.when: 在管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）中说明如何通过某种模式优化经营指标时套用
items.slot: leverage the [integrated/synergistic] model to [increase/optimize] the [proportion/share] of [...]
swap: use the combined model to raise the percentage (use 和 raise 略显口语化和生硬)
utilize the integrated structure to boost the ratio (utilize 偏重机械使用，不如 leverage 贴切)

items.en: proportion of its sales attributable to general line and EWP
items.why: 用过去分词短语后置作定语，极其精炼地表达了‘归属于……的销售额占比’。中国人在写财务报告时常写成‘sales which are attributed to...’或‘sales from...’，显得啰嗦且缺乏专业度。
items.when: 在财报、审计底稿或尽调报告中分析某类收入、成本或资产的归属和构成时
items.slot: proportion of its […] attributable to […]
swap: sales coming from [...] (过于口语化，缺乏正式财务报告的严谨感)
sales derived from [...] (意思相近，但介词换成了 derived，略带主动溯源色彩)

items.en: To assess the effectiveness and efficiency of our operations
items.why: 动词不定式置于句首作目的状语，用词精炼且节奏明快。中国人写财务报告时常爱用 for assessing 或 in order to assess，显得拖沓不够专业。
items.when: 在财务报告中阐述某项业务举措、投资或内控措施的目的时套用。
items.slot: To assess the effectiveness and efficiency of our [...], we regularly [...]
swap: To evaluate the performance and efficiency of our [...] - 词义相近但不如 effectiveness 精准
For the purpose of assessing our [...] - 结构冗长，缺乏现代商业报告的简洁感

items.en: is opening the door to more use cases
items.why: 用 opening the door to 这一生动的隐喻代替常规的 leading to 或 creating opportunities，极具画面感。中国人容易用生硬的 cause 或 result in，显得死板。
items.when: 描述某项新技术、新投资或新战略为未来带来更多可能性和衍生价值时套用。
items.slot: Our success with [...] is opening the door to more [...] for improving [...]
swap: is creating more opportunities for - 表达过于平淡，缺乏商业叙事的感染力
leads to additional use cases for - 用词偏学术化，不够符合美资企业财报的生动文风

items.en: Key learnings and best practices are then leveraged across
items.why: 动词 leverage 用得极其地道，指跨部门或跨网点推广最佳实践。中国人写这类管理动作时常会用 use 或 apply，无法体现这种杠杆效应和协同规模。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中总结某项成功经验、技术或标准需要在整个组织或多个分公司推广时套用。
items.slot: Key learnings and best practices are then leveraged across our [...] locations
swap: are subsequently applied across - applied 过于常规，无法展现最佳实践的复用价值
are then utilized throughout - utilized 偏向功能性使用，缺乏管理熟练度

items.en: represented 48%, 47% and 41% of our total revenue for fiscal 2023, 2024 and 2025, respectively
items.why: 用 represented... respectively 精准串联多年度的百分比与财务指标，逻辑极其严密。中国写手常写成分句或者用逗号乱接，缺乏 SEC 报告特有的平衡感和精确对位。
items.when: 在披露连续多年财务占比、集中度风险或关键经营数据时套用
items.slot: [...] represented [X]%, [Y]% and [Z]% of our total revenue for fiscal [Year1], [Year2] and [Year3], respectively
swap: accounted for [X]%, [Y]% and [Z]% of total revenue in [Year1], [Year2] and [Year3], respectively（动词换用 accounted for，意思完全一样，同样地道）
accounted for [X]%, [Y]% and [Z]% of total revenue in [Year1], [Year2] and [Year3], respectively（动词换用 accounted for，意思完全一样，同样地道）
contributed [X]%, [Y]% and [Z]% to total revenue during the same periods（动词换用 contributed to，侧重业绩贡献，但不如 represented 对应财务报表列报客观）
contributed [X]%, [Y]% and [Z]% to total revenue during the same periods（动词换用 contributed to，侧重业绩贡献，但不如 represented 对应财务报表列报客观）

items.en: Driving renewals and retention in existing end customers
items.why: 用动名词短语作句首的主语，既能指代动作，又能体现战略动作的持续性。中国学习者常写成动词原形开头或者从句（如 To drive...），显得拖沓且不够专业。
items.when: 在财务报告或商业计划书里，需要归纳某项核心战略动作及其带来的效果时。
items.slot: Driving […] in existing […]
swap: To drive renewals and retention (动词不定式头重脚轻，通常不用作段首句首)
How to drive renewals and retention (疑问词引导过于口语化，不符合严肃财报风格)

items.en: We intend to continue balancing our growth against our operating expenses.
items.why: 用 balance A against B 来表达‘在 A 和 B 之间权衡/博弈’，比中国职场常写的 balance A and B 更精准，带有一种动态对抗、利益冲突的画面感。
items.when: 在财报或管理层讨论（MD&A）中表述资源分配与战略冲突时套用。
items.slot: We intend to continue balancing […] against […].
swap: We plan to continue trading off […] against […] (语气偏负面，强调损失)
We will continue to weigh […] against […] (偏向静态评估，缺乏动态调整感)

items.en: may not ultimately grow our business, revenue or result in continued profitability.
items.why: 用 may not ultimately 组合，既不把话说死（合规避险），又准确暗示了时间拉长后可能竹篮打水一场空的结果，比简单的 might fail 显得职业得多。
items.when: 在风险因素（Risk Factors）中提示某项高额投入最终未必见效时套用。
items.slot: Expenditures related to […] may not ultimately […].
swap: might fail to ultimately […] (语法略显笨拙，ultimately 放的位置不够地道)
will likely not […] (语气过于绝对，违反 SEC 披露的谨慎原则)

items.en: there is no assurance that we will be able to maintain profitability in future periods.
items.why: 标准 SEC 风险披露句型，用 there is no assurance that 代替口语化的 we are not sure，既规避了前瞻性陈述（Forward-looking statements）的法律责任，又显得客观冰冷。
items.when: 无法保证未来某项利好指标（如盈利、营收增长、市占率）能够持续时套用。
items.slot: There is no assurance that we will be able to […].
swap: We cannot guarantee that we can […] (过于口语化，不够正式)
It is uncertain whether we will […] (力度偏弱，未明确免责意图)

items.en: The predecessor of LCNB Corp., the Bank, was formed as a national banking association in 1877.
items.why: 用 'formed as a' 简洁地表达实体设立时的法律形式，动词搭配精准。中国人常会生硬地直译为 'established to be a' 或 'created as a'。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调报告中追溯历史沿革、描述实体最初设立形态时套用。
items.slot: The predecessor of […], […], was formed as a […] in […].
swap: established to be a national banking association (establishment偏向物理设施，不如form贴切)
created as a national banking association (created偏向无中生有，formed更符合法律实体设立)

items.en: established by the Federal Reserve Board and the OCC
items.why: 用过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 standards，省去了 'which were established by' 的关系代词和be动词，使句子极具专业财报的干练感。国人写报告时容易写成定语从句，导致长句臃肿。
items.when: 修饰由特定机构制定、发布的标准、规则或框架时套用
items.slot: established by [...] and [...]
swap: which are established by the Federal Reserve Board and the OCC (使用了定语从句，显得啰嗦)
set up by the Federal Reserve Board and the OCC (set up 过于口语化，不符合 SEC 正式文风)

items.en: The Company continues to focus on sales and profits growth
items.why: 用 focus on 精准定位战略着力点，比中国人常写的中式英语 'pay attention to' 或 'put eyes on' 显得更有力度和专业度。
items.when: 在年报中阐述公司长期战略重点或管理层关注领域时套用
items.slot: The Company continues to focus on [...]
swap: The Company places strong emphasis on [...] (语气更重，强调管理层决心)
The Company pays attention to [...] (略显口语化，财报中不够正式)

items.en: align business functions and processes to enhance key capabilities
items.why: 用 align... to... 表达‘对齐/协同’，比中国人常用的 connect 或 make consistent 更具商业专业感；enhance key capabilities 干净利落，没有废话。
items.when: 讨论业务整合、流程优化或组织架构调整时使用
items.slot: align business functions and processes to enhance [...]
swap: integrate business operations to improve [...] (侧重点偏向集成，不如 align 强调方向一致)
synchronize business processes for [...] (用词偏重技术层面，不如原句宏观)

items.en: The Company strives to be good stewards of the environment and makes this an important part of its overall mission.
items.why: strives to be 比单纯的 tries to be 或 aims to be 更有力度，展现出企业在ESG方面的积极态度和庄严承诺。中国财务人员常写成 makes efforts to be，显得刻板生硬。
items.when: 在财报中表述公司对某项长期战略或ESG目标的坚定决心时
items.slot: The Company strives to be [...] and makes this an important part of its overall mission.
swap: The Company aims to be (语气偏弱，仅表示目标)
The Company is committed to being (更加正式但较常见)

items.en: Its sustainability strategy operates under four key pillars: natural resource conservation, green design, community impact, and food and agricultural impact.
items.why: operates under 赋予了战略一种动态的框架感和支撑力，比用 has four pillars 更生动专业。冒号后紧跟四个名词短语，平行对称。
items.when: 介绍公司的战略、计划或框架是由几个核心支柱支撑时
items.slot: Its [...] strategy operates under four key pillars: [...], [...], [...], and [...]
swap: Its strategy is based on four pillars (较为平淡，缺乏动感)
Its strategy consists of four pillars (结构直接但略显单调)

items.en: a federal income tax-exempt nonprofit corporation organized under Internal Revenue Code Section 501(c)(3) as a public charity.
items.why: organized under 极其精准地表达了法律实体的注册依据，定语后难却不冗长。中国财务人员容易写成 established by the law of，显得中式英语化。
items.when: 在财报附注或法律结构说明中描述实体注册依据时
items.slot: a [...] corporation organized under [...] as a [...]
swap: a [...] corporation established pursuant to [...] (更为传统法律化)
a [...] corporation formed under [...] (常见但不如 organized 正式)

items.en: will not necessarily be indicative of the Company’s actual results
items.why: 用 indicative of 替代 indicate，精准表达“能预示/说明”的概念，且加入了 will not necessarily 做双重否定式的缓和，比生硬的 will not 显得严谨得多。
items.when: 需要撇清外部宏观统计数据与公司实际财务表现必然联系的时候套用。
items.slot: will not necessarily be indicative of [...]
swap: will not necessarily show [...] (show 显得口语化，不够专业)
does not guarantee [...] (意思有偏差，原句强调的是指示性而非保证)

items.en: in 2025 compared to the 52-week average in 2024
items.why: 用过去分词 compared to 作为后置衔接，极其自然地引入对比基准，省去了复杂的从句，使年际变动的表述异常紧凑。
items.when: 在财报或尽调报告中罗列跨年财务、运营指标变动时使用。
items.slot: in [...] compared to the [...] in [...]
swap: compared with [...] (in 与 with 的微小差异，原句用的 to 在美资财报中极常见)
as compared to [...] (多了一个 as，略显冗长)

items.en: Management cannot accurately measure the full impact of inflation or deflation on retail pricing
items.why: 巧妙利用副词 'accurately' 修饰动词 'measure'，比生硬地使用 'cannot know' 或 'is unable to evaluate' 展现了管理层对量化局限性的严谨与专业表述。
items.when: 在管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）中说明由于变量复杂而无法精确量化某个影响时。
items.slot: Management cannot accurately measure the full impact of [...] on [...]
swap: is unable to precisely determine [...] – 略显生硬，缺乏财报润滑感
fails to quantify the exact effect of [...] – 带有贬义色彩，不适合管理层自述

items.en: An investment in the Partnership involves a high degree of risk.
items.why: 用 involves 替代了简单的 has 或 is，搭配 a high degree of risk 显得极其老道地道，中国人写财务报告时常直译为 has high risks 或 is very risky。
items.when: 在风险提示章节开头定性某个投资标的或项目的风险时套用。
items.slot: An investment in the […] involves a high degree of risk.
swap: An investment in the […] carries significant risks (语气略轻)
Investing in the […] is subject to substantial risks (略显生硬)

items.en: However, our agreements with Delek Holdings help mitigate these effects by including minimum volume commitments.
items.why: 用 'help mitigate'（有助于缓解）而不是绝对化的 'eliminate'（消除），体现了审计与尽调报告中严谨的风险提示态度。中国人写应对措施时容易用绝对词，而 'help' 做动词能为未完全消除的风险保留余地。
items.when: 描述某项合同条款或商业安排能够部分对冲或减缓某种不利影响时套用。
items.slot: However, our agreements with […] help mitigate these effects by including […]
swap: partially offset (侧重财务层面的抵消，更加具体)
serve to reduce (稍显生硬，不如 help mitigate 自然)

items.en: engaging in wholesale activity at our Abilene and San Angelo, Texas terminals
items.why: 中国人写业务描述常爱用动词（如 conduct wholesale business），而母语习惯用动名词短语 engaging in... activity 作为具体业务线条的名词化载体，显得更加法律严谨且专业。
items.when: 在财报中描述公司具体从事的商业活动或业务板块时套用。
items.slot: engaging in [...] activity at our [...] terminals
swap: conducting wholesale operations (偏日常运营，不如 engaging in 严谨)
carrying out wholesale transactions (侧重具体交易行为，范围较窄)

items.en: whereby we purchase light products for sale and exchange to third parties
items.why: 用 whereby 优雅地引导一个定语从句，指代前面的 wholesale activity 并解释其运作机制。中国财务人员容易用 which we use to 这种口语化句式，而 whereby 瞬间提升了文书的契约感与正式度。
items.when: 解释某项业务、协议或机制的具体运作方式时套用。
items.slot: whereby we [...] for [...]
swap: through which we purchase (中规中矩，但不如 whereby 精炼)
in which we purchase (介词搭配略显生硬)

items.en: providing terminalling services to independent third parties and Delek Holdings
items.why: 精准使用行业专业名词动词化（terminalling services），并用 to... 明确服务对象。中国写作者常写成 providing services of terminal，不够地道。
items.when: 在描述向特定客户群体提供某类专业配套服务时套用。
items.slot: providing [...] services to [...]
swap: offering terminal services (terminal 作定语不如 terminalling 专业)
delivering terminal-related services (词数过多，不够精炼)

items.en: Our IoT Solutions segment is managed with a focus on recurring typically high margin subscription-based revenues.
items.why: 国人写这类句子常习惯用动词词组主动表达（如 manage to focus on），而此处用被动语态加介词短语 with a focus on，显得极其客观且具有战略定力。重点落脚在名词词组上，符合财报的正式文风。
items.when: 在描述某个业务板块、资产或项目的战略管理导向时套用
items.slot: Our […] segment is managed with a focus on […].
swap: Our […] segment targets […] (偏口语化，不够正式)
Management focuses the […] segment on […] (主动语态不够客观)

items.en: We believe capturing enterprise-level deals should be a driver of growth, leveraging our direct sales model to achieve this.
items.why: 用动名词短语 capturing enterprise-level deals 作主语，比用从句更简洁有力；同时后接 leveraging... 伴随状语，极具商业拓展的画面感。国人常写成 We believe that if we capture...
items.when: 在阐述公司业务增长驱动力和实施路径时套用
items.slot: We believe capturing […] should be a driver of growth, leveraging our […] to achieve this.
swap: We believe that winning big deals can drive growth (主语从句显得拖沓，不够专业)
To drive growth, we capture […] (时态和逻辑主次不如原句倒装自然)

items.en: These third parties accounted for 60.2%, 56.7% and 59.9% of our total consolidated revenue in fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.
items.why: 句尾精准使用 respectively（对应地），完美解决了多年份数据与多个百分比的严格对应问题，避免了语序混乱，中国人写财报常漏掉这个词。
items.when: 在同一种陈述中按时间或类别顺序列举多组对应数据时
items.slot: [...], [%], [%] and [%] in fiscal [%], [%] and [%], respectively.
swap: in the corresponding years of [%], [%] and [%] (略显冗长)
for each of the respective years (表达略显重复)

items.en: No customers represented over 10% of consolidated revenue
items.why: 用否定词 No 开头直接表述没有客户超标，简洁有力。中国人常写成 All customers did not represent...，逻辑显得生硬和中式。
items.when: 披露集中度风险、说明没有单一客户或供应商超过特定阈值时套用。
items.slot: No customers represented over [...]% of consolidated revenue
swap: No single customer accounted for more than [...]% of consolidated revenue (略显冗长)
None of the customers exceeded [...]% of consolidated revenue (动词略显单一)

items.en: Except to the extent that net proceeds from security issuances by Hertz Global and cash exercises of Hertz Global Public Warrants are contributed to Hertz
items.why: 用 except to the extent that 这一高级法律连词精准限定例外情况，既严谨又避免了绝对化表述。中国人通常会用 unless，无法体现程度上的精确限制。
items.when: 在设定某项规则、资金来源或责任义务的例外边界和比例限制时套用。
items.slot: Except to the extent that [...] are contributed to [...]
swap: Unless [...] is contributed to [...]（用 unless 过于绝对，丢失了程度限制）
Save for the portion of [...] that is contributed to [...]（用法较为古旧，不够现代美式财报地道）

items.en: risks associated with operating in many different countries
items.why: 用过去分词短语 associated with 做后置定语，极简地将风险与具体业务活动绑定。中国人常写成定语从句 'risks that are associated with...' 或者用动名词所有格，显得拖沓不够地道。
items.when: 在审计报告中描述某项特定业务或投资所面临的潜在风险时。
items.slot: risks associated with […]
swap: risks linked to [...] (语气稍显口语化，不如 associated with 正式)
risks arising from [...] (侧重强调由某事引发的因果关系，不如 associated with 涵盖面广)

items.en: alleged violation of applicable anti-corruption or anti-bribery laws
items.why: 精妙运用 alleged（被指控的/涉嫌的），在法律和审计表述中保护公司免于承担过早下定论的责任。中国人容易直接写 suspected 或漏掉这个词，不够严谨。
items.when: 在合规审查或尽调报告中提及尚未定性或未被法院最终判决的违规行为时。
items.slot: alleged violation of applicable […] laws
swap: suspected violation of [...] (suspected 通常指内部怀疑或警方怀疑，alleged 法律色彩更浓)
potential violation of [...] (potential 仅指可能性，而 alleged 强调已被提出指控)

items.en: we undertake no obligation to update or revise publicly
items.why: 用 undertake no obligation 代替“we will not update”，在规避法律责任时显得既正式又被动防御。中国人容易写成 we don't have to update，语气太弱且不具备企业公文的严谨性。
items.when: 公司需要明确声明不对未来预测、财务估算或公开言论进行后续更新时
items.slot: we undertake no obligation to [...]
swap: we have no duty to [...]（duty 侧重道德或一般责任，undertake no obligation 更加契合 SEC 监管文体）
we will not [...]（将来时态过于绝对，缺乏 undertake no obligation 这种法律层面的免责缓冲）

items.en: anchored by three financial pillars: disciplined fleet management, revenue optimization and rigorous cost control
items.why: 过去分词短语作后置定语，极为精炼地修饰前面的 comprehensive strategy，用 anchored 比常用的 supported 更有力、更有基石感。中国人常写成定语从句 'which is anchored by...'，显得拖沓不够高级。
items.when: 在财报或战略规划中介绍核心战略、支柱或支撑要素时
items.slot: anchored by three [...] pillars: [...], [...] and [...]
swap: supported by three pillars (中规中矩，但语气稍显平淡，缺乏 anchored 的稳固感)
driven by three core elements (侧重驱动力，不如 anchored 强调底层支撑)

items.en: position us for sustainable growth in the future of mobility
items.why: 动词 position 后面直接接代词和介词短语（position sb. for...），表达“为……做好有利地位/打好基础”，极其地道。中国人往往会啰嗦地写成 'put us in a good position to achieve sustainable growth'。
items.when: 在总结战略举措的最终目的、展望未来发展前景时
items.slot: position us for sustainable [...] in the future of [...]
swap: prepare us for sustainable growth (prepare 侧重准备动作，不如 position 强调所处战略地位)
lead to sustainable growth (lead to 太过直接和泛化，缺乏主动布局的意味)

items.en: we are prioritizing de-leveraging and remain committed to retaining
items.why: 用 prioritizing（动词作谓语）和 remain committed to（系表结构加动名词）展现持续动作与坚定承诺，节奏感极强。中国人常写成 we will first de-lever and then keep keeping...，缺乏高管讲话的自信和力度。
items.when: 管理层向市场传达战略重点、资本配置方向或并购后整合计划时。
items.slot: we are prioritizing [...] and remain committed to [...]
swap: we plan to de-lever and want to keep (口语化严重，缺乏庄重感)
our priority is de-leveraging and we promise to retain (promise 一词在SEC文件中显得不够正式)

items.en: that is underpinned by a disciplined capital allocation framework
items.why: 用 underpinned by 代替日常的 supported by 或 based on，瞬间提升财务叙事的专业度与说服力。中国人写财报常过度使用 base on，显得词汇贫乏。
items.when: 阐述强劲财务表现、信用评级或战略背后的底层支撑机制时。
items.slot: that is underpinned by a [...] [...]
swap: that is supported by a disciplined capital allocation framework (supported 偏向日常用语，力度较弱)
which is based on a disciplined capital allocation framework (based on 略显平庸，缺乏财报书面美感)

items.en: allows us to meet demand on a worldwide basis for our customers
items.why: 中国人常写成 enable our customers to 或 make it possible for us，这里用 allow sb. to 极为地道且省力，动宾结构紧凑。
items.when: 在财报或审计报告中描述某项战略、资产或地理布局带来的赋能效果时。
items.slot: allows us to […] on a worldwide basis for our customers
swap: enables us to […] (语气更正式官方，少了一点商业行动感)
provides us the capability to […] (略显冗长，不如 allow 干脆)

items.en: draws on business and technical expertise from a worldwide workforce
items.why: draw on 比用 use 或 utilize 更高级，生动体现了‘汲取、依托’现成资源的动态感。中国人在写报告时常滥用 leverage 或 use。
items.when: 描述企业如何利用自身的人才、技术、资金等无形资产时。
items.slot: draws on […] from a worldwide workforce
swap: utilizes […] from a worldwide workforce (偏向工程或机械的使用，缺乏人才资源的柔性)
relies on […] from a worldwide workforce (带有依赖意味，不如 draw on 显得主动且优势明显)

items.en: provides revenue streams that may offset geographic economic trends
items.why: offset 用来描述‘对冲、抵消’负面经济周期，比 mitigate 或 balance 更精准。中国写作者常拼写成 counteract 或 counterweight。
items.when: 在风险评估或业务多元化分析中，说明某项收入或资产如何对冲宏观风险。
items.slot: provides revenue streams that may offset […]
swap: counteract […] (多用于抵消某种负面作用或化学物理效应，用于财务收入趋势略显生硬)
balance […] (词义较弱，仅仅是平衡，无法体现主动冲抵风险的效果)

items.en: A summary of our domestic and international results
items.why: 用名词短语 'A summary of...' 作主语，比动词 'We summarized...' 更符合财务报告的正式文风。中国人写财报常习惯用动作（We summarize），显得主观且琐碎，而用名词化结构（nominalization）则更客观严谨。
items.when: 在财报、审计报告或尽调报告中引出某项具体分析、明细或业绩总结时使用。
items.slot: A summary of our […] and […] results
swap: We summarize our domestic and international results below (动词主动语态，主观色彩较浓，不够客观)
An overview of our domestic and international results (overview 比 summary 范围更广，语意有细微差别)

items.en: From time to time, the markets in which we sell our products, services, and solutions experience weak economic conditions that may negatively affect sales.
items.why: 用 from time to time 替代刻板的 occasionally 或 sometimes，显得非常地道且具职业感。中国人写财报往往倾向于用 everyday 词汇，而专业母语者偏爱这类固定介词短语来描述周期性波动。
items.when: 描述企业业务、市场环境或财务状况不定期发生、间歇性出现的现象时。
items.slot: From time to time, […] experience […] that may negatively affect […].
swap: Occasionally, the markets [...] — 词义相同但稍显生硬，缺乏财报常用的流畅感。
At periodic intervals, the markets [...] — 过于正式和学术，不符合 10-K 的商业叙事风格。

items.en: Historical patterns or experiences of seasonality should not be considered a reliable indicator of our future net revenues or financial performance.
items.why: 用 should not be considered a reliable indicator 标准句式进行风险前瞻性披露（Safe Harbor），既坚定又严谨。中国审计师写英文报告时常直译为 cannot use history to predict，缺乏法律保护意识和规范的专业语态。
items.when: 在财报或尽调报告中提示历史数据不代表未来表现、划清预测责任时。
items.slot: Historical patterns or experiences of […] should not be considered a reliable indicator of our future […].
swap: Past trends cannot reliably predict our future [...] — 语气太绝对，缺乏审慎的法律防护色彩。
Historical data are not useful for forecasting [...] — 略显生硬且否定了数据的全部价值，不如原句委婉专业。

items.en: we tend to experience stronger customer demand in fourth quarters.
items.why: 用 tend to experience 替代直接的 will experience，体现了对商业趋势描述的客观和谨慎。中国人容易用肯定句式写死，忽视了市场波动的不确定性，而 tend to 是财报中平衡语气的绝佳选择。
items.when: 总结业务呈现某种概率性、趋势性但非绝对规律的季节或周期现象时。
items.slot: we tend to experience stronger […] in […].
swap: we usually experience stronger [...] — 偏向口语和绝对化，缺乏 10-K 所需的严谨度。
we are likely to experience stronger [...] — 语气略带猜测，不如 tend to 稳定且基于历史统计。

items.en: have been prepared in accordance with US GAAP
items.why: 用 in accordance with 代替中国财务人员爱用的 according to，瞬间提升审计报告的专业度与正式感。中国人在写会计准则遵循时，常误用 according to 显得口语化。
items.when: 在描述财务报表、审计意见或合同条款遵循特定标准时套用
items.slot: have been prepared in accordance with [...]
swap: prepared under [...] (略显简略，不够正式)
compliant with [...] (偏向法律合规，不如 in accordance with 贴合准则)

items.en: The major components of the Partnership's cash flow from investing activities are
items.why: 中国人写财报常说 'The main parts are' 或直接用动词，显得口语化且单调。这里用 'major components' 瞬间提升了正式度，而 'cash flow from investing activities' 则是标准的财务术语连缀，主谓搭配极具专业范儿。
items.when: 在财务报告或审计底稿中概述某类财务指标（如现金流、成本、收入）的构成时。
items.slot: The major components of the […]'s […] are […]
swap: The primary elements of [...] are [...]（elements 稍显学术，不如 components 在财报中常见）
The principal parts of [...] include [...]（parts 偏口语，不及 components 正式）

items.en: generated cash flow from the sale of real estate of
items.why: 中文直译常写成 'got money by selling'。这里用动词 'generated' 准确表达了资产变现带来的现金流入，并通过介词短语精确限定来源，最后用 'of + 金额' 干净利落地收尾，句式紧凑。
items.when: 报告特定交易或资产处置所产生的现金流入或收益金额时。
items.slot: generated cash flow from the sale of […] of […]
swap: produced cash inflows through selling [...]（produced 不如 generated 在财务语境中地道）
realized cash proceeds from disposing [...]（proceeds 侧重收到的款项，用法略有不同）

items.en: Preparing the financial statements requires management to use judgment
items.why: 用物主代词/动名词作主语，搭配 require sb. to do 的句型，把动作为主语的因果关系写得极其紧凑。中国人常写成 When preparing... management needs to...，略显啰嗦。
items.when: 在财报或审计报告中描述某项复杂工作对管理层主观判断的要求时。
items.slot: Preparing the financial statements requires management to […]
swap: The preparation of financial statements mandates management to...（偏法律或监管强制语气，不如 require 自然）
Management must use judgment when preparing...（主动语态，但失去了将编制过程本身作为客观触发条件的宏观视角）

items.en: affect the reported amounts of the Partnership’s assets and liabilities
items.why: 精准使用 reported amounts 这一专业审计词汇，并用 of 属格串联资产负债，避免了中式英语中用 change numbers 这种口语化表达。
items.when: 讨论会计估计、假设变更对财务报表具体项目的影响时。
items.slot: affect the reported amounts of the […]
swap: change the recorded numbers of...（recorded 略显随意，numbers 不如 amounts 专业）
impact the financial statement figures for...（figures 泛指数字，不如 reported amounts 严谨规范）

items.en: It is possible that the carrying amount of the Partnership’s assets and liabilities, or the results of reported operations, would be affected
items.why: 使用 It is possible that... 配合虚拟语气 would，完美展示了审计和估值披露中标准的对冲（Hedge）风险措辞，既提示了不确定性又显得客观严谨。中国人在写风险提示时容易用肯定句或直接说 might be wrong，不够职业。
items.when: 在审计底稿、尽调报告或财务附注中进行风险提示和假设敏感性说明时。
items.slot: It is possible that the carrying amount of […], or the results of reported operations, would be affected
swap: There is a chance that the asset values might change...（There is a chance 口语化严重，might 语气过强）
Management estimates could be wrong, which affects...（直接断言估计会错，措辞过于尖锐且不符合准则惯例）

items.en: commencing on February 1, 2026 and expiring on January 31, 2031
items.why: 使用分词短语作后置定语，精确限定租赁期的起止时间，连贯且信息密度高。中国人在写时间段时容易拆成两个独立的并列句或者用从句，显得冗长拖沓。
items.when: 审计报告中描述合同、租赁期、担保等有效期范围的场景
items.slot: to extend the lease term 5 years commencing on […] and expiring on […]
swap: starting on [...] and ending on [...] (用词偏日常，缺乏专业财务和法律文件的严肃性)
which begins on [...] and expires on [...] (定语从句略显累赘，不如分词短语干练)

items.en: The primary reason for the decrease was a significant reduction in consulting expenses.
items.why: 句型清晰地将‘变动原因’作为主语，‘具体业务变化’作为表语。中国人常写成 'Consulting expenses decreased significantly, which caused this.'，逻辑主次不够分明。
items.when: 解释财务数据大幅波动背后的核心驱动因素时
items.slot: The primary reason for the […] was a significant reduction in […]
swap: This decrease was primarily driven by a significant reduction in [...] (强调驱动因素，语气更强)
The decrease was mainly due to a significant reduction in [...] (常用但略显平淡)

items.en: these consulting fees were no longer incurred in the year ended 2025.
items.why: 用 'incurred'（发生/产生）搭配费用，且用 'were no longer' 精准表达某类支出在期内终止。中国人容易直译为 'we did not pay these fees anymore'，显得非常口语化和外行。
items.when: 说明某项一次性成本或特定开支在报告期内不再发生时
items.slot: these […] were no longer incurred in the year ended […]
swap: we stopped paying these consulting fees in [...] (过于口语化，缺乏专业财务严肃性)
these consulting fees ceased in [...] (词义不够全面，未明确指代费用的发生)

items.en: focusing on allowing users around the world to save money
items.why: 动名词短语层层嵌套（focusing on -> allowing -> to save），精准修饰前文的移动应用，比用定语从句更显紧凑连贯。
items.when: 描述某项产品、技术或战略的立足点和具体赋能对象时套用。
items.slot: [...] focusing on allowing […] to […]
swap: which focused on helping users (从句略显拖沓)
aimed at enabling users (动词略有不同，但连词较少)

items.en: The Company has not been successful in developing revenue
items.why: 用 has not been successful in 这种委婉的否定（Litotes）来表达商业上的失败或未达预期，既客观陈述了事实，又符合SEC文件严谨、非情绪化的披露基调。
items.when: 在财报中披露某项业务或商业化尝试未取得预期成效时套用。
items.slot: the Company has not been successful in […]
swap: failed to generate revenue (语气过于生硬直接，缺乏委婉性)
has not yet generated revenue (偏向单纯陈述事实，缺少对过程的评价)

items.en: the Company’s continued existence is dependent upon its ability to obtain needed working capital
items.why: 用 'continued existence is dependent upon' 替代常规的 'survive needs'，极具SEC文件特色。中国财务人员常写成 'the company may not survive without'，显得口语化且缺乏法律严谨性。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调中描述持续经营重大不确定性（Going Concern）时套用。
items.slot: the Company’s continued existence is dependent upon its ability to […]
swap: the Company relies heavily on its ability to […] （语气更弱，侧重依赖关系）
the Company's survival hinges on whether it can […] （语气更强硬、更口语化，不适合正式SEC文件）

items.en: Management monitors and analyzes the Company’s cash on-hand
items.why: 'monitors and analyzes' 是财报管理层讨论（MD&A）的标准双动词搭配。中国审计人员常写成 'management looks at the cash'，缺乏专业度。
items.when: 描述管理层对某项财务指标的持续跟进和评估时套用。
items.slot: Management monitors and analyzes the Company’s […]
swap: Management tracks and reviews the Company's […] （动词组合更偏向日常运营，正式度稍弱）
Management keeps an eye on the Company's […] （极度口语化，绝对不能出现在SEC报告中）

items.en: These factors could contribute to increased utilization of
items.why: 用 could 替代 will 保持了审计和前瞻性陈述（forward-looking statements）应有的谨慎合规语调，contribute to 比直接用 lead to 更具专业客观色彩。中国作者常因急于下结论而误用 will。
items.when: 在分析未来趋势、潜在市场增长或利好因素可能带来的影响时
items.slot: [These factors] could contribute to [increased utilization of] [...]
swap: may lead to a rise in [...] (may 的概率感与 could 略有不同，lead to 略显生硬)
will likely result in [...] (will 语气过强，不符合 SEC 报告对预测性陈述的审慎合规要求)

items.en: A portion of the revenue of the Industrial Technologies segment is attributable to the sale of consumables and replacement parts
items.why: 用 attributable to 替代简单的 derive from 或 come from，显得极其专业和严谨，专用于财报中描述某部分收入的归属。中国人常写成 comes from，显得口语化且缺乏财务质感。
items.when: 在财务尽职调查或审计报告中描述某板块或某产品线收入来源时套用
items.slot: A portion of the revenue of the [...] segment is attributable to the sale of [...]
swap: comes from (过于口语化，缺乏财报的正式感)
is derived from (虽然也常用，但不如 attributable to 准确表达归属关系)

items.en: The Company develops inks exclusively for the use with its marking equipment
items.why: 副词 exclusively 插在 for the use with 之前，精准限定了用途的唯一性，凸显技术壁垒。中国人容易把 exclusively 放在句首或句尾，导致修饰范围不够紧凑。
items.when: 描述企业对特定技术、配件或软件具有排他性绑定或控制力时套用
items.slot: The Company develops [...] exclusively for the use with its [...]
swap: only uses for (表达太弱，没有体现出独家研发和绑定的商业护城河)
specifically for (语气不够绝对，未能强调唯一排他性)

items.en: which is critical to ensure ongoing equipment reliability and mark quality
items.why: 非限制性定语从句用 which is critical to 承接前文，比用 and it can ensure 更有逻辑推进感。中国人常写成 ensuring，削弱了其重要性的强调语气。
items.when: 在审计或尽职调查中强调某项设计、控制或合规对整体业务至关重要时套用
items.slot: which is critical to ensure ongoing [...] and [...]
swap: ensuring (用分词作结果状语，语气较弱，不如 which is critical to 强调得有力)
which is important for ensuring (不够直接干脆，冗余词较多)

items.en: Changes in foreign currency exchange rates could have an adverse effect on the Company's revenue, cash flows and financial results.
items.why: 用名词词组 'have an adverse effect on' 代替动词 'adversely affect'，语气更正式客观，且符合审计与尽调报告强调风险时的专业文风。中国人常顺手写成动词短语，显得口语化。
items.when: 在财务报告或尽调中评估某外部因素对财务指标的负面影响时套用
items.slot: Changes in […] could have an adverse effect on the Company's […].
swap: negatively impact the Company's […] (动词直接修饰，语气更直接但略失财报的稳重感)
pose a significant threat to the Company's […] (语义更重，适用于风险提示)

items.en: To the extent that some or all of the Company’s variable interest rate debt is not subject to interest rate swaps
items.why: 用 To the extent that 极其精准地限定条件和范围（“在……范围内/在……程度上”），避免了用 if 时非黑即白的绝对化，是中国人写严谨合规报告时极少掌握的高级条件限定词。
items.when: 在财报或审计报告中需要精细化限定某个假设条件成立的边界时套用。
items.slot: To the extent that [...] is not subject to [...],
swap: If and to the extent that [...]（法律文书常用，略显冗长）
If [...] is not covered by [...]（用 covered 代替 subject，专业度稍逊）

items.en: In the event the Company seeks to refinance indebtedness
items.why: 用介词短语 In the event... 代替常规的 If... 条件句，使法律和财务文件的语调更正式、更有约束力。中国人写财报常习惯机械地用 if，显得口语化且单薄。
items.when: 在财报、合同或审计报告中描述某种假设性风险事件或触发条件时使用。
items.slot: In the event the […] seeks to […],
swap: Should the Company seek to refinance indebtedness (倒装句式，文学色彩较浓，财报中略显突兀)
If the Company seeks to refinance indebtedness (最基础的条件句，缺乏专业文件的严谨正式感)

items.en: limit the Company’s ability to incur such indebtedness
items.why: 动宾搭配精准地道，limit... ability to do... 完美表达了负面约束，而中国人容易直译成 restrict the company from doing。同时用 incur 搭配 indebtedness（产生/承担债务），比用get或take精准专业得多。
items.when: 描述外部因素、高利率或财务条款如何限制企业未来的融资或扩张动作时。
items.slot: limit the [….]’s ability to incur such […],
swap: restrict the Company from getting such debt (restrict 搭配 from doing 略显累赘，且 get debt 不够专业)
prevent the Company to incur such indebtedness (语法错误，prevent 不能直接接 to do)

items.en: could have a material and adverse effect on
items.why: 这是SEC披露文件中极其标准的风险标准句式（Material Adverse Effect，MAE），用 material and adverse 修饰 effect 极具法律和审计效力。中国人常写成 will badly influence 或 affect a lot。
items.when: 在风险提示（Risk Factors）章节评估某不利因素对财务指标的实质性破坏时。
items.slot: could have a material and adverse effect on the Company’s […],
swap: could negatively and seriously impact (用词偏口语化，缺乏SEC档案的法定严肃性)
will significantly damage (语气过于绝对，财报风险提示通常用 could 保留余地)

items.en: The Corporation performed an in-depth investigation and review of its attrition metrics
items.why: 国人常写成“The company deeply investigated...”。原文使用“perform an in-depth investigation and review of...”这种名词化（Nominalization）结构，将动作转化为标准商务流程，显得极其正式、专业，极适合审计和尽调报告的客观陈述风格。
items.when: 在报告中正式记录企业对某项内部风险、指标或资产进行深入排查时。
items.slot: The Corporation performed an in-depth investigation and review of its [attrition] [metrics], and developed a strategy...
swap: carried out a thorough study on employee turnover (thorough 不如 in-depth 正式)
deeply analyzed its attrition rates (动词形式不够正式，缺乏财报的严肃感)

items.en: in order to avoid limitations on capital distributions
items.why: 用 in order to 引出目的状语，比单纯用 to 更有正式的公文感。中国人写财报常漏掉 in order，或者直接用 so that 导致句子变冗长
items.when: 在监管报告或审计底稿中说明某项合规动作的目的时
items.slot: in order to avoid […] on […]
swap: for the purpose of avoiding [...] (偏向法律合同体，略显笨重)
so as to avoid [...] (更紧凑，但不如原句强调目的)

items.en: The Company’s financial statements have been prepared in accordance with US GAAP.
items.why: 用现在完成时 passive voice 强调编制动作对当前财务报表状态的持续影响，中国财务人员常误用一般现在时 is prepared。
items.when: 在审计报告或财报附注首段声明会计准则遵循情况时套用。
items.slot: The Company’s financial statements have been prepared in accordance with […]
swap: The financial statements are prepared in accordance with US GAAP（一般现在时，缺乏对编制过程完成并延续至现状的强调）
We have prepared the financial statements following US GAAP（主动语态，不够正式规范）

items.en: It is possible that the carrying amount of the Company’s assets and liabilities, or the results of reported operations, would be affected
items.why: 利用形式主语 It 引导主语从句，搭配虚拟语气 would 巧妙避险，中国人常直译为 We might affect assets if estimates are wrong，缺乏专业谨慎态度。
items.when: 在财报或审计报告中提示未来估计值不确定性及潜在财务影响时套用。
items.slot: It is possible that the carrying amount of […], or the results of reported operations, would be affected
swap: The carrying amount might be affected if estimates are inaccurate（条件状语从句前置，削弱了正式声明的客观性）
We may affect the carrying amount of assets if assumptions change（主动语态将责任揽给公司，增加法律风险）

items.en: This decrease was partially offset by rent increases
items.why: 财务分析中解释变动原因的黄金句式，被动语态平稳客观，partially offset 精准表达对冲效果。中国人常写成 But this decrease was made smaller by...，口语化且生硬。
items.when: 当某个财务指标下降被其他因素部分抵消时套用
items.slot: This [...] was partially offset by [...]

swap.en: This decrease was slightly mitigated by [...]
swap.msg: mitigated 语义偏向减缓风险或负面影响，不如 offset 贴切财报数据对冲

swap.en: This reduction was partly balanced by [...]
swap.msg: balanced 含义较宽泛，不如 offset 在财务语境中专业

items.en: the Company was allocated LLC administration expenses from affiliated parties of $181,433 and $239,899, respectively.
items.why: 用被动语态 'was allocated' 准确表达了成本分摊的会计事实，比中国人常写的 'received allocation of' 更加地道和符合审计报告的专业惯例。
items.when: 在财报或审计报告中描述关联方费用分摊时套用。
items.slot: the Company was allocated […] expenses from affiliated parties of […] and […], respectively.
swap: the Company received allocated […] expenses of […] (不如被动语态直接)
affiliated parties allocated […] expenses to the Company of […] (主动语态不够客观)

items.en: These expenses were lower in 2025, when compared to 2024, mainly due to a reduction in headcount and a decrease in property related management expenses.
items.why: 用 'when compared to' 作为过渡短语，比单纯的 'compared with' 读起来更有节奏感，且 'mainly due to' 引导原因非常干脆，避免了中国写作者爱用的 'is because of the reason that'。
items.when: 在财务分析中对比两年数据变化及原因时套用。
items.slot: These expenses were lower in […], when compared to […], mainly due to […] and […].
swap: These expenses decreased in […] compared to […] because of […] (稍显平淡，缺乏专业财报感)
The decrease in […] between […] and […] was primarily driven by […] (稍微偏重于因果动词)

items.en: These expenses were higher in 2025, when compared to 2024, mainly due to timing of tax and audit services and expenses related to roof repairs at the Jared Jewelry store in Concord, New Hampshire.
items.why: 用 'timing of tax and audit services' 这种高度凝练的名词化结构来指代‘税务和审计服务的时间差异/节点’，极为符合英文财务报告的精炼要求。
items.when: 解释某些费用波动是由项目发生时间点不同导致时套用。
items.slot: These expenses were higher in […], when compared to […], mainly due to timing of […] and expenses related to […].
swap: These expenses were higher because tax and audit services happened at different times (口语化，不够正式)
The increase was due to the different schedule of tax and audit services (词汇稍显冗长)

items.en: commencing on February 1, 2026 and expiring on January 31, 2033
items.why: 用分词短语作后置定语紧凑交代起止时间，极具合同文本的严谨感。中国人往往会写成冗长的从句 which begins on... and ends on...，不够精炼。
items.when: 披露租赁期、合同效力期或锁定资产持有期时。
items.slot: commencing on […] and expiring on […]
swap: effective from [...] to [...]（更偏向简短的日期罗列，缺乏动感）
beginning on [...] and terminating on [...]（用词偏口语化，缺乏SEC文件的公文感）

items.en: is scheduled to decrease to $337,410 from $381,325
items.why: 用 scheduled to 精准界定这种变动是按合同预先确定的（而非突发波动），客观严谨。中国人在写财务变动时常笼统用 will decrease，未能体现条款的契约预定属性。
items.when: 描述未来租金阶梯递增、分期偿还或已安排好的财务指标变动时。
items.slot: is scheduled to decrease to […] from […]
swap: will decrease to [...] from [...]（失去预定计划的客观语气，变成单纯的主观预测）
is set to decrease to [...] from [...]（口语化色彩稍浓，正式财报少见）

items.en: For information on material risks related to Edward Jones Bank
items.why: 用介词短语直接引导交叉引用，简洁干练。中国人写报告常受母语影响写成 For you to know more about... 或 If you want to find information about...，不够正式。
items.when: 在正文中引导读者跳转到其他章节、附录或外部文件查阅特定信息时。
items.slot: For information on [...]
swap: For further details regarding [...] (语气更重，强调细节)
Refer to [...] for information concerning [...] (动词前置，指令性更强)

items.en: could have a negative impact on the Partnership’s financial results
items.why: 用 could have a negative impact on 表达潜在负面影响，语气克制且符合 SEC 惯用的审慎表达。中国人常直接用 will hurt 或 affect badly，显得主观且不够职业。
items.when: 在风险披露或审计报告中评估某不利因素对财务表现的潜在影响时套用
items.slot: [market volatility/factor] could have a negative impact on [...]
swap: would adversely affect (语气略显绝对，不如 could 留有余地)
might negatively influence (influence 力量感不如 impact 重)

items.en: In the event of a significant reduction in revenues
items.why: 用 In the event of 替代简单的 if，瞬间提升句子的法律效力和审计严谨度。中国人极易条件反射地写成 If revenues reduce significantly，显得不够书面化。
items.when: 在假设性前提、应急条款或压力测试情景中引出条件时套用
items.slot: In the event of a [significant reduction/material change] in [...], [...]
swap: If there is a drop in (过于口语化，缺乏商业文书的正式感)
Should revenues decline significantly (倒装句式偏文学化，不如短语直接)

items.en: larger than the Partnership in terms of capital, resources, AUC, transaction volume and range of product offerings
items.why: 用 in terms of 完美限定了比较的维度，避免了泛泛而谈。中国人容易用 regarding 或 from the perspective of，显得臃肿不够地道。
items.when: 在财务分析中需要从多个具体指标（如资金、资产、交易量等）限定比较范围时套用。
items.slot: larger than the Partnership in terms of […]
swap: larger than the Partnership regarding [...] (regarding 略显生硬，多用于商务信函)
larger than the Partnership with respect to [...] (结构过长，不如 in terms of 精炼)

items.en: This list of factors is not all inclusive
items.why: 用 not all inclusive 替代不地道的 incomplete，语气严谨且符合法律与合规文书的惯用标准，中国人容易写成 is not complete。
items.when: 在列举风险、原因或特征但无法穷尽时，用于声明免责和范围限定。
items.slot: This list of […] is not all inclusive
swap: This list is not exhaustive (更具法律严肃性的同义词)
This list is not intended to be complete (意图更为明确的限定表达)

items.en: that may be made from time to time
items.why: 用 may be made 配合 from time to time 将动作泛化并进行概率对冲，中国人常写成 from time to time made，语序和严谨度均有欠缺。
items.when: 需要指代不定期的、多次发生的未来行为或声明时。
items.slot: that may be […] from time to time
swap: that might be issued periodically (用 issued 替换 made，语气更偏向正式出版物)
that are occasionally made (用 occasionally 替换短语，但削弱了动态感)

items.en: could be limited and perhaps eliminated by federal legislation
items.why: 采用情态动词 could 加上副词 perhaps 进行双重对冲（hedge），既指出了潜在的不利变化，又避免了绝对化断言。中国人写财报风险时容易用 will 或肯定语气，不够严谨。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中评估未来不确定性、法规变更或潜在负面影响时。
items.slot: could be [...] and perhaps [...] by [...]
swap: may be restricted and potentially phased out by [...] (用 may 和 potentially，专业度相似)
is subject to limitation or elimination by [...] (转换为主谓结构，更为正式)

items.en: revenues generated from TVA's electricity sales were $13.5 billion
items.why: 用过去分词短语后置定语作主语修饰语，比写成定语从句（revenues that were generated from...）更紧凑，中国人写财报常啰嗦用从句
items.when: 在财报中陈述特定业务板块或资产所产生的收入时套用
items.slot: [... revenues] generated from [...] were [...] billion
swap: revenues derived from [...] were [...] billion (derived 比 generated 更显正式和法律严谨)
revenues stemming from [...] were [...] billion (stemming from 强调来源和根基)

items.en: See Note 18 — Revenue for details regarding revenues by state for each of the last three years
items.why: 祈使句直接引导读者查阅附注，干脆利落。中国人写报告常加冗余的主语 we refer you to 或 please check
items.when: 正文需要交叉引用财务报表附注（Notes to Financial Statements）时套用
items.slot: See Note [...] — [...] for details regarding [...] for each of the last [...] years
swap: Refer to Note [...] for further details (Refer to 略显被动和客套)
Additional details can be found in Note [...] (字数过多，不够财报风格的简洁)

items.en: having due regard for the primary objectives of the TVA Act
items.why: 用分词短语作状语来表达“在做某事时充分考虑/兼顾……”，比用 and 连接句子显得老练且层次分明。中国人常写成 while considering 或 and they should consider。
items.when: 在陈述某项商业决策或政策制定时，需要说明必须兼顾的其他原则、法规或利益。
items.slot: having due regard for [...]
swap: taking into account [...] (语气更偏向技术性计算或数据考量)
with a view to [...] (目的性更强，但不如 due regard 正式且全面)

items.en: retirement of outstanding Bonds in advance of their maturity
items.why: 用介词短语 in advance of 代替提前的副词修饰，既保持了名词化（nominalization）的正式感，又避免了提前行文的琐碎。中国人极易写成 before they mature。
items.when: 在涉及财务安排、债务清偿、合同履行等时间节点的超前动作时使用。
items.slot: retirement of [...] in advance of [...]
swap: prior to the maturity of [...] (更偏向法律契约文体，略显生硬)
ahead of [...] (口语化色彩稍浓，不够严谨)

items.en: power shall be sold at rates as low as are feasible
items.why: 使用 as... as are feasible 结构来进行精妙的条件限制，既表达了普惠的愿望，又在法律上通过 feasible 留出了商业可行性的安全边界。中国人常写成 as low as possible，显得绝对而不严谨。
items.when: 在披露定价原则、收费标准、成本控制等可能受到客观条件约束的承诺时使用。
items.slot: at rates as [...] as are feasible
swap: at the lowest possible rates (主观意味太强，缺乏法规层面的客观弹性)
at commercially reasonable rates (虽然也是套话，但不如原句强调‘可行性极限’)

items.en: differ materially from recent results or anticipated future results
items.why: 用 materially 这个副词修饰 differ，比单纯用 significantly 更具法律严谨性和审计质感；中国人在写财报时常干瘪地用 be different from，缺乏专业度。
items.when: 在财报中比较实际业绩与预期业绩或历史数据时使用
items.slot: differ materially from [...]
swap: differ significantly from (程度稍弱，缺少 SEC 文件的严肃感)
vary substantially from (substantially 偏口语化，不如 materially 贴切)

items.en: assumes risk in professional, financial and personal lines
items.why: 用 assume risk 替代承担风险的普通动词 take 或 bear，搭配介词 in 精准定位细分领域。中国人容易写成 'takes risks on'。
items.when: 在尽调报告中描述承保或承担特定类别风险时套用
items.slot: assumes risk in [...]
swap: takes risks within [...] (takes 不够专业规范)
bears risk across [...] (across 强调横向跨度，不如 in 聚焦领域)

items.en: identified the concept of "enterprise risk" within an insurance company holding system
items.why: 用 identify 引出概念比直接用 define 或 introduce 显得更专业且符合监管文件客观陈述的基调。中国人常写成 put forward 或 raise this concept。
items.when: 在监管报告或尽调中首次提出、引入某个专业概念或框架时。
items.slot: identified the concept of "[...]" within a [...]
swap: introduced the concept of... (略显生硬，不如 identified 准确客观)
put forward the concept of... (口语化太强，不适合正式财报)

items.en: if not remedied promptly, is likely to have a material adverse effect
items.why: 采用省略句式 if not remedied promptly 极大地精简了条件状语从句，且用 is likely to have 替代确定性断言，规避了法律责任。中国人常写成 if it is not solved quickly, will cause...
items.when: 在审计或风险披露中预测潜在负面后果、进行谨慎表态时。
items.slot: if not [...], is likely to have a material adverse effect upon [...]
swap: if we do not solve it immediately, will lead to... (主观色彩太浓且不够正式)
if left uncorrected, may result in... (稍微简略但不如 remedied 贴切)

items.en: to assist state insurance regulators in monitoring the financial condition of insurance companies
items.why: 用 assist in doing 比中国人和非母语者滥用的 help to do 更具官方文件和法律契约的严谨感，动词搭配精确。
items.when: 写审计报告或尽调分析中描述某项措施、制度或工具的政策目的时。
items.slot: to assist […] in monitoring the financial condition of [...]
swap: to help [...] monitor [...]（略显口语化，缺乏专业正式感）
to facilitate [...] in overseeing [...]（词义更重，适用于更强势的监管干预场景）

items.en: Departure from the usual range on four or more of the ratios
items.why: 将动词 depart 转为名词 departure，并用介词 from 和 on 组合，完美把复杂条件压缩成一个高密度的名词短语，中国人常写成当动词用的长句。
items.when: 尽调中归纳触发某种审计预警或违约条款的特定触发条件时。
items.slot: Departure from the usual range on [...]
swap: When the ratio deviates from [...]（变成从句，拖沓冗长，失去专业财报的干练）
Falling outside of [...]（用动名词短语，语气偏随意，不适合正式披露）

items.en: requiring significant resources to fund operating expenses, construction and other expenditures
items.why: 用现在分词短语作后置状语，流畅地顺承主句并列举具体资金投向。中国人写到这里常另起一句用 'It requires...'，破坏了句式的紧凑感。
items.when: 在说明某项业务、战略或事件需要消耗大量资金或资源时。
items.slot: requiring significant resources to fund [...], [...] and other expenditures
swap: which demands substantial funds to cover [...], [...] and other costs (定语从句，结构稍显繁琐)
necessitating major outlays for [...], [...] and miscellaneous expenses (用词更高级但略显刻意)

items.en: See "Capital Resources and Liquidity" in Item 7., "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" for additional information and discussion
items.why: 标准的SEC财报交叉引用句式，祈使句开头干净利落。中国人写指引常常加上主语 'You can see...'，显得不够权威和规范。
items.when: 在报告正文中引导读者跳转至其他章节查看详情时。
items.slot: See "[...]" in Item [...], "[...]" for additional information and discussion
swap: Refer to "[...]" in Item [...] for further details (略微简化的交叉引用写法，正式度稍逊)
Additional information is available under "[...]" in Item [...] (被动语态，失去了祈使句的直接指令感)

items.en: in light of demand increases across the industry
items.why: 用 in light of（鉴于、考虑到）来引出背景原因，比直白的 because of 更显专业和书面。中国人写报告时容易滥用 because 或 considering，而 in light of 带有评估当前形势后的客观语气。
items.when: 在财务报告或审计报告中分析外部环境变化、宏观因素或行业趋势对企业的影响时套用。
items.slot: in light of […] across the industry, including due to […]

swap.zh: 过于直接因果，缺乏对客观形势的评估感

items.en: have an adverse effect on FET’s consolidated results of operations
items.why: 采用“动词 + 名词”结构（have an adverse effect on）代替动词（adversely affect），这是标准的 SEC 报告法律/财务文体特征。中国人常习惯写 adversely affect，而名词化表达能把负面影响作为实体结果抛出来，语气更严谨。
items.when: 评估潜在风险、不利事件或宏观压力对财务报表项目、现金流或经营成果的具体冲击时套用。
items.slot: could have an adverse effect on […]'s consolidated results of operations, cash flow and financial condition

swap.zh: 动词形式过于简短，缺乏正式法律文件的郑重感
negatively impact 略显口语化，不如 adverse effect 正式

items.en: involves risk, including the risk of potential breakdown or failure
items.why: 中国人写风险披露时喜欢用 involve risks 后面直接接名词，而这里用了同根词 risk, including the risk of 的名次叠用结构，使后面的细分风险点更加清晰且具有法律严谨性，避免了结构扁平化。
items.when: 在财务报告中披露某项核心业务（如运营、投资）面临的综合风险及其具体表现形式时套用。
items.slot: involves risk, including the risk of potential […]
swap: faces risks such as [...] (表达过于口语化，缺乏SEC档案的正式法律语气)
carries risks including [...] (动词力度稍弱，未强调风险的层层递进)

items.en: operational restrictions resulting from environmental requirements and governmental interventions
items.why: 中国人常写 caused by 或 due to，而 SEC 文本频繁使用分词短语 resulting from 作后置定语修饰 restrictions，既紧凑又带有强烈的因果顺承色彩，避免了使用定语从句的冗长。
items.when: 需要指代由于外部政策、法规或客观条件引发的负面结果或限制条件时套用。
items.slot: operational restrictions resulting from […]
swap: operational restrictions caused by [...] (caused by 略显粗白，缺乏财报的专业克制感)
operational restrictions due to [...] (due to 通常置于be动词后作表语，作后置定语不如 resulting from 流畅)

items.en: remain obligated to provide safe and reliable service
items.why: 用 remain 强调法定义务的持续性，比直接用 are required to 更有官方承诺的郑重感。中国人常写成 are still required to do，显得生硬机械。
items.when: 在陈述持续的监管义务、合规责任或合同承诺时
items.slot: remain obligated to […]
swap: stand committed to […]（强调姿态积极，但语气稍显公关化）
are required to […]（平铺直叙，缺乏对‘一直承担’这一状态的强调）

items.en: adversely affect our and the FET Subsidiaries' operating results through reduced revenues and increased capital and operating costs
items.why: 用 through 引导具体传导路径，结构清晰。中国人常写成 affect operating results, and this is caused by..., 句子松散且缺乏因果链条的紧凑感。
items.when: 在财报中分析某一风险因素如何通过财务指标逐层传导并产生影响时
items.slot: adversely affect […] operating results through […]

items.en: compared to $16.1 million at December 31, 2024
items.why: 用compared to衔接同一指标不同期间的对比数据，简洁逻辑清晰，避免重复主语，中国人常写的对应英文表达更啰嗦，缺乏专业报告的紧凑感
items.when: 在财务报告中对比同一财务指标不同期末时点的数值时套用
items.slot: compared to $[…] at […]

swap.zh: versus更正式，多用于监管类报告，语气更严谨
against更侧重对比基准，适合风险类数据的对比表述

items.en: marking a 2.7% increase from the previous year
items.why: 用现在分词短语作结果状语，紧凑衔接前文主体与数据结果，符合正式报告的简洁性要求；中国人常使用并列句如“and this leads to a 2.7% increase”，略显冗余，破坏行文流畅度
items.when: 描述某一行为或数据带来的直接结果的场合

swap: […], resulting in a […]% year-over-year rise（换用resulting in更直接体现因果关系）
[…], which brings about a […]% increase compared to last year（用定语从句稍显正式，适合强调因果逻辑）

items.en: designed to engage partners who provide value-added services
items.why: 用过去分词短语作后置定语，紧凑说明项目设计目的，比中文拆分表述更简洁，符合英文正式报告的凝练要求
items.when: 介绍项目、计划或流程设计目的的正式场景
items.slot: designed to engage […] who provide […] services
swap: created to attract partners that deliver value-added services（侧重创建动作，原短语更贴合官方设计初衷）
intended to engage partners offering value-added services（用现在分词简化定语，语气较灵活，原短语更正式）

items.en: verify the end customer's identification before accepting such orders
items.why: 用‘verify sth before doing sth’结构明确合规流程，比中文直译更符合英文审计/合规报告的正式表述，逻辑清晰
items.when: 描述合规审核、流程验证的正式场景，如财务尽职调查、审计报告
items.slot: verify the […] before accepting such orders
swap: confirm the end customer's identity prior to accepting such orders（更正式但稍生硬，原短语更自然）
check the end customer's identification before accepting such orders（语气较随意，不符合正式报告要求）

items.en: a temporary 10% levy on all global imports
items.why: 中文常直译“临时10%的关税对所有进口”，此处“a temporary [X] on [Y]”结构清晰限定了征税的范围和性质，避免歧义，符合财经报告精准表述要求。
items.when: 正式报告中描述征税、收费等具体事项的场合。
items.slot: a temporary [...] on all global imports
swap: a provisional 10% levy on all global imports（provisional侧重临时的不确定性，不如temporary准确）
a temporary 10% duty on all global imports（duty侧重国内税，通用性弱于levy）

items.en: Our products rely on key components, including merchant silicon, integrated circuit components and power supplies
items.why: 用名词化结构（rely on + 名词短语）替代直译的动宾结构，更符合英文正式报告的书面语风格，避免口语化；中国人常直接写‘Our products depend on...’，此处用rely on更贴合‘核心依赖’的程度，表述更精准。
items.when: 撰写正式财务报告中关于产品核心组件依赖情况的说明时套用。
items.slot: Our products rely on key components, including […], integrated circuit components and power supplies
swap: Our products depend on key components, including […], integrated circuit components and power supplies（depend on语气稍弱，无法体现‘核心依赖’的程度）
Our products are reliant on key components, including […], integrated circuit components and power supplies（被动结构正式度略低，主动结构更清晰）

items.en: neither we nor our contract manufacturers have a written agreement with these component providers
items.why: 用neither...nor并列否定两个主体，避免重复主语，逻辑严谨，符合英文正式报告的书面表达习惯；中国人常分开写‘We have no written agreement... Our contract manufacturers also have no...’，表述更啰嗦。
items.when: 撰写正式报告中关于多个主体共同不具备某项条件的说明时套用。
items.slot: neither we nor our […] have a written agreement with these component providers
swap: both we and our […] lack a written agreement with these component providers（both...and语气肯定，不如neither...nor的否定并列精准）
neither our […] nor we hold a written agreement with these component providers（语序调整后重点后置，正式度稍降）

items.en: typically do not impose purchase obligations for specific quantities beyond the amounts established in our submitted purchase orders or forecasts
items.why: 用模糊限制语typically限定动作的普遍性，避免绝对化表述，符合SEC合规报告的谨慎性原则；中国人常直接写‘do not impose’，缺乏限定，表述不够严谨。
items.when: 撰写正式报告中关于合同条款的普遍性说明时套用。
items.slot: [...] typically do not impose purchase obligations for specific quantities beyond the amounts established in our submitted purchase orders or forecasts
swap: generally do not impose purchase obligations for specific quantities beyond the amounts established in our submitted purchase orders or forecasts（generally语气更宽泛，不如typically贴合特定商业场景的常规情况）
usually do not impose purchase obligations for specific quantities beyond the amounts established in our submitted purchase orders or forecasts（usually偏向日常语境，正式度低于typically）

items.en: marks the start of the 2018-19 U.S.-China tariff hikes
items.why: 中文常直译“标志着2018-19年美中关税上调的开始”，此处用“marks the start of + 事件”的结构，简洁清晰建立事件时间逻辑，适合报告中关键节点的界定，帮助读者明确事件的时间意义。
items.when: 用于财务尽调、审计报告中说明关键事件的时间节点，如重大交易、政策变动的时间界定。
items.slot: marks the start of the […]
swap: signals the beginning of […]（同义，语气稍弱，适合非核心事件）
indicates the onset of […]（更偏向负面事件，适合审计中风险事件的时间说明）

items.en: dual mandate of maximum employment and price stability
items.why: 使用“dual mandate”这一财经政策领域的标准术语，简洁准确，体现专业性；中国人常写“two main goals”，表述冗余且不够正式。
items.when: 撰写货币政策、监管类报告，描述双重核心目标时套用。
items.slot: dual mandate of […] and […]
swap: two core objectives of […] and […]（更通用，不如dual mandate具备官方政策属性）
dual goals of […] and […]（语气稍弱，mandate更具法定/官方约束力）

items.en: such as the emergence of a pandemic, the start of a war, or a sudden breakthrough in technological advancement
items.why: 用“such as”引出平行结构的多个例子，逻辑清晰，符合英文正式文体的举例规范；中国人常写“like a pandemic, a war, or a tech breakthrough”，用like过于口语化，且例子结构不平行。
items.when: 撰写报告时，列举某类事物的具体实例时套用。
items.slot: such as the emergence of […], the start of […], or a sudden breakthrough in […]
swap: including the emergence of […], the start of […], or a sudden breakthrough in […]（including更强调全部包含，语气过重）
for example, the emergence of […], the start of […], or a sudden breakthrough in […]（for example更侧重单个例子，不适合多例列举）

items.en: in a virtual as well as on-demand format
items.why: 中文常说“在虚拟和按需的形式中”，表述不够正式且平行结构不清晰；该短语用“as well as”明确并列两种交付模式，更符合正式报告的专业语气。
items.when: 描述服务、项目或产品的交付格式时使用，适用于年报、合规报告等正式文件。
items.slot: in a […] as well as […] format
swap: in both […] and […] format (语气比原文更随意，不够正式)
in […] or […] format (含义侧重二选一，与原文的并列包含不同)

items.en: gain valuable feedback and suggestions on improvements to our culture and strategy
items.why: 中文常说“获取有用的反馈和建议来改善我们的文化和战略”，“获取”不如“gain”专业，“来改善”的介词搭配不如“on improvements to”精准；该表达更贴合正式报告中收集反馈的语境。
items.when: 描述从员工或利益相关方处收集反馈时使用，适用于公司年报、尽职调查报告等。
items.slot: gain valuable feedback and suggestions on improvements to our […] and […]
swap: obtain valuable feedback and suggestions for improving our […] and […] (“obtain”比“gain”更生硬，不够自然)
receive useful feedback and suggestions about improvements to our […] and […] (“useful”不如“valuable”专业，“about”搭配不够精准)

items.en: with a specific interest in local tax reform and urban economic development
items.why: 中文常用直白的“我对…有特别的兴趣”，此句用伴随状语结构，简洁正式，避免句子冗余，符合学术写作的正式性要求。
items.when: 学术报告、论文自我介绍等正式写作中，用于说明自身研究兴趣方向。
items.slot: with a specific interest in […] and […]
swap: having a particular focus on […] and […]（更突出研究的核心聚焦性）
with special attention paid to […] and […]（更强调对相关领域的关注度）

items.en: make it difficult to convince national brands to return or invest in Detroit
items.why: 用it作形式宾语避免主语过长，符合正式报告流畅性，中文常直接写“很难说服…”，英文该结构更自然。
items.when: 正式报告中表达难以说服某主体做某事的场合
items.slot: make it difficult to convince […] to […]
swap: pose a challenge to convincing […] to […]（语气更正式，侧重挑战而非直接困难）
make it hard to persuade […] to […]（语气偏口语化，不如前者正式）

items.en: driven by the highest property taxes in the state
items.why: 过去分词短语作后置定语，简洁紧凑避免从句冗长，适合正式报告简洁表达，中文常直接写“由…导致的”。

caused by the highest property taxes in the state（语气偏口语化，不如driven正式）

items.en: making retailers more reluctant to expand or relocate in Detroit
items.why: 中文常直接用“导致”连接因果，用现在分词作结果状语更简洁紧凑，符合英文正式报告表达习惯
items.when: 用于描述前一情况引发的后续结果

causing […] to be more reluctant to […] or […] in […]（更直接的因果表述）

items.why: 中文常直接写“这件事是我最关心的”，而用“top of mind”是财经报告里地道的正式表达，简洁贴合专业语境，避免口语化。

items.en: meaning they take a larger percentage of earnings from low-income residents
items.why: 该句用现在分词短语meaning引导解释性分句，精准衔接前文“regressive”的定义，逻辑清晰且简洁，中文常直接用冒号或“即”引出解释，英文用meaning更符合正式书面语的衔接习惯，避免冗余。

items.en: the outlook for employment and output was subdued

items.en: Though the labor market had been fairly solid through that spring
items.why: 用“Though”引导让步状语，自然衔接前后逻辑，流畅不生硬；中国人常直接用“However”转折，破坏报告连贯性。
items.when: 用于报告中描述与预期相反的现状或数据。

Although the […] had been fairly solid through that […]（语气更正式，书面感更强）

items.en: One simple way to visualize the monetary policy decision-making process
items.why: 这个写法用清晰结构引出分析方法，比中文常直译的“一个简单的方法是…”更自然流畅，符合英文报告正式逻辑衔接要求

items.slot: One simple way to visualize the […] process

A straightforward method to depict the monetary policy decision-making process → 更简洁，适合精简的正式报告

items.en: dictate mortgage rates, wage growth and daily household budgets
items.why: 用正式动词dictate准确表达“直接决定”的含义，比中国人常用的determine或decide更具书面正式感，契合财经报告语境

items.en: co-movement between commodity prices and country risk premia

items.when: 撰写大宗商品价格与风险、经济变量联动分析类的报告时套用。

joint movement between […] and […]（侧重联合行动而非协同变动）

items.en: the decision of when and how to innovate rests with each bank and its management
items.why: 这个写法以名词短语“the decision”作主语，避免用第一人称“we”，更客观中立，符合专业报告正式语气；中国人常直接写“we decide when and how to innovate”，主观性过强。
items.when: 撰写金融监管或企业治理类英文报告，表述决策归属时套用。

items.en: it is important to be clear about what that role is—and what it is not

items.when: 撰写专业报告或政策解读类英文内容，表述明确界定范围时套用。
items.slot: it is important to be clear about what that […] is—and what it is not
swap: it is essential to be explicit about what that role is and what it is not 用“explicit”替代“clear”，更强调表述精准性，语气偏严谨
it is critical to be unambiguous about what that role is and what it is not 用“unambiguous”替代“clear”，更突出无歧义要求，语气偏强硬

items.en: in the spirit of Bastourre et al. (2012)

items.en: in the spirit of Ouliaris and Rochon (2026)

items.when: 撰写学术报告、论文引用相关研究框架时套用

items.en: a balanced examination of both AI's potential benefits and the risks financial institutions need to manage
