items.en: increasing the number of people who could get health insurance
items.why: 用动名词短语作主语搭配定语从句精准限定范围，比中文直译对应的生硬英文更符合正式报告表达习惯，清晰传递覆盖人群数量变化
items.when: 正式报告中描述项目覆盖范围、受益人数变化时使用
items.slot: increasing the number of people who could get [X] through […]
swap: growing the number of people who could access health insurance through […]（语气更侧重数量增长趋势）
expanding the pool of people who could get health insurance through […]（语气更侧重覆盖范围扩大）

items.en: make it difficult to convince national brands to return or invest
items.why: 用it作形式宾语，避免真正宾语（不定式）后置导致的头重脚轻，符合英文正式写作的紧凑结构；中文常直接写“convincing national brands is difficult”，头重脚轻不够正式。
items.when: 正式报告中表达“说服某群体做某事很困难”的场合。
items.slot: make it difficult to convince […] to […] or […]
swap: make it hard to persuade（hard比difficult更口语，正式报告用difficult更合适）
pose a challenge to convincing（用名词challenge更正式，适合深度分析）

items.en: spurred demand for stronger Medicaid oversight and enforcement
items.why: 该短语用“spurred demand for”精准表达“促使产生对…的需求”，比中国人常用的“made people need”更正式且有动作感，符合财经报告的正式语气。
items.when: 在撰写政策、监管相关的财经报告时，表达“某事件促使产生对某方面的需求”的场景下使用。
items.slot: […] spurred demand for […]
swap: gave rise to the need for（语气更中性，侧重客观结果）
prompted a call for（更侧重呼吁行动，语气更主动）

items.en: established the national Medicaid Fraud Control Units program
items.why: 用“established”表达官方设立项目，比中国人常用的“set up”更正式，契合官方财经/政策报告的措辞规范，避免口语化。
items.when: 在撰写官方项目、机构设立的财经或政策报告时使用。
items.slot: established the national […] program
swap: set up the national […] program（更口语化，适合非正式场合）
created the national […] program（侧重创造新机制，语气稍弱）

items.en: primarily reliant upon our predominant merchant silicon vendor
items.why: 用“primarily”和“predominant”双重限定依赖的程度与主体，避免绝对化表述，符合SEC合规报告的谨慎性要求，中文常直接写“主要依赖某供应商”，英文通过双重限定更精准
items.when: 描述对特定核心供应商的依赖关系时套用
items.slot: we are primarily reliant upon our predominant […] vendor
swap: are mainly reliant on our dominant […] vendor（mainly比primarily随意，dominant语气弱于predominant）
are primarily dependent on our leading […] vendor（dependent不如reliant正式，leading语气弱于predominant）

items.en: beyond the amounts established in our submitted purchase orders or forecasts
items.why: 用“beyond”明确义务的范围边界，搭配“established”增强正式性，中文常直接写“超出采购订单或预测的数量”，此写法更符合法律合规文档的措辞规范
items.when: 描述合同义务或责任的范围边界时套用
items.slot: typically do not impose purchase obligations for specific quantities beyond the amounts established in our submitted […] or forecasts
swap: beyond the quantities set in our submitted purchase orders or forecasts（set不如established正式）
other than the amounts confirmed in our submitted purchase orders or forecasts（other than语气模糊，不如beyond明确边界）

items.en: Concerns about Medicaid’s “integrity ” became highly politicized
items.why: 这个写法用“Concerns about [主题] became highly politicized”清晰表达某议题因政治因素被高度化，中国人常直接写“[主题] is very political”，缺乏正式且精准的表述，适合财经报告描述政策争议的语境。
items.when: 撰写财经或政策相关报告，描述某议题因政治因素被高度化、引发争议的场合。
items.slot: Concerns about […] became highly politicized
swap: Issues related to Medicaid’s integrity were highly politicized（更正式，适合学术类报告）
Medicaid integrity concerns became highly politicized（更简洁，适合短篇幅报告）

items.en: maintained that anti-fraud rhetoric often disguised ideological opposition
items.why: 这个写法用“maintained that [论点]”清晰表达某方坚持的观点，且用“disguised ideological opposition”精准描述修辞背后的真实意图，中国人常写“said that anti-fraud words hide real opposition”，表述不够正式且精准，适合报告中引用观点的场合。
items.when: 撰写报告时，引用某方坚持的论点并点明其背后真实意图的场合。
items.slot: maintained that […] often disguised ideological opposition
swap: argued that anti-fraud rhetoric masked ideological opposition（语气更强，适合争议性话题）
asserted that anti-fraud rhetoric concealed ideological opposition（更正式，适合政策分析报告）

items.en: I am a Ph.D. candidate studying fiscal and social policy
items.why: 用“Ph.D. candidate”正式说明身份，搭配现在分词后置修饰研究领域，比中式的“I am a student who is studying for Ph.D. in...”更简洁专业，符合学术写作规范
items.when: 学术报告、简历或正式自我介绍场合
items.slot: I am a Ph.D. candidate studying […]
swap: I am a doctoral candidate researching […]（更正式，用于学术论文）
I am a PhD student focusing on […]（更常用，语气稍轻）

items.en: Since the effects of shocks are uncertain in real time
items.why: 中文正式报告常直接用"Because"引导原因，此处用"Since"更贴合财经/政策报告的正式语气，且"in real time"是专业领域精准表达"实时"的固定搭配，避免中式英语生硬翻译
items.when: 适合正式报告中引出因果关系的论述，尤其是涉及专业领域时效性分析时
items.slot: Since the effects of […] are uncertain in real time
swap: As the effects of shocks are uncertain in real time（语气更柔和，适合缓和论证）
Because the effects of shocks are uncertain in real time（更直接，适合强调因果逻辑）

items.en: policymakers must draw conclusions about their nature based on analysis of data
items.why: 中文写报告常拆分冗余从句如"policymakers must draw conclusions about their nature because they analyze data"，此处用"based on"的分词结构作后置定语，避免冗余，符合英文正式报告的简洁性要求，且"draw conclusions"是财经领域固定表达
items.when: 适合正式报告中描述决策/结论的依据时使用
items.slot: […] must draw conclusions about their nature based on analysis of […]
swap: policymakers should draw conclusions about their nature on the basis of analysis of data（"on the basis of"更正式，适合学术类报告）
policymakers need to draw conclusions about their nature through analysis of data（"through"更强调方式，语气稍弱）

items.en: whose relative importance and interactions must be assessed
items.why: 中文写报告常重复名词如"overlapping shocks, and their relative importance..."，此处用"whose"引导非限制性定语从句，指代明确，避免名词重复，让句子更连贯紧凑，符合正式写作要求
items.when: 适合正式报告中对前文提到的复数名词（如多个因素、冲击）的补充说明时使用
items.slot: […] overlapping shocks, whose relative importance and interactions must be assessed
swap: […] overlapping shocks, and their relative importance and interactions must be evaluated（用and连接，语气稍口语化，正式度略低）
[…] overlapping shocks, the relative importance and interactions of which must be assessed（用"of which"替代"whose"，更书面化，适合严谨学术写作）

items.en: make it difficult to convince national brands to return or invest in Detroit for the first time
items.why: 用形式主语it替代冗长的真正不定式短语，避免句子头重脚轻，中文常直接写“很难说服”，显得生硬不流畅。
items.when: 用于正式报告中表达“做某事存在困难”的语境
items.slot: make it difficult to convince […] to return or invest in […] for the first time
swap: make it hard to persuade national brands to return or invest in Detroit for the first time（hard比difficult语气更随意，persuade侧重行动说服）
pose a challenge to convincing national brands to return or invest in Detroit for the first time（更正式，强调挑战属性）

items.en: increase the cost of moving goods and maintaining retail inventory
items.why: 用两个动名词moving和maintaining构成平行结构，清晰对应成本的两项具体内容，比中国人易犯的不定式不平行错误更符合英文正式写作的严谨规范，逻辑清晰
items.when: 财经报告中阐述成本对应的具体活动内容时套用
items.slot: increase the cost of moving […] and maintaining […]
swap: raise the cost of transporting goods and keeping retail inventory（transporting侧重货运，keeping偏口语，适配性窄）
boost the cost of moving goods and to maintain retail inventory（不定式破坏平行结构，不符合正式写作要求）

items.en: The rules governing these banks were first established in 1993.
items.why: 用现在分词"governing"作后置定语修饰"rules"，简洁紧凑，避免了冗余的定语从句，中国人常习惯写"the rules which govern these banks"，表述更冗长。
items.when: 用于正式财经或监管报告中，修饰规章制度、条款等名词的场合。
items.slot: The rules governing […] were first established in […].
swap: The rules that govern these banks were first set in 1993.（用定语从句替代现在分词，语气稍正式但表述更冗长）
The rules governing these banks were initially set in 1993.（用"initially"替换"first"，强调初始性，语气略有差异）

items.en: represented 80%, 79% and 80% of our total revenues for 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively.
items.why: 用respectively精准匹配多组对应数据（百分比与年份），避免分述每年占比的冗余，中国人常直接罗列各年占比，结构松散
items.when: 正式财务报告（如SEC 10-K）中披露多组对应量化数据的场合
items.slot: represented […], […], and […] of our total revenues for […], […], and […], respectively.
swap: accounted for 80%, 79% and 80% of our total revenues for 2025, 2024, and 2023, correspondingly（correspondingly语气模糊，不如respectively精准对应）
made up 80%, 79% and 80% of our total revenues for 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively（made up偏口语化，不如represented正式）

items.en: Revenues derived directly, as a prime contractor, or indirectly, as a subcontractor, from contracts with the U.S. government
items.why: 用derived from明确收入来源，用as修饰身份（主承包商/分包商），结构清晰正式，中国人常写“revenues from direct contracts as prime and indirect as subcontractor”，缺少规范来源表述结构
items.when: 正式财务报告中界定收入来源及对应合作身份的场合
items.slot: Revenues derived […], as a […], or […], as a […], from contracts with […]
swap: Revenues generated directly, as a prime contractor, or indirectly, as a subcontractor, from contracts with the U.S. government（generated侧重创造，不如derived侧重来源精准）
Revenues coming directly, as a prime contractor, or indirectly, as a subcontractor, from contracts with the U.S. government（coming偏口语，不符合正式报告措辞）

items.en: Our U.S. government sales are concentrated with the DoW, which constitutes the majority of our U.S. government revenue for any given year.
items.why: 用定语从句which补充核心客户（DoW）的收入占比地位，紧凑且信息完整，中国人常拆成两句，逻辑衔接弱、正式度不足
items.when: 正式财务报告中披露客户集中度及核心客户地位的场合
items.slot: Our […] sales are concentrated with the […], which constitutes the majority of our […] revenue for any given year.
swap: Our U.S. government sales are concentrated with the DoW, and it constitutes the majority of our U.S. government revenue for any given year.（用and连接，逻辑紧凑度弱于定语从句）
Our U.S. government sales are concentrated with the DoW, which forms the majority of our U.S. government revenue for any given year.（forms语气稍弱，不如constitutes正式）

items.en: based on the competitive dynamics of each opportunity
items.why: 该写法用具体维度明确决策依据，避免模糊空泛，中文常写笼统表述，不够严谨
items.when: 说明业务角色、合作模式等决策依据的正式报告场景
items.slot: based on the competitive dynamics of […]
swap: in light of the competitive dynamics of […]（更正式，适合监管类报告）
depending on the competitive dynamics of […]（更灵活，适合内部分析）

items.en: derive a significant portion of our revenue from
items.why: 精准量化核心收入的来源占比，符合英文财经报告的正式书面表达习惯，中文常笼统写“我们的大部分收入来自”，缺少正式性与精准占比表述
items.when: 在财务报告中说明核心收入的主要来源场景时套用
items.slot: We derive a significant portion of our revenue from […]
swap: generate a large share of our revenue from（语气偏向市场份额视角，原句侧重来源的持续性）
obtain a substantial part of our revenue from（语气更正式，适合监管类文件）

items.en: A significant percentage of our revenue is derived from
items.why: 用被动语态客观表述收入结构占比，符合英文正式报告的中立性要求，中文常直接写“我们的很大一部分收入来自”，缺少被动语态带来的客观性
items.when: 在财务报告中客观说明收入的结构占比时套用
items.slot: A significant percentage of our revenue is derived from […]
swap: A large proportion of our revenue is generated from（更偏向运营视角，原句侧重来源的根源性）
A substantial percentage of our revenue is obtained from（更正式，适合SEC类监管文件）

items.en: had fallen to 2.3 percent from 2.8 percent a year earlier
items.why: 这个量化对比写法清晰严谨，符合财经报告的正式风格，中国人常直接写“decreased from X to Y”，缺少时态和具体时间参照，不够精准
items.when: 用于财务报告中描述指标同比变化的幅度
items.slot: had fallen to […] percent from […] percent a year earlier
swap: declined to […] percent from […] percent a year earlier（语气更中性，适合非紧急类报告）
decreased to […] percent from […] percent a year earlier（更简洁，适合短篇幅报告）

items.en: But, ultimately, the decision of when and how to innovate rests with each bank and its management.
items.why: 用「rests with」清晰表达责任归属，比中国人常用的「is the responsibility of」更简洁正式，符合财经报告的严谨性。
items.when: 用于财务尽职调查或审计报告中明确责任主体的场合。
items.slot: But, ultimately, the decision of when and how to […] rests with […]
swap: ultimately, the responsibility for deciding when and how to innovate lies with each bank and its management.（用「lies with」替换「rests with」，语气更中性）
ultimately, it is the responsibility of each bank and its management to decide when and how to innovate.（用形式主语it结构，更书面化，增强正式感）

items.en: Our job is to set clear expectations, be transparent, and not micromanage individual business decisions.
items.why: 用并列结构（set clear expectations, be transparent, not micromanage）清晰罗列职责，比中国人常用的「our responsibilities include」更简洁有力，符合报告凝练要求。
items.when: 用于财务尽职调查或审计报告中明确自身职责的场合。
items.slot: Our job is to set clear expectations, be transparent, and not micromanage individual […] decisions.
swap: Our responsibilities include establishing clear expectations, maintaining transparency, and avoiding micromanagement of individual business decisions.（用「establishing」「maintaining」「avoiding」替换动词短语，更书面化）
We are tasked with setting clear expectations, being transparent, and refraining from micromanaging individual business decisions.（用「are tasked with」替换「Our job is to」，语气更正式）

items.en: We can create a supportive regulatory environment by being receptive to new ideas and technologies.
items.why: 用「being receptive to」表达开放接纳的态度，比中国人常用的「accept」更委婉专业，符合财经报告中对创新的中立立场表达。
items.when: 用于财务尽职调查或审计报告中描述对新事物（如新技术、新方法）态度的场合。
items.slot: We can create a supportive […] environment by being receptive to […]
swap: We can foster a supportive regulatory environment by being open to new ideas and technologies.（用「foster」替换「create」，更具动态感；「open to」替换「receptive to」，语气更直接）
We can build a supportive environment by being amenable to new ideas and technologies.（用「build」替换「create」，「amenable to」替换「receptive to」，更强调愿意协商）
